items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Во славу стыѧ единосущныѧ животворащїѧ. и нераздѣлимыѧ Трцы.
items.english_text: To the glory of the Holy, Consubstantial, Life-Creating, and Undivided Trinity:

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Старанїемъ раба своего Арсенїя Триножка. и жены его Анастасїи: написасѧ книга сїѧ. глаголемаѧ Октоихъ. сирѣчъ Осмогласникъ до цркве Дипополской. Храмъ Чда. с. Михаила.
items.english_text: Father, and Son, and Holy Spirit.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Старанїемъ раба своего Арсенїя Триножка. и жены его Анастасїи: написасѧ книга сїѧ. глаголемаѧ Октоихъ. сирѣчъ Осмогласникъ до цркве Дипополской. Храмъ Чда. с. Михаила.
items.english_text: Through the zeal of His servant Arseniy Trynozhka and his wife Anastasiya, this book was written, called the Octoechos, that is, the Eight-Toned Book, for the church of Di[po]pole,[^1] the Temple of the Miracle of Saint Michael.[^2]

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: In the year from the Nativity of Christ 1707.[^3]

items.office: Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [Мініатюра ліворуч: Воскресіння Господнє. Спаситель постає над відкритим гробом у сяйві хмар, тримаючи в лівиці хоругов з хрестом, правицею благословляє. Вгорі напис: ІН҃С ХР҃С. Доокола рослинна ілюмінована рамка.]
items.english_text: [Miniature on facing leaf: The Resurrection of Christ. The Savior rises above the open tomb surrounded by clouds of light, holding in His left hand a banner with the Cross, and blessing with His right hand; inscribed above: IC XC. Enclosed in an illuminated floral border.]

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Начало гласъ .а. или Осмогласникъ. Содержащїй...
items.english_text: *The Beginning of Tone 1, or the Octoechos.*

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: В субботу вечере на Гди воззвахъ поставимъ стіхи...
items.english_text: *On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...*

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Вечернаѧ наша млтвы, прїймы стый Гди. и подаждь намъ ѡставленїе грѣховъ. ꙗко ты единъ єси, ꙗвлей въ Мирѣ въскрнїе.
items.english_text: Receive our evening prayers, O Holy Lord, and grant us remission of sins; for Thou alone art He Who showed forth the Resurrection unto the world.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: нашъ. избавлей насъ ѿ безаконїй наши.
items.english_text: Encompass Zion, O ye people, and surround her, and give glory within her unto Him Who is risen from the dead; for He is our God Who delivered us from our iniquities.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Прїйдѣ́те людїе воспоемъ, и поклонимся Хртꙋ: славѧще єго є́же иꙁмртвыхъ воскрнїе. ꙗко то́й є́стъ Бгъ нашъ. и́же ѿлести вражїѧ миръ иꙁбавлѧяи.
items.english_text: Come, ye people, let us hymn and worship Christ, glorifying His Resurrection from the dead; for He is our God, Who delivered the world from the deceit of the enemy.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Веселитеся нбса, вострꙋбите ѡснованїа земли. возопїйте горы съ веселїемъ. Се́ бо Еммануилъ, грѣхи наша на Кртѣ́ пригвоздивъ. и жизнь даяй, смерть оумертвивъ: Адама воскрсивыи, ꙗко члѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: Be glad, O ye heavens; sound the trumpet, ye foundations of the earth; cry aloud, ye mountains, with gladness! For behold, Emmanuel nailed our sins to the Cross, and giving life, He put death to death, raising Adam, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Плотїю волею распеншагося насъ ради. пострадавша, и погребенна. и́ воскрша иꙁмртвыхъ, воспоемъ глаголюще. оутверди православіемъ Црков твою Хр́те. и оумири жизнь нашу, ꙗко блгъ и члѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: Him Who of His own will was crucified in the flesh for our sake, Who suffered and was buried, and rose from the dead, let us hymn, saying: Confirm Thy Church in Orthodoxy, O Christ, and make our life peaceful, as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Живопрїемному ти гробу, престояще недостойнїи, славословїе приносимъ, неизреченному твоему блговтробїю Хрте Бже ншъ. ꙗко Крть и смрть насъ ради волею прїемый. и воскршаго въ славѣ безгрѣшне. да мирови дарꙋеши воскрнїе, ꙗко члѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron (fol. 2):*[^4]

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Иже Ѡцꙋ съ беꙁначална, и съ прносꙋщна слова. и́же ѿ Двическа чрева прошедшаго неизреченно, и Кртъ, и смрть насъ ради волею прїемшаго, и воскрша въ славѣ, воспоемъ глаголюще. животодавче Гди слава тебѣ́, Спсе дшамъ ншимъ.
items.english_text: Standing before Thy life-receiving Tomb, we, the unworthy, offer doxology unto Thine unutterable loving-kindness, O Christ our God; for Thou, the Sinless One, didst accept the Cross and death of Thine own will for our sake, and didst rise in glory, that Thou mightest grant resurrection unto the world, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Всемирную славу, ѿ члвкъ прозябшую...
items.english_text: The Word Who is equally without beginning and co-eternal with the Father, Who came forth ineffably from the Virginal womb, and of His own will accepted the Cross and death for our sake, and rose in glory, let us hymn, saying: O Giver of life, Lord, glory to Thee, the Savior of our souls!

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Всемирную славу, ѿ члвкъ прозябшую...
items.english_text: *Glory... Now and ever... Dogmatic Theotokion (Incipit):*

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: шую, и влка рождшую. нбную дверъ. воспоемъ Мрїю Двицю. беꙁплотныхъ пѣснь и вѣрныхъ оудобренїе. та бо ꙗвися нбо, и Црковъ Бжтва. та прегражденїе вражды раздрашивши. миръ въведе, и цртвїе ѿверзе. Сїю оубо имѣще, вѣры оутвержденїе. поборника имамы. йзнея рождшагося Гда. дерзайте оубо. дерзаите, людїе Бжїи. ибо той побѣдитъ враги. ꙗко всесиленъ.
items.english_text: The glory of the whole world, who blossomed forth from mankind who bore the Master, the Heavenly Gate, let us hymn Mary the Virgin, the song of the Bodiless Powers and the adornment of the faithful! For she was revealed as Heaven and the Temple of the Godhead; she, having broken down the barrier of enmity, brought in peace and opened the Kingdom. Having her, therefore, as the confirmation of our faith, we have a Champion, the Lord Who was born of her. Be of good courage, therefore, be of good courage, O people of God; for He will conquer the enemies, as He is almighty.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Стра́тїю твоею Хрте, ѿстра́стей свободихомся: и воскрнїемъ твоимъ йзистлѣнїа йꙁбавихомся. Гди слава тебѣ́.
items.english_text: By Thy Passion, O Christ, we have been set free from passions; and by Thy Resurrection we have been delivered from corruption. O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Стіхъ:* Гдь воцрися, въ лѣпоту ѡблечеся.
items.english_text: Let creation rejoice, let the heavens be glad, let the nations clap their hands with mutual rejoicing! For Christ our Savior nailed our sins to the Cross, and putting death to death, He bestowed life upon us, raising the fallen Adam with all his race, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Да ра́дꙋется тваръ, нбса давеселя́тъся: рꙋкама да всплещꙋтъ ꙗꙁыци совеселїем. Хртосъ бо Спсъ нашъ. на Кртѣ́ пригвозди грѣхи наша. и смерть оумертвивъ. животъ намъ дарова. падшаго Адама всероднаго воскрсивыи. ꙗко человѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron (fol. 3):*[^5]

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Стіхъ:* Ибо оутверди вселенную, ꙗже неподвижется.
items.english_text: O Incomprehensible King of Heaven and earth, of Thine own will Thou wast crucified for love of mankind! Hades, encountering Thee below, was embittered, while the souls of the righteous, receiving Thee, rejoiced; and Adam, beholding Thee, O Creator, in the nethermost parts, arose. O the marvel! How did He Who is the Life of all taste of death? But as He willed, He enlightened the world, which cries and says: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Цръ сый нбу и земли непостижиме, волею распяся за члвколюбїе. єгоже адъ срѣтъ долѣ, ѡгорчи́ся. и праведныхъ дꙋша прїемаяи. радовахꙋся. Адамъ же видѧ тя Зиждителю въ прейсподнихъ, воста. Ѡ чꙋдесе. како смерти вкꙋси, и́же всѣхъ жизнь. но ꙗкоже йꙁволи мира просвѣ́тити, вопїюща. и́ глꙩща. воскрсый иꙁмртвыхъ. Гди слава тебѣ́.
items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearing Women, carrying myrrh with haste and weeping, reached Thy Tomb; and not finding Thine immaculate Body, but learning from the Angel of the new and most glorious miracle, they said unto the Apostles: The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: бнаго, своима рꙋкама носящи. на твоя рабы оумилосердися: и моли спастися дшамъ нашимъ.
items.english_text: Behold, the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled; for as a Virgin thou didst give birth, and after giving birth thou didst remain as before birth. For He Who was born was God, and therefore He transformed nature anew. But, O Mother of God, despise not the supplications of thy servants offered unto thee in thy temple, but as the Mother of the Compassionate One bearing Him in thine arms, have compassion on thy servants, and pray that our souls may be saved.

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Камени запечатану ѿ їꙋдей. и́ воиномъ стрегꙋщимъ Пречтое Тѣло твое. въскрсалъ єси въ третїи днь Спсе. даруяи мірови жиз. сего ради сили нбныя вопїяху ти жизнодавче. Слава воскрнїю ти Хрте. слава Царствїю ти. слава смотренію твоему, едине человѣколюбче.
items.english_text: While the stone was sealed by the Jews and the soldiers were guarding Thine immaculate Body, Thou didst rise on the third day, O Savior, granting life unto the world. Therefore, the Heavenly Powers cried aloud unto Thee, O Giver of life: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O Christ! Glory to Thy Kingdom! Glory to Thy dispensation, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Гаврїилꙋ провѣщавшу ти Дво, є́же радуйся. съ гласомъ воплощашеся всяческихъ Влка, в тебѣ́ стѣмъ Кївѡтѣ. ꙗкоже рече првныи Двдъ. ꙗвилася єси ширшая нбсъ понесшїя Зиждителя своего. слава вселшемуся в тя. слава прошедшему йз тебе. слава свободйвшему насъ ржтвомъ твоимъ.
items.english_text: When Gabriel proclaimed unto thee, O Virgin, "Rejoice!", with the voice the Master of all became incarnate in thee, the holy Ark, as the righteous David said. Thou wast revealed more spacious than the heavens, having borne thy Creator. Glory to Him Who dwelt within thee! Glory to Him Who came forth from thee! Glory to Him Who set us free through thy childbearing!

items.office: On Saturday evening at "Lord, I have cried," we set the verses...
items.slavonic_text: Тый жде Тропари. и в Неделю. на оутрени поемъ. на Бгъ Гдь.
items.english_text: *Rubric: These same Troparia are sung also on Sunday at Matins at "God is the Lord."*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: В Ндлю на полунощници Канѡнъ Стѣи и Живоначалнѣи Трцѣ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .а. Ірмосъ:* Твоя побѣдителная десница. бголѣпно.
items.english_text: Thy victorious right hand in God-befitting manner...[^7]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Едино трїсоставное начало, Серафіми немолчно славятъ: беꙁначалное приснѡсꙋщное, творителное всяческихъ, непостижимое, блꙁе. и́ всякъ ꙗꙁыкъ вѣрно почитаетъ пѣснми.
items.english_text: The Seraphim unceasingly glorify the One Tri-Hypostatic Beginning: unoriginate, co-eternal, Creator of all things, incomprehensible, O Good One; and every tongue faithfully honors Thee with hymns.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Да члвкомъ единственное. трїсїятелное твое ꙗвиши Бжтво. создавый прежде члвка, по своему Ѡбраꙁу воѡбраꙁилъ єси, оумъ єму; и Слово. и Дхъ давъ, ꙗко члвѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest reveal Thine only, tri-radiant Godhead unto men, having fashioned man before, Thou didst form him according to Thine image, giving him mind, and word, and spirit, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Съ вышише показуя, единственною, Бгоначалныхъ въ трїехъ ѵпостасехъ державу: Ѡч҃е реклъ єси. равнодѣ́телному своему Снꙋ и Дхꙋ. прїйдѣ́те сошедше. ꙗꙁыки йхъ размѣ́симъ.
items.english_text: Showing forth from on high the single dominion of the Divine Sovereignty in Three Hypostases, Thou, O Father, didst say to Thine equally creative Son and Spirit: Come, let Us go down and confound their tongues.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Оумъ оубо єстъ нерожденныи Оцъ ѡбраꙁно премрдыи преречеся. Слово же собеꙁначалное съ естественный Снъ, и Дхъ стый. и́же вдвѣ слова создавыи воплощенїе.
items.english_text: The unbegotten Father is figurative mind, named most wise; while the Word, co-unoriginate, is the consubstantial Son; and the Holy Spirit, Who fashioned the incarnation of the Word...

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .г. Ірмосъ:* Единъ съвѣдый члвческаго сꙋщества немощь...
items.english_text: O Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature...[^8]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Ты древле ꙗвѣ Авраамꙋ ꙗко ꙗвися трисоставенъ, єдинственъ же, естествомъ Бжества: бгословїа истиннѣйшее. ѡбраꙁно ꙗвилъ єси. и́ вѣрно поем тѧ. единоначалнаго Бга и трїсолнечнаго.
items.english_text: Of old, visibly appearing unto Abraham as three hypostases, yet one in the nature of the Godhead, Thou didst prefigure the truest theology; and we faithfully hymn Thee, the Single-Origin God, Tri-Radiant.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Истебе родивыися Бголѣ́пно. неизреченно Очее, возїя свѣтъ ѿ свѣта Снъ непремѣне; и Дхъ Бжтвенный свѣтъ йзыйде: и єдинаго Бжтва зари. трїсопостатнѣй. покланяемся вѣрно. и́ славимъ.
items.english_text: Born of Thee in a God-befitting manner, ineffably, O Father, the Son, Light of Light, shone forth immutably, and the Holy Spirit, Divine Light, proceeded; and we faithfully worship and glorify the Three Hypostases, the splendors of the One Godhead.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Единица Трца преестественѣ. неизреченно паче смысла. оумными сꙋществы славится, трїстыми гласы немолчную вопїющихъ хвалу. и́миже согласно поетъся й нами. трисгостатный Гдь.
items.english_text: The Trinity in Unity is praised supernaturally, ineffably, beyond understanding, by the noetic beings, who cry out with unceasing praise in thrice-holy voices, with whom the Tri-Hypostatic Lord is harmoniously hymned by us also.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Истебе временнѣ беꙁсѣмене пройзынде вышше лѣтный, оуподобивыися намъ невидимый, и єдиному естеству и Цьству Ѡчу научикъ. и Сновню, и Дховꙋ. Бце: тѣмже тя славимъ.
items.english_text: From thee in time, without seed, came forth the One Who is above time; the Invisible One, having become like unto us, taught us the one nature and Kingdom of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Spirit, O Mother of God; therefore, we glorify thee.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Сѣдаленъ. Гласъ .а. по. Гробъ твои...
items.english_text: O All-Effecting Trinity and All-Good Unity, receive the supplications of those who unceasingly cry with clay lips: Holy, Holy, Holy, sung in the manner of the Seraphim! O Giver of life, save and have compassion on those who cry out in Thy holy Church: Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Трце вседѣтелная, и́ преблагая єдинице прїими молбы, вопїющїй непрестанно бренными оустнами: Стъ. стъ. стъ. воспѣваемый Серафімски. жизнодавче, спси и́ оущедри, и́же в стѣй Цркви твоеи Зовꙋщихъ, Гди слава тебѣ́.
items.english_text: Have mercy on us who cry unto thee, O Most Holy, Pure One, who cry night and day: Cleanse our transgressions, for thou hast a Merciful One Who hears thy supplications; encompass us, therefore, with a motherly prayer.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Помилуй насъ, и́же к тебѣ́ возывающихъ. Престая чтая. в нощи и́ въ дни вопїющихъ. ѡчисти наша прегрѣшенїа: ꙗбо мардаго ймаши послушающа твоя молбы, Матернею оубо молитвою ѡкємши насъ.
items.english_text: Mount overshadowed by the grace of God...[^10]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .д. Ірмосъ:* Горꙋ тя блгодáтїю Бжїю присѣнъ...
items.english_text: Shine upon us, O Tri-Radiant Divine Sovereignty, with the splendors of Thy beneficent illuminations into the eyes of our hearts, to envision the beauty of Thy Divine brightness that is beyond the mind, and of Thy light-giving and sweet communion!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Восїяйми Бгоначалїе трїсолнечное: сїянми твоихъ бгодѣтелныхъ ѡꙁаренїй къ сердечныхъ ѡчесехъ, добротѣ мечтатїся, є́же паче оума Бгоначалныя ти свѣ́тлости, й свѣтодателнаго и сладкаго причастїя.
items.english_text: In the beginning Thou didst establish the heavens, O Lord, and all their host by Thy all-creating Word, and by the Spirit of Thy mouth, Who is consubstantial; with Whom Thou rulest over all things by Thy tri-radiant, single-origin Godhead.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Бгоначалная и вседѣ́телная Трце. неслїянная единице: враꙁꙋми и́ просвѣ́ти, воє́же творити волю твою стꙋю и блгꙋю въ крѣпости й сокрушенную.
items.english_text: Having created us according to Thine image and likeness O Sovereign and All-Effecting Trinity, Unconfused Unity: give us understanding and enlighten us, that we may do Thy holy and good will in strength and contrition.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Родила єси ѿ Трца единаго Пречтая. Бгоначалнѣйша Сна, воплощшася насъ ради истебе, ѡзаряюща земнородныхъ, трїсолнечнаго Бжтва невечернымъ свѣтомъ, и стнымь.
items.english_text: Thou didst bear One of the Trinity, O Most Pure Lady, the Most Sovereign Son, Who was incarnate for our sake of thee, illuminating earthborn mortals with the unwaning and holy light of the Tri-Radiant Godhead.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .є. Ірмосъ:* Просвѣщенїемъ сїянїемъ пришествїя твоего...
items.english_text: By the illumination of the brilliance of Thy coming...[^11]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Иже первой Агглской кромѣ посредства оуткари, непристꙋпными твоея доброты лꙋчами ѡсїяваемой быти блговоливши: твоими зарами просвѣ́ти Трце единоначалственнѣйшая, православно тебе поющихъ.
items.english_text: O Trinity, most single in sovereignty, Who wast well pleased that the first angelic creation should be illuminated without mediation by the unapproachable rays of Thy beauty: enlighten with Thine illuminations those who hymn Thee in Orthodoxy!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Нынѣ естество̀ единственное Бгоначалїе трїсолнечное, воспѣваетъ тя. є́же ѡсꙋществовала єси за блгть. прегрѣшенїемъ йзбавленіе и напастем, йспрошающи, и бѣдъ и скорбей.
items.english_text: Now human nature, which Thou didst bring into being out of goodness, hymns Thee, the Single Nature, the Tri-Radiant Divine Sovereignty, asking deliverance from transgressions, and assaults, and tribulations, and sorrows.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡца. и Сна, и́ Дха стаго: єдино естество и Бжество вѣрнїи славимъ. дѣлителное оубо. нераздѣлное же. єдинаго Бга. невидимыя и невидимыя твари.
items.english_text: *Troparion (fol. 6):*[^12]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Реченїя вся Прроческая. преднаписаша. Пречтая твое ржтво: неизреченное. и невдобьсказꙋемое: єгже мы познахомъ. тайно научающес. ѿединственнѣмъ и трисолнечнѣмъ Божествѣ.
items.english_text: Father, and Son, and Holy Spirit: one Nature and Godhead do we, the faithful, glorify, divided yet undivided, of the One God of visible and invisible creation.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .ѕ. Ірмосъ:* Ѡбыйде насъ послѣдняя беꙁдна...
items.english_text: All the prophetic sayings prefigured thy childbearing, O Most Pure Lady: ineffable and inexplicable; whereby we came to know, being mystically taught, of the single and tri-radiant Godhead.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Равностатную силꙋ ꙗко ймѣщи, Трце пресꙋщественная, в тождествѣ хотѣнїа. єдиница єси проста и́ нераздѣлна. ты оубо насъ силою своею соблюди.
items.english_text: The lowest abyss has encompassed us...[^13]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Ты вся вѣки хотѣ́нїемъ своимъ, ꙗко блга составила єси ѿ несꙋщихъ, непостижимая Трце. Таже и́ члвка создала єси. но йннѣ, ѿ всякаго иꙁбавими ѡбстоянїа.
items.english_text: Possessing equal power, O Supersubstantial Trinity, in identity of will, Thou art a simple and undivided Unity; do Thou, therefore, preserve us by Thy power!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Безначалная и сопрстолная Трце стая. Ѡч҃е. и Сн҃е. и Дш҃е, вся ѡживляющи. всяже ѡсщяющи. и́ вся спсающи. единою силою. та бо славятъ херувіми. ймы недостойный хвалу ти воздаемъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst establish all the ages by Thy will from non-being, as Thou art good, O Incomprehensible Trinity; then Thou didst also create man; but now deliver us from every tribulation!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Слнцу незаходимомꙋ храмъ была єси...
items.english_text: O Holy Trinity, without beginning and enthroned together, Father, Son, and Spirit, Who givest life to all, sanctifiest all, and savest all by one power: for the Cherubim glorify Thee, and we, the unworthy, render praise unto Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: зда́вшемꙋ и въ чинъ поста́вльшемꙋ свѣтила великаѧ всесилнѣ, пречтаѧ дво Бгоневѣ́стнаѧ. но й ннѣ страстеймѧ иꙁбави и́мꙋченїа.
items.english_text: Thou wast a temple unto Him Who created and in all His power set in order the great luminaries, O Most Pure Virgin, Bride of God; but even now deliver me from passions and torment.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Припадаемъ ти вѣрою ѿ срдца вопїюще: помилуй насъ непотребныхъ своѧ рабы, Трце преблгáѧ, Оч҃е, и Сн҃е, съ Дхо́мъ, и оуми́лрдися всемативаѧ, на стадо є́же собра̀ мꙋдрѣ, непрестанно славѧщее твою блгость.
items.english_text: Falling down before Thee in faith, we cry out from the heart: Have mercy on us, Thine unprofitable servants, O All-Good Trinity, Father and Son with the Spirit; and show compassion, O All-Merciful, toward the flock which Thou hast wisely gathered, which unceasingly glorifies Thy goodness.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Дв҃о, иже истебе неизреченно рожьшемуся молися, нша ѡблегчити срдца, въ глꙋбинѣ ѡтчаянїа ѡтѧгченна прегрѣшенми: й возведи ѿ оуны́нїи тяжкихъ, славити тѧ всемлтиваѧ: єдинꙋ надеждꙋ рабомъ твоимъ.
items.english_text: O Virgin, pray to Him Who was ineffably born of thee, that He may lighten our hearts, weighed down in the depth of despair by transgressions, and lead us up from grievous despondency to glorify thee, O All-Merciful Lady, the only hope of thy servants.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь .з҃. Ірмо́съ:* Тебе мысленную Бде пещь разсмотрѧ...
items.english_text: Considering thee, O Mother of God, as a mystical furnace...[^15]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Слове Бжїй, съестественное ѡзаренїе вседержителя Бга, ꙗкоже ѡбѣщася єже оутебе, бгодѣ́телное вселенїе сотвори, ꙗко блговоутробенъ, съ Ѡцемъ твоимъ и Дхомъ, истрашна бѣсомъ мѧ покажи и́ стра́стемъ.
items.english_text: O Word of God, consubstantial radiance of God the Almighty, even as Thou didst promise, make Thine all-beneficent abode in me, as Thou art tenderly compassionate, with Thy Father and the Spirit, and show me to be terrible unto demons and passions.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Да твое́го блгосердїа вл́ко покажеши починъ...
items.english_text: *Troparion (fol. 7):*[^14]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: чинъ намъ, Сна своего пославъ к нашему смѣренїю, паки въ ѡбразилъ єси на первꙋю свѣ́тлость, но й ннѣ Бжтвеннымъ мѧ вразуми Дхо́мъ.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest show the beginning of Thy tender-heartedness toward us, O Master, having sent Thy Son unto our lowliness, Thou didst reform us unto our first brightness; but even now give me understanding through Thy Divine Spirit.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Треми сщенїи едино Бжтво славимъ, Ѡца безна́чалнаго, Сна же сопртолна, и Дха, въ єдиной державѣ, и вѣрно вопїемъ: Оцъ нашихъ Бже блгвенъ єси.
items.english_text: By three hallowings we glorify the One Godhead: the Unoriginate Father, the Co-Enthroned Son, and the Spirit, in one dominion, and faithfully cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Иже на херувімстѣмъ Пртолѣ носимый, всѧческихъ Царь, въ чревѣ твоемъ Дѣвственнѣмъ вселися пречтая: всѣхъ иꙁбавлѧѧ нистаънїа, ꙗко человѣколюбецъ, но й ннѣ твоими мѧ молбами сохрани.
items.english_text: He Who is borne upon the Cherubic Throne, the King of all, dwelt within thy virginal womb, O Most Pure Lady, delivering all from corruption, as the Lover of mankind; but even now preserve me by thy supplications.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь .и҃. Ірмо́съ:* Чюдо превелїе росодавцꙋ во ѡбразѣ пещъ...
items.english_text: A marvelous wonder: the furnace prefiguring the dew-giver...[^16]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Манїемъ бгодѣ́телнымъ Гди всѣхъ, Трїсоставне и вседержителю, нбса простерлъ єси ꙗко кожꙋ, таже и́ Землю ѿклыналъ єси глꙋбину, всесилною ти горстїю. Тѣмже ирабы твоѧ оукрѣпи, любовїю и вѣрою ктебѣ чловѣколюбче, да тѧ славимъ желанїемъ въвѣки.
items.english_text: By Thine all-beneficent nod, O Lord of all, Tri-Hypostatic and Almighty, Thou didst stretch out the heavens like a skin, and didst also establish the depth of the earth by Thine all-powerful fist; therefore strengthen also Thy servants in love and faith toward Thee, O Lover of mankind, that we may glorify Thee with longing unto the ages.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: [трисо]лнечный свѣ́тъ тѧ лицы, единственный же паки сꙋществомъ, є́же къ твоимъ свѣтодателнымъ лꙋчамъ взирати присно, имиже насыщꙋся славы твоеѧ сладкїѧ, й свѣтодателныѧ й пребогатыѧ, й превозношꙋ тѧ вѣрно въ [вѣки].
items.english_text: Enlighten with Thy Divine-origin Light those who hymn Thee, the Tri-Radiant Light in Persons, yet Single in Essence, ever to gaze upon Thy light-giving rays, whereby I may be filled with Thy sweet, light-giving, and bountiful glory, and I faithfully exalt Thee unto the ages.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Прїими хвалꙋ й честь ѿ непости́жнаго оума нашего, Трце пресовершенная, всѧ ѡзарѧющи, й оу́мъ просвѣщающи ѡбластїю й си́лою, тѧ бо славѧтъ нбныѧ силы, й мы земнїи немолчно вопїем и превозноси въ вѣки.
items.english_text: Receive praise and honor from our incomprehensible mind, O Most Perfect Trinity, enlightening all things, and illuminating the mind with dominion and power; for the heavenly powers glorify Thee, and we, earthborn mortals, unceasingly cry aloud and exalt Thee unto the ages.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Вознесе на нбса, чловѣ́ческое прїемъ естество непреложнѣ, Снъ твои Пречтаѧ Бце, премножествомъ блгти, йзбавль древнѧѧ тлѧ, єму же й благодарственно воспѣваемъ: Да блгословитъ тваръ всѧ Гда, й превозноси въ всѧ вѣки.
items.english_text: Thy Son, O Most Pure Mother of God, having assumed human nature immutable, by the abundance of His goodness, and delivered it from ancient corruption, ascended into the heavens; unto Whom we also sing in thanksgiving: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь .ѳ҃. Ірмо́съ:* Образъ чтаго ржтва твоего...
items.english_text: The image of thy pure childbearing...[^18]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Спаси Спсителю твари, чꙋвственныѧ же йоумныѧ, рабы твоѧ, ѿ вражїѧго навѣ́та, й ѡзлобленїѧ, престаѧ Трце, єдиносꙋщнаѧ: й соблюдай стадо твое всегда безнавѣ́тно.
items.english_text: Save Thy servants, O Savior of creation, both sensible and intelligible, from the snare and malice of the enemy, O Most Holy, Consubstantial Trinity, and keep Thy flock ever unharmed!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Да глубинꙋ неисчетнꙋю, сꙋщественныѧ покажеши...
items.english_text: *Troparion (fol. 8):*[^17]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: покажеши своеѧ бл́гости, далъ єси намъ ѡбѣ́ты, Трїсолнечный, й единоначалный Бже всесилный, спсителныѧ твоимъ рабомъ, йхже съвершити сподоби.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest show the unsearchable depth of Thine essential goodness, Thou hast given saving promises unto Thy servants, O Tri-Radiant and Single-Originate Almighty God; which vouchsafe to fulfill!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Призри на наша моленїа, и́же въ Трїехъ Бгоначалныхъ ѵпостасѣхъ, єдинъ сый Бгъ въ истиннѣ вѣрꙋемый: й подаждь твоимъ ракомъ оутѣшенїе, молитвами Пречистыѧ й препѣ́тыѧ Бгоматере.
items.english_text: Look upon our supplications, Thou Who art One God in Three Divine-Origin Hypostases, truly believed in, and grant comfort unto Thy servants,[^19] through the prayers of the Most Pure and All-Hymned Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, the Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity (fol. 4):*[^6]
items.slavonic_text: Нестерпѣ естества Земнаго зрѣти, завистїю вражїею, въ тлѣнїе впадша, преслꙋшанїемъ Первозданнаго: но преклонь нбса сниде, нералꙋчся Божества, въ двѣ́ без Ѡца воплощся, да земныѧ ѡбожитъ.
items.english_text: He could not endure to behold earthly nature fallen into corruption through the envy of the enemy by the disobedience of the First-Formed; but bowing the heavens, He came down without parting from the Godhead, and was incarnate of the Virgin without a father, that He might deify earthborn mortals.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: В Неделю на Оутрени, по .а. Стіхологїи Сѣдаленъ, Гласъ .а.:
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [въскр]шомꙋ из Гроба, й единомꙋ Бгꙋ нашему.
items.english_text: While the soldiers were guarding Thy Tomb, O Savior, they became as dead from the lightning brilliance of the appearing Angel, who proclaimed the Resurrection unto the women. We glorify Thee, the Destroyer of corruption; we fall down before Thee Who art risen from the tomb, and our only God.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Къ Кртꙋ пригвоздися волею щедре, въ Гробѣ же положенъ бывъ ꙗко мертвъ, животодавче, держа́вꙋ съкрꙋшилъ єси силне смертїю. Тебѐ бо вострепеташа вратници Адовы, ты совоздвигл єси и́же ѿ вѣка оу́мершї ꙗко єдинъ человѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed to the Cross of Thine own will, O Compassionate One, and laid in the Tomb as one dead, O Giver of life; Thou didst mightily crush the dominion of death, for the gatekeepers of Hades trembled before Thee; and Thou didst raise with Thyself those dead from the ages, as the only Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Матеръ тѧ Бжїю свѣмы вси, Двꙋ въ истиннꙋ, й по рждтвѣ ꙗвльшꙋюся, и́же любовію прибѣгающїи, къ твоей блгти. Тебе бо имами грѣшнїи престателницꙋ, й тебе стѧжахомъ въ напастехъ спасенїе, єдинꙋ всенепорочную.
items.english_text: We all know thee to be the Mother of God, truly revealed as Virgin even after childbearing, who flee unto thy goodness with love; for we sinners possess thee as a mediatress, and we have acquired thee as salvation in afflictions, the only All-Immaculate Lady.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: По .в. Стілогїи Сѣдаленъ, Гласъ .а.:
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Жены къ Гробꙋ прїидоша оуранше, и Агглское ꙗвленїе видѣвше трепетахꙋ: Гробъ ѡблисташе жизнь, чꙋдо оужасаше йхъ: сего ради шедше оу́чникомъ проповѣдахꙋ востанїе: Ада йспровергъ Хртосъ, ꙗко єдинъ крѣпокъ й силенъ, й истлѣвшаѧ съ воздвигнѣ всѧ, страхъ ѡсꙋжденїа разоръ силою Кртною.
items.english_text: The women went early in the morning to the Tomb, and seeing the appearance of the Angel, they trembled; the Tomb shone forth life, and the marvel amazed them; therefore going unto the Disciples, they proclaimed the rising: Christ has overthrown Hades, as He alone is mighty and strong, and He has raised all the corrupt with Himself, destroying the fear of condemnation by the power of the Cross.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Къ кртꙋ пригвоздися животе всѣхъ, и въ мертвыхъ вмѣненъ бывъ безсмертный Гдь: къ срдцꙋ єси трїдневенъ Спсе, й воздвиглъ єси Адама ѿ тлѧ. сего ради Силы нбныѧ вопїахꙋ ти жизнодавче, слава стртемъ твоимъ Хрте, слава воскресенїю ти, слава съхожденїю твоему, едине члвколюбче.
items.english_text: *Glory (fol. 9):*[^20]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Заченши неѡпално Ѻгнь Бжтвенный: й рождши безсѣмени источника жизни Гда, Ѡбрадованнаѧ Бце, спаси тебе величающихъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed to the Cross, O Life of all, and numbered among the dead, O Immortal Lord; Thou wast in the heart of the earth three days, O Savior, and didst raise Adam from corruption. Therefore the Heavenly Powers cried aloud unto Thee, O Giver of life: Glory to Thy Passion, O Christ; glory to Thy Resurrection; glory to Thy descent, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Разбойниче покаянїе. Рай ѿверзе, рыданїе же Мvроносицъ, радость возвѣсти: ꙗко въскрлъ єси Хрте Бже, подаяй мїрови велїю млть.
items.english_text: Having conceived without being burned the Divine Fire, and given birth without seed unto the Lord, the Fountain of life, O Full of Grace, Mother of God: save those who magnify thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Вънегда скорбѣ́тими, оуслыши моѧ болѣ́зни, Гди тебѣ Зовꙋ.
items.english_text: The repentance of the thief opened Paradise, and the lamentation of the Myrrh-bearing Women proclaimed joy: that Thou art risen, O Christ God, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Пустыннымъ непрестанно Бжтвенное желанїе бываетъ, мира сꙋщимъ сꙋетнаго кромѣ.
items.english_text: When I am in sorrow, give ear unto my afflictions, O Lord, as I cry unto Thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Стомꙋ Дхꙋ, честь и́ слава, ꙗкоже Ѡцꙋ подобає[тъ]...
items.english_text: For those of the desert, divine longing is unceasing, since they are outside the vain world.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [по]доба́етъ, кꙋпно же й Снꙋ. сего ради да воспоемъ Трци единодержа́вїе.
items.english_text: To the Holy Spirit belong honor and glory, even as it is fitting unto the Father together with the Son; therefore let us hymn the single dominion of the Trinity.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: На горы твоихъ, вознесемя законъ добродѣтелей: просвѣти Бже, да пою тѧ.
items.english_text: Unto the mountains of Thy laws has the law of virtues lifted me up; enlighten me, O God, that I may hymn Thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Десною ти рꙋкою прїймъ ти Слове, съхранима соблюди, да не Ѻгнь менѐ ѡпалитъ грѣховный.
items.english_text: Receiving me with Thy right hand, O Word, keep and preserve me, lest the fire of sin burn me up.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Стымъ Дхомъ, всѧка тваръ ѡбновлѧется, паки текꙋщи напервое: равномощенъ бо єстъ Ѡцꙋ й Словꙋ.
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit every creature is renewed, running back unto the first state; for He is equally powerful with the Father and the Word.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ѡрекшихъ мнѣ, внидемъ въ дворы Гдна: возвеселимися Дхъ, сорадꙋетъ ми ся сердце.
items.english_text: Over those who said unto me: Let us go into the courts of the Lord, my spirit was glad, and my heart rejoiced.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Въ домꙋ Дввѣ, страхъ великъ, та́мо бо Престоломъ поставле́ннымъ, судѧтся вся племена Земнаѧ и́ языци.
items.english_text: In the house of David there is great fear; for thrones being set there, all the tribes and nations of the earth shall be judged.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Стомꙋ Дхꙋ, честь й поклоненїе, сла́ва й держа́ва, ꙗкоже Ѡцꙋ достоитъ, й Снови же подоба́етъ приносити: єдиница бо єстъ Трца єстествомъ а нелици.
items.english_text: To the Holy Spirit belong honor and worship, glory and dominion, even as it is worthy of the Father, and fitting to be offered unto the Son; for the Trinity is a Unity in essence, but not in persons.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Нынѣ воскрну глетъ Гдь, положꙋся въ спсенїе, й не ѡбинꙋся ѡнемъ.
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon (fol. 10), Tone 1:*[^21]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Всѧко дыха́нїе. Еѵлїе оу́трнее. Воскрнїе Хво. Ѱаломъ .н҃. Канонъ воскресенъ на .д. Кртовоскресенъ на .д. Бци на .г. й в минеи на .д. Аще празднуемы стый, на .ѕ.
items.english_text: Now will I arise, says the Lord; I will set Myself in salvation, I will deal openly therein.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Твоѧ побѣдителнаѧ десница, бголѣпно въ крѣпости прославися, та бо безсмертне: ꙗко всемогꙋщаѧ, противныѧ сотрѐ, Їилтяномъ пꙋть глубинѣ содѣлавшаѧ.
items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord. Matins Gospel. The Resurrection of Christ. Psalm 50.*[^22]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Иже рꙋка́ма пречтыма, ѿ пе́рсты Бгодѣтелнѣ йсперва създавъ мѧ, рꙋцѣ распрострѣтъ на Кртѣ, ѿ Землѧ возивая тлѣ́нное ми Тѣло, є́же ѿ Двы прїалъ єси.
items.english_text: *The Resurrection Canon on 4; the Cross-Resurrection Canon on 4; that of the Mother of God on 3; and in the Menaion on 4. If a celebrated saint, on 6.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ѡумерщвленїе подалъ єси мене ради, й дшꙋ смерти предасть: и́же въ дꙋновенїемъ Бже́ственнымъ, дшꙋ ми вложивъ: й ѿрѣши́въ вѣчныхъ оузъ, й съ воскресивъ нетлѣнїемъ прославилъ єси.
items.english_text: Thy victorious right hand has been glorified in strength in a manner befitting God; for it, O Immortal One, being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, making a way for the Israelites through the deep.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Радꙋйся блгти источниче, Радꙋйся Лѣ́ствице й двери[... ]
items.english_text: *Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Радꙋйся блгти источниче, Радꙋйся Лѣ́ствице й двери[... ]
items.english_text: He Who with all-pure hands fashioned me in divine beneficence from the dust in the beginning, stretched out His hands upon the Cross, calling up from the earth my corruptible body, which Thou didst receive from the Virgin.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Радꙋйся блгти источниче, Радꙋйся Лѣ́ствице й двери[... ]
items.english_text: Thou didst submit to mortification for my sake, and didst deliver Thy soul unto death, O Thou Who by Divine inbreathing didst place a soul in me; and loosing me from eternal bonds and raising me with Thyself, Thou didst glorify me with incorruption.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [й двери...] й двери нбнаѧ. Радꙋйся свѣщниче йстамно Златаѧ, й горо несѣкомаѧ, ꙗже жизнодавца Хрта мирови рождшаѧ.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Fountain of grace; rejoice, O Ladder and Heavenly Gate! Rejoice, O Candelabrum and Golden Jar, and Uncut Mountain, who didst bear Christ the Giver of life unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Хртосъ ѡбожа́етъ мѧ, воплоща́яся. Хртосъ мѧ возноситъ смирѧ́яся. Хртосъ безстрастнымъ съдѣловаетъ, стражда жизнодавецъ єстествомъ плоти. тѣ́мже воспѣваю блForceдарственную пѣснь, ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Same Tone. Ode 1:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Хртосъ возноситъ мѧ, распинаемъ. Хртосъ совоскрша́етмѧ, оу́мерщвлѧемъ. Хртосъ жизнь ми дарꙋетъ. тѣмже съ веселїемъ, рꙋкама плещꙋще, пою спсителю побѣднꙋю пѣснь, ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: Christ deifies me, becoming incarnate; Christ exalts me, humbling Himself; Christ makes me impassible, as the Giver of life suffers in the nature of flesh; therefore I sing a song of thanksgiving: For He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Бга Дви́це зачала єси, блже въ дѣтвѣ родила єси, йстебе воплощшася Пречтаѧ, единаго соста́вомъ єдинародна: во двоихъ же сꙋществѣ́хъ познаваемаго Сна, ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: Christ exalts me, being crucified; Christ raises me with Himself, being put to death; Christ grants me life; therefore with gladness, clapping our hands, I sing unto the Savior a song of victory: For He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Кꙋ́ю ти достойнꙋю пѣснь наше принесетъ неможенїе, точїю ѡбрадователную, є́иже насъ Гаврїилъ тайно навчилъ єстъ: радꙋй[ся]...
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive God, O Virgin, and didst bear Him in virginity, incarnate of thee, O Most Pure Lady: the Only-Begotten Son, One in Hypostasis, yet known in two essences: For He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дуйся Бце Дво, Мати неневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Mother of God:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Прно двѣ й Мтри Царѧ вышнихъ силъ, ѿчистѣйша срдца вѣрнїи, дховнѣ възопїемъ: Ра́дуйся Бце Дво, Мати неневѣстнаѧ.
items.english_text: What worthy song can our weakness offer thee, save that of joyful greeting, which Gabriel mystically taught us: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God, Unwedded Mother! (fol. 11)[^23]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Неизрече́ннаѧ беꙁдна твоего непостижимаго ржтва твое́го всечистаѧ, вѣрою несꙋмлѣнною оу́бо чистѣ приносимъ ти слн̃ше: Ра́дꙋйся Бце Дво, Мати неневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: Unto the Ever-Virgin and Mother of the King of the heavenly hosts, from a pure heart let us, the faithful, spiritually cry aloud: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God, Unwedded Mother!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Единъ съ вѣдый члвчкаго существа неможенїе, й млтивнѣ вне ѡболкїися, препояшимя силою, є́же въ пити тебѣ стый, Црковъ ѡдꙋшевленнаѧ пречтыѧ ти славы, человѣколюбче.
items.english_text: O All-Pure Lady, unto the ineffable abyss of thine incomprehensible childbearing, with unhesitating faith we purely offer thee praise: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God, Unwedded Mother!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Бгъ сый мнѣ бл́гїе, падшаго оущедрилъ єси, й съ нїити къ мнѣ блговодилъ єси. Распятїем же въ знесыймѧ, є́же вопити тебѣ стый славы Гдь, неизслѣдимый въ блгости.
items.english_text: *Katavasia: I will open my mouth...*[^24]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Животъ съставенъ Хрте сый, и истлѣвшамѧ ꙗко млрдый Бгъ в мя ѡболкїйся, въ персть смертную съ шедъ вл́ко, смертную державꙋ раꙁрꙋшилъ єси, й мертвецъ трїдневенъ воскрсе[... ]
items.english_text: Thou alone, Who knowest the weakness of human nature, and didst mercifully clothe Thyself in it: gird me with power to cry unto Thee: Holy art Thou, the animate temple of Thine all-pure glory, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Животъ съставенъ Хрте сый, и истлѣвшамѧ ꙗко млрдый Бгъ в мя ѡболкїйся, въ персть смертную съ шедъ вл́ко, смертную державꙋ раꙁрꙋшилъ єси, й мертвецъ трїдневенъ воскрсе[... ]
items.english_text: Being God, O Good One, Thou didst have compassion upon me who was fallen, and wast well pleased to descend unto me; and by Crucifixion Thou didst exalt me, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy art Thou, the Lord of glory, unsearchable in goodness!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [воскрсе:] воскрсе: въ нетлѣнїе мѧ ѡболкъ єси.
items.english_text: Being Substantial Life, O Christ, and having clothed Thyself in me who was corrupted, as the Merciful God: descending into the dust of death, O Master, Thou didst destroy the dominion of death, and rising as dead on the third day Thou didst raise me, and didst clothe me in incorruption.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ѡгнь заченши въ оутробѣ Двице Дхомъ оубо пртымъ, пребыла єси неѡпалима, понеже тѧ Кꙋпина Законодавцꙋ Моѵсею, палиму й несгегому ꙗвѣ прежде возвѣсти, прїемшю Ѻгнь непостоя́нный.
items.english_text: Having conceived Fire in thy womb through the Holy Spirit, O Virgin, thou didst remain unconsumed; for the Bush manifestly prefigured thee to Moses the Lawgiver, burning yet unconsumed, as thou didst receive the Insupportable Fire.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Иже на свое ра́мо Заблꙋждшее ѻвча̀ воспрїимъ, й низложившемꙋ древомъ грѣхъ єго, Хртꙋ Бгꙋ воꙁопїемъ, въ здвигнувый рогъ нашъ, стъ єси Гди.
items.english_text: Unto Him Who took upon His shoulders the straying sheep, and by the Tree cast down its sin, unto Christ God let us cry aloud: O Thou Who hast exalted our horn, holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Возведшемꙋ Пастыра великаго иꙁ Ада Хрта: й стителствомъ єго, Аплы мꙋдрѣ ꙗзыки оу́пасшемъ, истинною й Бжественнымъ Дхомъ да послꙋжимъ.
items.english_text: Unto Him Who brought up from Hades the Great Shepherd, Christ, and through His pastorship wisely shepherded the nations through the Apostles, let us minister in truth and in the Holy Spirit.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Иже ѿ Двы волею въ плотившемꙋся бесѣмене Снꙋ, й рождшꙋю по ржтвѣ, Бжтвенною силою чтꙋю Двꙋ сохраншемꙋ, и́же над всѣми Бгꙋ воꙁопїемъ: стъ єси Гди.
items.english_text: Unto the Son Who of His own will was incarnate without seed of the Virgin, and Who by Divine power preserved the Pure Virgin even after childbearing, unto God Who is over all let us cry aloud: Holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ѡблакъ тѧ легкїи неложнѣ Дво йменꙋемъ, Прроческимъ послѣ́дующе реченїем, прїиде на тѧ Гдь, разорити єгѵпетскїѧ пре[лести]...
items.english_text: We truly call thee a light cloud, O Virgin, following the prophetic sayings; for the Lord came upon thee to destroy the Egyptian deceptions of hand-made idols, and to enlighten those who serve them. (fol. 12)[^25]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: прелести рꙋкотвореніѧ, й просвѣтити симъ слꙋжащыѧ.
items.english_text: The prophetic choir truly named thee a sealed fountain and a shut gate, hymning the wonders of thy virginity, clearly describing the signs for us, which He preserved even after childbearing.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ запечатлѣнный воистинну ликъ Прроческїи, источникъ же, й заключе́нную дверь йменова, дѣтва твоего воспѣтая, ꙗвственнѣ знаменїа намъ пишуще, юже соблюде й по рождествѣ.
items.english_text: Gabriel, having been vouchsafed to see the Supersubstantial Mind as far as possible, brought unto thee the joyful greeting, O All-Immaculate Virgin, clearly announcing the conception of the Word and proclaiming His ineffable birth.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Оу́ма пресꙋщественна видѣти, ꙗко же мощно сподоблся Гаврїилъ, Двице пренепорочнаѧ, ѡбрадованенъ ти гласъ принесе, словꙋ Зачатїе ꙗвственнѣ возвѣщающъ, й неизреченное рожденїе проповѣдающъ.
items.english_text: Having perceived with foresighted eyes the mountain overshadowed by Divine grace, Habakkuk proclaimed the Holy One of Israel about to come forth from thee, for our salvation and renewal.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Горꙋ тѧ блгтїю бжтвенною присѣннꙋю, прозорливима Аввакꙋмъ оусмотривъ Ѻчима истебе й зынти хотѧща, Їилю провоуглашаше стаго, наспсенїе наше й ѡбновленїе.
items.english_text: Who is this Savior coming forth from Edom, wearing a crown of thorns, having His garments dyed red, hanging upon the Tree? He is the Holy One of Israel, for our salvation and renewal.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [єгоже:] єгоже бо ꙗ́ко ѕлодѣѧ вы вознести на Кртъ оу Пилата йспросисте, оумовредивѣ, смерти радразщикъ силꙋ, бголѣ́пно въскрсѐ иꙁ Гро́ба.
items.english_text: Behold, ye disobedient people, and be ashamed for Him Whom ye madly asked of Pilate to lift upon the Cross as an evildoer, destroying the power of death, arose from the tomb in a manner befitting God.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Древо тѧ Дви́це жизни свѣ́мы: небо снѣдны плодъ смертоно́сный члвкомъ истебе прозѧбе, но живота присносꙋ́щнаго наслажденїе, наспсенїе наше й ѡбновленїе.
items.english_text: We know thee to be the Tree of Life, O Virgin; for no mortal fruit for food grew forth from thee unto men, but the enjoyment of life eternal, for our salvation and renewal.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Кто се́й красенъ иꙁ едома, йсего ѡчервленїе ризное, ѿ винограда босо́рска, красенъ ꙗко Бгъ, ꙗко члвкъ же, Кровїю плоти; ризꙋ ѡчервле́нꙋ нося, ємꙋже поемъ, вѣрнїи: сла́ва силѣ твое́й Гди.
items.english_text: Who is this beautiful One coming from Edom, and His garments dyed red from the vineyard of Bosor? Beautiful as God, and as man, wearing a garment reddened with the Blood of His flesh; unto Whom we, the faithful, sing: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Хртосъ бꙋдꙋщихъ блгъ, ꙗвлься Архїереи, грѣхъ нашъ разорилъ є́стъ, й показа́въ страненъ пꙋть свое́ю Кровїю, въ лꙋчшꙋю же й съвершеннѣйшꙋю вниде скинїю, Пртча нашъ въстав.
items.english_text: Christ, having appeared as the High Priest of good things to come, destroyed our sin, and having shown a strange way by His own Blood, entered into the greater and more perfect Tabernacle, having become our Forerunner.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкоже реклъ єси, третїи днь Хрте воскре иꙁ Гро́ба, составная истинно, разоренную бо Црковъ, своего телесе: ꙗ́ко содѣ́тель, ѡбнови́лъ єси, нетлѣ́нный же ꙗко Бгъ ꙗвися...
items.english_text: Even as Thou didst say, O Christ, on the third day Thou didst rise from the tomb, which was truly accomplished; for as Creator Thou didst renew the destroyed temple of Thy body; and Thou wast revealed as incorruptible God, and incorruptible man. (fol. 13)[^26]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Оу́винъ древнїй долгъ йспросила єси препѣ́таѧ, ѻу́иже насъ ради ꙗвльшагося новаго Адама, съединивъ во тебѣ чтымъ зачаттїемъ, плоть оумнꙋю ѡдꙋшевленную, йстебе произый́де Хртосъ, единъ во ѻбоихъ Гдь.
items.english_text: Thou didst release the ancient debt of Eve, O All-Hymned Lady, through the New Adam Who appeared for our sake; having united in thee through the honorable conception an intelligible, animate flesh, Christ came forth from thee, One Lord in both natures.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Слы́ши чюдесъ Небо, й внꙋшай Земле: ꙗко дщи перстнаго падшаго Адама, Бгꙋ нареченна бысть, й своему содѣ́телю роди́телница, на спнїе наше й ѡбновленіе.
items.english_text: *Another Troparion, to the Most Holy Theotokos:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Поемъ великое й страшное твое Таинство, премы́рныхъ бо оутаився чиноначалїи, на́тѧ йже прно сый, сниде ꙗ́ко дождь нарꙋно всепѣтаѧ, наспнїе нше й ѡбновленіе.
items.english_text: Hear wonders, O Heaven, and give ear, O Earth! For the daughter of the earthly, fallen Adam was called Mother of God, and parent unto her Creator, for our salvation and renewal.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Стаѧ стыхъ, Бце всепѣтаѧ, чаѧнїе ꙗзыкомъ, й спнїе вѣрнымъ, йстебе восїа Избавитель, й жизнода́вецъ, й Гдь, єгоже моли спастися рабомъ твоимъ.
items.english_text: We hymn thy great and awesome Mystery; for hiding Himself from the heavenly ranks, He Who is ever-existing came down upon thee like rain upon the fleece, O All-Hymned Lady, for our salvation and renewal.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣтивый сїянїемъ пришествїя твоего Хрте, й оуꙗснивъ Кртомъ си ми́рꙋ конца, срдца просвѣ́ти свѣтомъ[... ]
items.english_text: Holy of holies, O All-Hymned Mother of God, the expectation of the nations and salvation of the faithful: from thee shone forth the Redeemer, and Giver of life, and Lord; Whom implore to save thy servants.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [свѣтомъ] ти, свѣтомъ твоего Бгоразꙋмїя православно поющы.
items.english_text: O Christ, Who didst enlighten the ends of the world with the brilliance of Thy coming, and didst make them radiant by Thy Cross: enlighten the hearts with the light of Thy divine knowledge, of those who hymn Thee in Orthodoxy.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Пастырѧ ѻвцамъ великаго й Гда, Їꙋдеи дре́во Кретнымъ оу́мертвиша, но тои самъ, ꙗ́ко ѻв[ца], мертвыѧ въ Адѣ погребенныѧ, Державы смертныѧ иꙁбави.
items.english_text: The Jews put to death the Great Shepherd of the sheep and the Lord by the tree of the Cross; but He Himself delivered the dead buried in Hades from the dominion of death.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Кртомъ си ми́ръ блговѣстивъ: й проповѣ́дал єси плѣннымъ, Спсе мо́й, ѡставле́нїе, держа́вꙋ же: ймѣщаго посрамилъ єси Хрте, на́га ѡбнищавша показалъ єси Бжественным си воста́нїемъ.
items.english_text: Having announced peace by Thy Cross, Thou didst proclaim remission unto captives, O my Savior; and Thou didst put to shame him who held dominion, O Christ, showing him naked and destitute by Thy Divine rising.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Проше́нїа вѣрно просѧщимъ, всепѣ́тая, непризри, но прїими, й сїѧ доношай Снꙋ своемꙋ Пречтаѧ, Бгꙋ единомꙋ блгодателю, тебе бо престателницꙋ стѧжахомъ.
items.english_text: Despise not the petitions of those who ask in faith, O All-Hymned Lady, but receive them and bring them unto thy Son, O Most Pure Lady, the only Benefactor God; for we have acquired thee as our mediatress.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ Богатство й глꙋбина премꙋдрости Бжїа: ѡвсѧлаѧ препрыѧ Гдь, ѿ коварства тѣ́хъ избавилъ є́стъ насъ, пострадавъ бо волею, немощїю плотскою: свое́го крѣпостїю ѡ́живил а мертвца воскре́слъ є́стъ.
items.english_text: O the depth of the riches and wisdom of God! The Lord, surpassing all things, delivered us from their craftiness; for having suffered of His own will in the weakness of the flesh, by His own might He gave life, and rose as dead.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Бгъ сый, соединя́ется плоти насъ ради: й распина́ется, й оу́мираетъ, й погребенъ бываетъ: й паки въскреса́етъ: й восходитъ свѣ́тло...
items.english_text: Being God, He is united unto flesh for our sake, is crucified, dies, is buried, rises again, and ascends brightly in His flesh, Christ unto the Father, with Which He will come and save those who have piously served Him. (fol. 14)[^27]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: свѣ́тло съ плотїю своею, Хс къ Оцꙋ, сънеюже прїидетъ, йспасетъ, блгочестно томꙋ послꙋжившихъ.
items.english_text: Holy of holies, O Pure Virgin, thou didst bear the Holy of holies, Christ the Redeemer, Who sanctifies all; therefore we proclaim thee Queen and Sovereign Lady of all, as the Mother of the Creator of creatures.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Стыхъ стаѧ Дво чтаѧ: стыхъ стаго родила єси всѣхъ ѡсщяющаго, Хрта Избавителѧ, тѣ́мже тѧ Црицꙋ й Влдычицꙋ всѣхъ, ꙗко Мтръ зиждителѧ тварей проповѣ́дꙋемъ.
items.english_text: The heavenly Hosts are glad, beholding thee; and with them the assemblies of mankind rejoice; they are joined together through thy childbearing, O Virgin Mother of God, which we worthily glorify.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Веселят꙽ся нбнаѧ Силы, зрѧще тѧ, радꙋютжеся сни́ми члч҃каѧ съставленїа, Рождествомъ твоимъ совокꙋпишася, Дво Бце, є́же достойно славимъ.
items.english_text: Let every human tongue and thought be moved to the praise of the truly human adornment; for the Virgin has come, clearly glorifying those who hymn her marvels in faith.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Да дви́жется всѧкъ ꙗзыкъ члч҃кїй й мысль, къ похвалѣ члвчкаго коистиннꙋ оудобренїа, Двлѧ бо прїиде ꙗвственнѣ славѧщи: вѣрою тоѧ воспѣва́ющихъ чꙋдеса.
items.english_text: Glorified is the song and praise of the all-wise offered unto the Virgin and Mother of God; for she was the temple of the most blessed glory, which we worthily glorify.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [люди] люди твоѧ Бже нашъ, ты бо крѣпостїи немощны[х].
items.english_text: The lowest abyss has encompassed us, and there is none to deliver; we were accounted as sheep for the slaughter; save Thy people, O our God; for Thou art the strength of the weak.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣшенїемъ первозданнаго Гди, лютѣ оуꙗꙁвихомся, раною же йсцѣлихомся твоею, єюже заны оуꙗзвленъ бысть Хрте, ты бо крѣпость немощнымъ й йсправленіе.
items.english_text: Through the sin of the first-formed man, O Lord, we were grievously wounded; but we were healed by Thy wound, whereby Thou wast wounded for our sake, O Christ; for Thou art the strength and restoration of the weak.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Возвелъ єси иꙁ Ада Гди, Кита оу́вывъ всеаднаго всесилне своею державою, ниꙁложивъ того силу, ты бо животъ єси, й свѣ́тъ й въскрнїе.
items.english_text: Thou didst bring up from Hades, O Lord, having slain the all-devouring whale by Thine all-powerful might, casting down his power; for Thou art Life and Light and Resurrection.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Веселятса ѿтебѣ Дво пречтаѧ, рода ншго праѻтци: едема воспрїемше тобою егоже преступленіемъ погꙋбиша, ты бо чтаѧ, й прежде рождества, й по рождествѣ єси.
items.english_text: The forefathers of our race rejoice in thee, O Most Pure Virgin, having received Eden again through thee, which they had lost through transgression; for thou art pure, both before childbearing and after childbearing.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Оумъ сый безстра́стенъ й невещественъ, примѣшаетса Хс Бгъ, оумꙋ члвчкомꙋ, ходотайствꙋющꙋ Бжтвеннымъ естествомъ, плоти же девствомъ, й всемꙋ мнѣ непреложенъ весма соединися: да спсенїе всемъ ми падшемъ пода распинаемь.
items.english_text: Being impassible and immaterial Mind, Christ God was joined unto human mind, mediating by the Divine nature and virginity of the flesh; and being immutable, He was wholly united unto all of me, that being crucified He might grant salvation unto all of me who was fallen.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Паде прелще́нъ бывъ Адамъ, й сокрꙋши́ся: надеждею ѡболганъ сый древле ѡбоженїа: но во[з]стаетъ соединенїемъ, Слова ѡбожа́емъ, й стр̄тїю бестра́стїе прїемлетъ, на престолѣ ꙗ́ко Снъ славимъ є́стъ, сѣдяй со Оцемъ й Дхомъ.
items.english_text: Adam was deceived and fell, and was crushed, having of old been lied to by the hope of deification; but he rises again, being deified by union with the Word, and through His Passion receives impassibility, glorified as Son upon the Throne, sitting with the Father and the Spirit.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Нѣдръ не ѿстꙋ́пль беꙁначала родителѧ, къ нѣдрѣхъ чтыѧ Ѻтроковица водворѧетса, й бываетъ, и́же прежде безматеренъ: без Ѡца воплощаемьй, и́же правдою Цртвꙋяй Бгъ, сего неродословенъ страшный родъ, й неизреченъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion (fol. 15):*[^28]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Престоѧтъ раболѣпнѣ ржтвꙋ твоемꙋ чи́ны нбныѧ: дивѧщеся достойно твоемꙋ беꙁсѣменномꙋ рождествꙋ прино Дво, ты бо чтаѧ, й преже рождества, й по рождествѣ єси.
items.english_text: Without departing from the bosom of His Unoriginate Father, He takes up His abode in the bosom of the Pure Maiden, and He Who was before without mother becomes incarnate without father, God reigning in righteousness: His awesome generation is without genealogy and ineffable.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Воплотися и́же прежде сый безплотенъ, Слово йстебе Пречтаѧ, и́же всѧческаѧ волею творѧй: и́же безтелесныхъ воинства приведый ѿ небытїа, ꙗко всесиленъ.
items.english_text: The heavenly orders stand before thy childbearing as servants, worthily marveling at thy seedless childbearing, O Ever-Virgin; for thou art pure, both before childbearing and after childbearing.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Оумерщвленъ бы врагъ живоноснымъ ти плодомъ Бгоблагодатнаѧ: й попранъ бы Адъ прокклѧтый, ииже въ оузахъ свободихомся. Тѣмже вопїю, страсти раꙁдрѣши срца моего.
items.english_text: The Word, Who was formerly bodiless, was incarnate of thee, O Most Pure Lady, He Who makes all things by His will, Who brought the incorporeal hosts from non-being, as He is all-powerful.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Воскрлъ єси ꙗко Бгъ иꙁ Гро́ба въ сла́вѣ, й мира съ воскрсилъ єси: й єстество человѣ́ческое ꙗ́ко Бга воспѣваетъ тѧ, й смерть исчезе, Адамъ же ликꙋетъ Влко, й Еѵѵа ннѣ ѿ оузъ свобождаема...
items.english_text: The enemy was slain by thy life-bearing Fruit, O Full of Divine Grace, and cursed Hades was trampled down, and we who were in bonds were set free; therefore I cry aloud: Loose the passions of my heart!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: [свобождаема] жда́ема. Ра́дуетсѧ зовꙋщи, Ты єси и́же всѣмъ подая Хрте въскрнїе.
items.english_text: As God Thou didst rise from the tomb in glory, and didst raise the world with Thyself; and human nature hymns Thee as God, and death has vanished; and Adam dances for joy, O Master, and Eve, now delivered from bonds rejoices, crying aloud: Thou art He Who grantest resurrection unto all, O Christ!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Воскршаго тридне́вно воспоемъ ꙗ́ко Бга всесилна: й вра́та Адова сокрꙋшившаго, й йже ѿвѣка иꙁ Гро́ба воздвигшаго, Мvроносицамъ ꙗ́вльшагося, ꙗ́коже блговолилъ є́стъ, и́же прежде силъ, є́же радꙋйтеся рекїи: й Апломъ ра́дость возвѣ́щаетъ, ꙗ́ко единъ жинодавецъ, тѣ́мже вѣрою жены, ѻу́ченикомъ знаменїа побѣ́ды блговѣ́ствꙋетъ, й Адъ стенетъ; й смерть рыда́ет, мїръ же веселитсѧ; й вси снимъ радꙋютсѧ, со Хр̄товѣ воскресе́ніи: Ты бо всѣ́мъ подаеши Хр̄те воскрнїе.
items.english_text: Let us hymn Him Who arose on the third day as Almighty God, Who shattered the gates of Hades, and raised from the tomb those dead from the ages, and appeared unto the Myrrh-bearing Women, even as He was well pleased, He Who first said "Rejoice!" unto the women,[^30] and proclaims joy unto the Apostles, as the only Giver of life. Therefore with faith the women announce the tokens of victory unto the Disciples, and Hades groans, and death laments, and the world is glad, and all rejoice together with them in the Resurrection of Christ: For Thou, O Christ, grantest resurrection unto all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Тебе мысленную Бце пе́щъ разумѣваемъ вѣрнии, ꙗ́коже бо ѿроки сплъ єстъ три, превозносимый: всего мѧ члвка, въ чревѣ ти ѡбновилъ є́стъ, хвалимый ѿце́мъ Бгъ й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: We, the faithful, understand thee to be a mystical furnace, O Mother of God; for even as the Exalted One saved the three youths, He renewed all of me, man, in thy womb, the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceedingly glorified.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Убояся землѧ, сокры́ся слнце, й померче свѣтъ, раздрася Црковнаѧ Бж́твеннаѧ Катапета́сма: каменїа же распадашася: на Кртѣ бо висить првеникъ, хвалимый ѿце́мъ Бгъ й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: The earth was afraid, the sun hid itself, and the light grew dark; the divine veil of the Temple was rent in twain, and the rocks were split; for the Righteous One hung upon the Cross: the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceedingly glorified.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ты бысть ꙗ́ки безпо́мощенъ: й оуꙗ́звленъ въ мертвыхъ, волею насъ ради, превозносимый всѧ свободилъ єси: й державною рꙋко́ю съвоскрсилъ єси, хвалимый ѿце Бгъ, й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion (fol. 16):*[^29]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋ́чкꙋ златꙋ пречтꙋю, Трапе́зꙋ Бжтвеннаго хлѣ́ба жизни, йменꙋемъ тѧ чтаѧ, мѣ́сто сщ҃енїа, пртолъ высокъ, на немже Бгъ почилъ є́стъ, прехвалный, й превозносимый въ вѣки.
items.english_text: Thou didst become as one helpless, and wast wounded among the dead of Thine own will for our sake, O Exalted One; Thou didst free all, and by Thy mighty hand didst raise them with Thyself: the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceedingly glorified.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Древле оу́бо проклѧта бысть Землѧ, Авелевою ѡчервленившися кровїю, брато оубійственною рꙋкою, Бготочною же твоею Кровїю, блгословися, ѡкропле́нна: й грающи вопїетъ, ѿцъ нашихъ Бже благословенъ єси.
items.english_text: We name thee the all-pure Golden Jar, the Table of the Divine Bread of life, O Pure Lady, the place of sanctification, the exalted Throne whereon God has rested, Who is all-praised and exalted unto the ages.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Да рыда́ютъ Їюдейстїи Бгопротивнїи Людїе, дерзости оубіенїа Хва, ꙗзыци же да веселѧтся, й рꙋкама давосплещꙋтъ, й да вопїютъ: Оцъ нашихъ Бже блгословенъ єси.
items.english_text: Of old the earth was cursed, having been stained with the blood of Abel by a brother-slaying hand; but sprinkled with Thy God-shed Blood, it is blessed, and dancing it cries aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Се Мvроносицамъ ѡблистаѧй, вопїяше Агглъ, воскрнїа Хва, прте й видите Знаменїа, Плащеницꙋ й Гробъ, й возопїите, Оцъ нашихъ Бже...
items.english_text: Let the Jewish God-opposing people weep for the daring murder of Christ; but let the nations be glad, and let them clap their hands and cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: На кртѣ пригвождься волею насъ ради члѣколюбче, й праѻтца Адама рукописаніе растерзалъ єси. Тѣмже вси снимъ непрестанно поемъ, ѿцъ нашихъ Бже блгвенъ єси.
items.english_text: Behold, shining upon the Myrrh-bearing Women, the Angel cried aloud of the Resurrection of Christ: Come and see the signs, the Plashchanytsia and the Tomb, and cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers! blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Та Бце лѣствица, Їаковъ Пррчески разумѣваетъ: тобою бо превозносимый, на земли ѧвися, й съчлвки поживе, ꙗко блгоизволи хвалимый, ѿцемъ Бгъ, й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Being nailed of Thine own will unto the Tree of the Cross for our sake, O Lover of mankind, Thou didst tear up the handwriting of forefather Adam; therefore with him we all unceasingly sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Радуйся чтаѧ, истебе пройде пастыръ, йже въ Адамову кожу ѡболкъся воистиннꙋ: въ всего мя члвка, за милосердїе непостыдное, хвалимый ѿцемъ Бгъ й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos (Theotokos): We, the faithful, understand thee to be a mystical furnace...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Радуйся источниче прно живыя воды, радуйся раю пищный: радуйся стѣно вѣрныхъ, радуйся неискусобрачная, радуйся всемирная радости, єѧже ради намъ воси[я] хвалимый ѿцемъ Бгъ й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Jacob prophetically perceived thee to be the Ladder, O Mother of God; for through thee the Exalted One appeared upon earth and lived among men, as He was well pleased: the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceedingly glorified.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .и҃. Ірмо́съ:* Въ пещи дѣти Їилеви, ꙗкоже въ горнилѣ, добро[тою...]
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Pure Lady! From thee came forth the Shepherd, Who truly clothed Himself in Adam's skin: into all of me, man, for His blameless compassion: the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceedingly glorified.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: добротою бл́гочестїа чистѣйше злата, блищахуся глюще, Блгословѣте вся дѣла Гдня Гда поите, й превозносите его въвѣки.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O fountain of ever-living water! Rejoice, delight-filled paradise! Rejoice, wall of the faithful! Rejoice, unwedded one! Rejoice, joy of all the world, for whose sake the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceedingly glorified shone forth upon us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Иже волею вся твора, й претворяяйже, ѡбращая сѣнь смертную въ вѣчную жизнь, стр̄тїю твоею Слове Бжїй, тебе непрестанно вся дѣла ꙗко Бга поем, й превозноси къ вся вѣки.
items.english_text: In the furnace the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone with the beauty of piety purer than gold (fol. 17),[^31] saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exceedingly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Ты разорилъ єси сокрушеніе Хрте, й шкалянство, въ вратѣхъ й твердынѣхъ Адовыхъ, воскресъ йз гроба тридневенъ, тебе непрестанно вся дѣла ꙗко Бга пою, й превозносятъ къ вся вѣки.
items.english_text: O Word of God, Who by Thy will dost make and transform all things, turning the shadow of death into life eternal by Thy Passion: unto Thee all works unceasingly sing as God, and exceedingly exalt Thee unto all ages.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1
items.slavonic_text: Иже безсѣмене й паче естества ѡблистаніа, Бжтвеннаго рождьшю бисера многоцѣннаго Ха, воспоемъ глюще, блгвите вся дѣла Гдня Гда поите й пре[во]носите его въ вся вѣки.
