items.english_text: Light shone forth unto my life and flesh, and the burden of sin was loosed, when the Most High was incarnate of the Virgin without seed at the end of times.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: В безднѣ грѣховнѣ ѡдержаимъ, неизслѣдимую млрдїа твоего призываю бездну: ѿ тла Боже мой возведи мя.
items.english_text: Held fast in the abyss of sins, I call upon the unsearchable abyss of Thy compassions: from corruption, O my God, raise me up!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗко злодѣй Првникъ ѡсꙋдися, й съ безаконными на древѣ пригвождаетсѧ, повиннымъ ѡпущеніе: своего даруѧ Кровїю.
items.english_text: As a malefactor the Righteous One was condemned, and was nailed unto the Tree with the lawless, granting remission unto the guilty through His own Blood.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Единаго ради оубо члвка перваго Адама, древле въ мїръ вниде смерть, й единаго ради Сна Бжїа, ꙗвися воскрнїе.
items.english_text: For the sake of one man, the first Adam, death entered the world of old; and for the sake of the one Son of God, the Resurrection hath appeared.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Неискусомужно Дво родила еси: й вѣчнꙋеши Двою ꙗвльшися: йстинными бжества Сна й Бга твоего ѡбразы.
items.english_text: Without knowing man, O Virgin, thou didst give birth, and thou remainest eternally a Virgin, being shown forth as true images of the Godhead of thy Son and God.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Гласъ глаголъ молбы, ѿ болѣзненныя влко дꙋша оуслышавъ, ѿ лютыхъ мя йзбави, единъ бо еси нашему спасенію виновенъ.
items.english_text: Having heard the voice of the words of supplication from a suffering soul, O Master, deliver me from grievous things; for Thou alone art the Cause of our salvation.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Блюстителя положилъ еси падшему херувима, древа животнаго, но видѣвше тя двери ѿверзошася, ꙗвибося путь твора разбойнику къ раи.
items.english_text: Thou didst place a Cherub to guard the Tree of life from the fallen; but beholding Thee, the gates opened, and a way was revealed leading the thief unto Paradise.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙋстъ адъ й йспроверженъ бысть, смертїю единаго, є́же бо многое богатство всебѣ собра: единъ ѿ всѣхъ на Хртосъ йстощилъ естъ.
items.english_text: Hades was emptied and overthrown by the death of the One; for the great riches which it gathered into itself, Christ, the One above all, emptied.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Естество члвческое работающєе грѣхꙋ, влчице чтаѧ, тобою свободꙋ оулꙋчи, твой бо Снъ, ꙗко Агнецъ, за всѣхъ заклается.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos (Theotokos):* (fol. 32)[^50]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Вопїетъ ти вси йстиннѣй Бгоматери, прогнѣвавшая рабы йзбави: едина бо дерзновенїе къ Снꙋ ймаши.
items.english_text: Human nature, which was enslaved unto sin, O Pure Sovereign Lady, through thee hath obtained freedom; for thy Son, as a Lamb, is slain for all.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Воскрлъ еси ѿ Гроба всесилне Спсе, й Адъ видѣ чꙋдо сїе, оужасеся, й мертвїи восташа, тварь же видящи, радуется тебѣ, й Адамъ въ кꙋпѣ веселится; й мїръ Спсе мой воспѣваетъ тя присно.
items.english_text: All men cry aloud unto thee, the true Mother of God: Deliver Thy servants who have provoked anger; for thou alone hast boldness before thy Son!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ты еси свѣтъ ѡмраченнымъ, ты еси воскрнїе всѣхъ, й животъ члвкомъ, й всѣхъ съ собою воскрсилъ еси, смртную державꙋ спсе разоръ, й Адовы врата сокрушилъ еси слове, й мертвїи оузрѣвше чꙋдо сїе оудивишася, й вся тварь кꙋпно сорадꙋется ѡ въскрнїи твоемъ, члвколюбче. Тѣмже й вси славимъ; й въспѣваемъ твое съхожденїе, й миръ спасе мои въспѣваетъ тя присно.
items.english_text: Thou didst arise from the tomb, O Almighty Savior, and Hades, beholding this wonder, was terrified, and the dead arose; and creation, seeing it, rejoices with Thee, and Adam is glad together; and my world, O Savior, hymns Thee ever.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ты еси свѣтъ ѡмраченнымъ, ты еси воскрнїе всѣхъ, й животъ члвкомъ, й всѣхъ съ собою воскрсилъ еси, смртную державꙋ спсе разоръ, й Адовы врата сокрушилъ еси слове, й мертвїи оузрѣвше чꙋдо сїе оудивишася, й вся тварь кꙋпно сорадꙋется ѡ въскрнїи твоемъ, члвколюбче. Тѣмже й вси славимъ; й въспѣваемъ твое съхожденїе, й миръ спасе мои въспѣваетъ тя присно.
items.english_text: Thou art the Light of the darkened, Thou art the Resurrection of all, and Life unto men; and Thou didst raise all with Thyself, having overthrown the dominion of death, O Savior, and shattered the gates of Hades, O Word; and the dead, beholding this wonder, were amazed, and all creation rejoices together at Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind. Therefore we all glorify and hymn Thy descent, and my world, O Savior, hymns Thee ever.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Богопротивное велѣніе законопреступнаго мꙋчителя, высокъ пламень вознесло естъ. Хртосъже прострѣтъ, бгочтивымъ дѣтемъ, хладъ духовный: сый блгвенъ, й препрославленный Бгъ ѿцъ наших.
items.english_text: The godless decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame; but Christ spread a spiritual dew for the pious children: blessed and exceedingly glorified is He, the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Нетерпяше влко зрѣти, грѣхомъ смертнымъ члвка мꙋчима: но пришедше йсилъ своею кровїю, члвкъ бывъ, сый блгословенъ, й препрославленъ Бгъ Ѻцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: The Master endured not to see man tormented by mortal sin; but having come and become man, He healed him with His Blood: blessed and exceedingly glorified is He, the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Видѣвше тя Хрте, ѡблеченна въ ѡдеждꙋ ѿмщенїа: оужасошася вратници Адовы, безꙋмнаго бо мꙋчителя раба, како пришелъ еси оубити, сый блгословенъ, й препрославленъ Бгъ Ѻцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee clothed in the garments of vengeance, O Christ, the gatekeepers of Hades were terrified; for [they saw] how Thou didst come to slay the servant of the foolish tyrant: blessed and exceedingly glorified is He, the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Стыхъ стѣишꙋю разумѣемъ, ꙗко единꙋ рож[д]шую Бга непремѣннаго, Дво нескверная, Мти безневѣстная: всѣмъ бо вѣрнымъ йсточила еси нетлѣніе, бжтвенны[мъ] ржтвомъ си.
items.english_text: We understand thee to be holier than the holy, as having alone given birth unto the immutable God, O Undefiled Virgin, Unwedded Mother; for unto all the faithful thou didst pour forth incorruption through thy divine childbearing.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Ірмосъ. [Вѣтїя ꙗвишася ѿроци...]:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos (Cross-Resurrection): The children were shown forth as orators...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡсꙋди Праѡтца древле, є́же въ едемѣ преслꙋшаніе: но волею сꙋдиля бысть, престꙋпающымъ раздрѣшая прегрѣшенїа, пребжтвенный ѿцемъ Бгъ й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Disobedience in Eden condemned the forefather of old; but He was willingly judged, loosing the transgressions of the transgressors: the Supremely Divine God of our fathers, and exceedingly glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Спаслъ еси оуязвеннаго ꙗзыкомъ, завистїю члвко-
items.english_text: Thou didst save him who was wounded by the tongue through the envy of the manslayer (fol. 33),[^51] bitten in Eden by voluntary bites; for by Thy voluntary Passion Thou didst heal him: the Supremely Divine God of our fathers, and exceedingly glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: члвкоꙋбїйца, въ едемѣ волнылъ оугрызенїемъ, волною бо стр̄тїю йсцѣлилъ еси. Пребжтвенный ѿцемъ Бгъ и препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst call me who walked in the shadow of death unto light, having encompassed dark Hades with the radiance of Godhead: the Supremely Divine God of our fathers, and exceedingly glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ходяща мя въ сѣни смертнѣй призвалъ еси къ свѣтꙋ, темнозрачный Адъ блистанїемъ ѡбложекъ Бжтва. Пребжтвенный Ѻцемъ Бгъ й препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Jacob beheld in the night, as in an enigma, God incarnate; and He appeared from thee in brightness unto those who sing: The Supremely Divine God of our fathers, and exceedingly glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Зраше въ нощи оубо, Іаковъ, ꙗко въ гаданїй Бга воплощенна: йстебеже свѣтлостїю ꙗвися, поющимъ: Пребжтвенный Ѻцемъ Бгъ и препрославленъ.
items.english_text: The signs in thee showed forth the ineffable union: He wrestled with Jacob, wherewith He was willingly united unto men, O Pure Lady: the Supremely Divine God of our fathers, and exceedingly glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Знаменїа ꙗже в тебѣ, неизреченнаго продавала снятїа, съ Іаковомъ борется: ймже волею совокуписа члвкомъ чтаѧ, пребжственныи ѻцемъ Бгъ и препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Abominable is he who does not proclaim Thee, the One Son of the Virgin, of the All-Hymned Trinity, with unhesitating faith and with the tongue crying aloud: The Supremely Divine God of our fathers, and exceedingly glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: ...вѣрныяже прохлаждающи, й поющїй. Блгословите вся дѣла Гдня Гда.
items.english_text: The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its action by divine command, burning the Chaldeans cooling the faithful who sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Кровїю твоею Хрте, ѡчервленно плоти твоея зряще ѡдѣянїе, трепетомъ дивляхуся, многамъ ти долготерпѣнїю, Агглстїи чины, зовꙋще: Блгвите вся дѣла Гдня Гда.
items.english_text: Beholding the garment of Thy flesh crimsoned with Thy Blood, O Christ, the angelic ranks marveled with trembling at Thy great longsuffering, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ты мое мертвенное ѡдѣялъ еси щедре, въ безсмертїе въстанїемъ си, тѣмже веселѧщеся блгодарственно воспѣваютъ ти избраннїи людїе твои Хрте, зовꙋще тебѣ: пожерта бысть смерть побѣдою.
items.english_text: By Thy rising Thou didst clothe my mortality in immortality, O Merciful One; therefore Thy chosen people, rejoicing, thankfully sing unto Thee, O Christ, crying unto Thee: Death is swallowed up in victory!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ты и́же Ѻцꙋ неразлꙋчнаго, въ оутробѣ безсѣмене заченши, й бгомужно поживша, неизреченно породила еси Бгородителнице Пречтая, тѣмже тя спнїе всѣмъ намъ воспѣваемъ.
items.english_text: Having conceived in thy womb without seed Him Who is inseparable from the Father, and having lived as God-man, thou didst ineffably give birth unto Him, O Most Pure Mother of God; therefore we sing of thee as salvation unto us all.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Видѣнъ бывъ на Кртѣ пригвождаемъ, и́же богатый въ млти: волею же погребеся, й тридневно воскрсе, й избавилъ еси вся земныя члколюбче, вѣрою поющыя: да поетъ Гда вся тварь, й превозноситъ его въвѣки.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos (Cross-Resurrection): Unto the golden body they did not bow...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Избавити ѿ истлѣнїя, сошедъ въ преисподняя
items.english_text: He Who is rich in mercy was seen nailed unto the Cross, and was willingly buried, and arose on the third day; and Thou didst deliver all earthly beings, O Lover of mankind, who sing with faith: Let every creature sing to the Lord, and exceedingly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: слове Бжїй, єгоже создалъ еси Хрте силою твоею бжественною, й безистлѣнїа сотворъ, славы прносꙋщныя твоея, причастника содѣла, да поетъ, возывающи, Гда вся тварь, й превозноситъ его къ вѣки.
items.english_text: Descending into the nethermost parts to deliver from corruption him whom Thou didst create by Thy divine power, O Christ, Word of God (fol. 34),[^52] and having made him free from corruption, Thou didst make him a partaker of Thine ever-existing glory: that every creature, crying aloud, may sing to the Lord and exceedingly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Видѣнъ бысть на земли тобою, й съ члвки поживе, є́же блгтїю неизреченный й силою, емꙋже поемъ вси вѣрнїи, зовꙋще: ѡсꙋщественнаѧ, да поетъ Гда вся тварь, й превозноситъ его къ вѣки.
items.english_text: Through thee He was seen upon earth and lived among men, Who is ineffable in grace and power; unto Whom all of us, the faithful, sing, crying aloud: Let hypostatized creation sing to the Lord, and exceedingly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Воистиннъ тя чтаѧ, проповѣдꙋющїе славимъ Бцꙋ: ты бо единаго породила еси ѿ Трца воплощенна, ємꙋже съ Ѻцемъ й Дхомъ вси поемъ: да поетъ Гда вся тварь, й превозноситъ его къ вѣки.
items.english_text: Proclaiming thee in truth as the Mother of God, O Pure Lady, we glorify thee; for thou didst bear the One of the Trinity incarnate, unto Whom with the Father and the Spirit we all sing: Let every creature sing to the Lord, and exceedingly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Безначална Родителя, Снъ Бгъ й Гдь, воплощься ѿ Двы намъ ꙗвися, ѡмрачныѧ просвѣтити, йсобрати расточеннаѧ, тѣмже всепѣтꙋю Бцꙋ величаемъ.
items.english_text: The Son of the Unoriginate Begetter, God and Lord, incarnate of the Virgin, hath appeared unto us, to illuminate the darkened and to gather together the scattered: therefore we magnify the All-Hymned Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: ...ственнаго, ребра твоѧ Хртӕ напаяемо, животъ намъ прозябло естъ.
items.english_text: As planted in Paradise on Cranium, O Savior, the thrice-rich Tree of Thy Most Pure Cross, watered with the divine water and Blood as from a divine fountain, Thy side, O Christ, being watered, hath sprouted forth life unto us.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Низложи силныя распныйся, ꙗко всесиленъ, и́еже низꙋ лежащее въ Адовѣй твердыни, естество члчкое вознесъ, й на Ѻчїимъ посади пртолѣ, снимже тебѣ грѧдꙋщу, покланяющеся тя величаемъ.
items.english_text: Being crucified as Almighty, Thou didst cast down the mighty; and having raised up human nature lying below in the stronghold of Hades, Thou didst seat it upon the Father's Throne: therefore, worshipping Thee Who comest with it, we magnify Thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Единицꙋ тричисленнꙋю, Трцꙋ єдиносꙋщную православно поюще вѣрнїи, славимъ, непресѣкомо пребжтвенное естество: трїсвѣтлую невечернюю Зарю, единый нетлѣнный свѣтъ намъ возсїявшꙋю.
items.english_text: Singing in orthodox manner, we, the faithful, glorify the Tri-numbered Monad, the Consubstantial Trinity, the undivided, Supremely Divine Nature: the Tri-radiant, unwaning Dawn, which hath shone forth upon us as the One Incorruptible Light.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: ...есь еси желанїе, весь сладость, Слове Бжїй, Двыа Сне, Бже Богомъ Гди, стыхъ пртый, тѣмже тя вси съ рождшею величаемъ.
items.english_text: Thou art all desire, Thou art all sweetness, O Word of God, Son of the Virgin, God of gods, Holy Lord of saints; therefore we all magnify Thee together with her who bore Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Колѣна нбныхъ прекланяются Іисе, й земныхъ, ꙗко Зиждителю, й преисподнихъ ꙗко Бгꙋ распеншуся плотїю, й ꙗзыкъ всякъ Бгословующе величаетъ тя.
items.english_text: The knees of those in heaven, and on earth, and under the earth bend before Jesus: as unto the Creator, and as unto God Who was crucified in the flesh; and every tongue, theologizing, magnifies Thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкоже йз рукꙋ йсхитилъ еси Адовыхъ керыхъ [крѣпкихъ] связанныхъ влко дша, й нынѣ насъ йзбави насилныѧ мучителевы рꙋки, да тя вси йзбавляеми величаемъ.
items.english_text: Even as Thou didst snatch from the hands of Hades the bound souls of the mighty, O Master, so now deliver us from the violent hand of the tormentor, that, being delivered, we all may magnify Thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Жезлъ крѣпости дастся естеству тлѣнному, Слово Бжїе въ чревѣ ти чтаѧ, й сїе воставиши, до ада поползшееся, тѣмже тя всечистая, ꙗко Бцꙋ величаемъ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos (Theotokos):* (fol. 35)[^53]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Юже йзволилъ еси влко, прїими милостивнѣ молбꙋ, Мтре твоеѧ ѡ насъ, й твоеѧ блгти, всяческая йсполнятся, да тя вси ꙗко блгодателя величаемъ.
items.english_text: A rod of strength was given unto corruptible nature, the Word of God in thy womb, O Pure Lady, and Thou didst raise up that which had slipped down unto Hades; therefore we magnify thee, O All-Pure Lady, as Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: На Хвалитехъ стїхиры. Самогласны, Гласъ .в.:
items.english_text: Accept mercifully the supplication of Thy Mother for our sake, which Thou didst desire, O Master; and let all things be filled with Thy goodness, that we all may magnify Thee as Benefactor.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Всякое дыханїе й вся тварь, тебе славитъ Гди, ꙗко Кртомъ смерть оупразднилъ еси: да покажеши людемъ є́же йз мертвых твое въскрнїе, ꙗко единъ члколюбецъ.
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera. Samoglasny, Tone 2:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Да рекꙋтъ Іоудеи, како воины погубыша стрегꙋщей Црѧ, почто бо камень не сохрани Камене жизни, йли погребеннаго дадѧ: йли воскршему да поклонятся, глюще снами: слава множествꙋ щедротъ твоихъ, Спасе нашъ слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: Let every breath and every creature glorify Thee, O Lord, for through the Cross Thou didst abolish death: that Thou mightest show forth unto the peoples Thy Resurrection from the dead, as the only Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Радуйтеся людїе, й веселитеся; Агглъ сѣдя на Камени гробнѣмъ, той намъ блговѣсти рекъ: Хртосъ воскрсе йз мртвыхъ Спсъ мїро-
items.english_text: Let the Jews say how the soldiers lost the King Whom they were guarding: why did the stone not preserve the Rock of life? Either let them give up Him Who was buried, or let them worship Him Who is risen, saying with us: Glory to the multitude of Thy compassions; our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: ...ви: й йсполни всяческая блгоуханїа, Радꙋйтеся людїе й веселитеся.
items.english_text: Rejoice, ye peoples, and be glad! An Angel sitting upon the stone of the tomb, he proclaimed the glad tidings unto us, saying: Christ the Savior of the world is risen from the dead and filled all things with fragrance: Rejoice, ye peoples, and be glad!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Агглъ оубо є́же радꙋйся: прежде твоего зачатїа Гди, блгтнѣй принесе: Агглъ же камень славнаго Гроба твоего, въ твое въскрнїе ѡвали, ѡвъ оубо въ печали мѣсто веселїа ѡбразы возвѣщаѧ, сей же въ смерти мѣсто, влку жизнодавца проповѣда намъ. Тѣмже вопїем ти, Блгтелю всѣхъ Гди, слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: An Angel indeed brought "Rejoice!" unto the Full of Grace before Thy conception, O Lord; and an Angel also rolled away the stone of Thy glorious tomb at Thy Resurrection: the former declaring emblems of joy instead of sorrow, and the latter proclaiming unto us the Master, the Giver of life, instead of death. Therefore we cry unto Thee, O Benefactor of all, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Возлїяша Мѵро съ слезами на Гробъ твой жены: й йсполнишася радостїю, оуста йхъ внегда глаголати ймъ, въскресе Гдь.
items.english_text: The women poured out myrrh with tears upon Thy tomb, and their mouths were filled with joy when they said: The Lord is risen!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Да похвалятъ ꙗзици й людїе Хрта Бга нашего, волею насъ ради Распятїе претерпѣвша, й въ адѣ тридневновавша: й да поклонятся єго тридневному йз мертвыхъ воскресенїю: ймже просвѣтишася всего мїра концы.
items.english_text: Let the nations and peoples praise Christ our God, Who willingly endured the Crucifixion for our sake and remained three days in Hades; and let them worship His three-day Resurrection from the dead, whereby the ends of the whole world were enlightened.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Распятъ быстъ й погребеся Хрте, ꙗкоже йзволи, плѣнилъ еси смерть, й воскрсе въ славѣ, ꙗко Бгъ й Влка, дарꙋѧ мїрови жизнь вѣчную,
items.english_text: Thou wast crucified and buried, O Christ, as Thou didst will; Thou didst despoil death and arise in glory as God and Master, granting unto the world eternal life (fol. 36)[^54] and great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Воистинну законопрестꙋпный запечатлѣвше камень, болшаго насъ чꙋдесе сподобисте, ймꙋтъ разумъ стражїе, днесь пройде йз Гроба, й глаголахꙋ: рцѣте ꙗко намъ спѧщым; прїидоша оучници й оукрадоша єго, й кто крадетъ мертвца, най пачеже й нага: той воскресе самовластно ꙗко Бгъ: ѡставль въ Гробѣ й погрѣбателная своѧ, Прїидѣте видите Іоудеи: како неразори печати: ймже смерть попра, й родꙋ члчкомꙋ безконечную жизнь дарова й велїю млть.
items.english_text: Truly, O lawless ones, by sealing the stone ye deemed us worthy of a greater miracle: the guards have knowledge of it; today He came forth from the tomb, and they said: Say that while we slept the disciples came and stole Him away. But who steals a dead body, especially one that is naked? He arose by His own power as God, leaving His burial wrappings in the tomb. Come and see, ye Jews, how He did not break the seals: He Who trampled down death and granted unending life and great mercy unto the human race!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: [Г]ласъ ти приносимъ Разбойничъ, й молимся: Помяни мя Гди въ Цртвїи си.
items.english_text: We bring unto Thee the voice of the thief, and we pray: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Кртъ твой приносимъ въ прощенїе согрѣшенїемъ: єгоже насъ ради прїятъ члвколюбче.
items.english_text: We bring Thy Cross for the forgiveness of sins, which Thou didst accept for our sake, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Смртїю твоею Гди, оумертвилъ еси смрт[ь]: своимъ же воскресенїемъ Спасе мой мир[ъ] просвѣтилъ еси.
items.english_text: We worship Thy burial and arising, O Master, through which Thou didst deliver from corruption and the world, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроносица срѣтъ, воскрсъ ѿ Гроба: и оученикомъ возвѣстити рекъ твое востанїе.
items.english_text: By Thy death, O Lord, Thou didst put death to death; and by Thy Resurrection, O my Savior, Thou hast enlightened the world.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Икоже ѿ Гроба воскрсивъ Адама преблагїй, сице ꙗко Бгъ древомъ миръ спаслъ еси.
items.english_text: Meeting the myrrh-bearing women when Thou didst arise from the tomb, Thou didst bid them proclaim Thine arising unto the disciples.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻца прославимъ, Сну поклонимся, и Дху Стаго, вси вѣрныи воспоимъ.
items.english_text: Even as Thou didst raise Adam from the tomb, O Exceedingly Good One, so, as God, by the Tree Thou didst save the world.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: Радуйся Престоле ѡгнезрачный, радуйся Мати неискусомужная, радуйся Дво, ꙗже Бга члвкомъ рождшїа.
items.english_text: Let us glorify the Father, let us worship the Son, and let all of us, the faithful, hymn the Holy Spirit.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 2. Troparion: When Thou didst descend... Glory... Another. Both now. Theotokion: All beyond comprehension... Podoben.* (fol. 27),[^44]
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ СꙋББОТꙋ ВЕЧЕРЪ НА ВЕЛИЦЕ ВЕЧЕРИ НА ГДИ ВОЗВА СТРЫ. ГЛАСЪ .Г.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Fiery-Throne; rejoice, O Mother unwedded; rejoice, O Virgin who didst bear God unto men!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Твоимъ Кртомъ Хрте Спасе, смрти держава разрушися: и дїавола лесть оупразднися. родъ же члчкїй вѣрою спсаемъ, пѣснь ти всегда приноситъ.
items.english_text: *On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣтишася всяческая, воскрнїемъ твоим[ъ] Гди, и Рай паки ѡтверзеся. всяже тваръ восхваляющи тя, пѣснь ти всегда приноситъ.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, the dominion of death was overthrown and the deception of the devil was brought to naught; and the human race, being saved by faith, ever brings a hymn unto Thee.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Славлю Ѻца, и Сна силу, и стаго Дха пою влчество: нераздѣлно и несозданно Бжество, Трцу единосꙋщную, Цртвꙋющую въ вѣки вѣкомъ.
items.english_text: All things were enlightened by Thy Resurrection, O Lord, and Paradise was opened once again; and all creation, praising Thee, ever brings a song unto Thee.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Крту твоему чтному, покланяемся Хрте: и воскрнїе твое, поемъ и славимъ: раною бо твоею мы вси йсцѣлихомъ.
items.english_text: I glorify the power of the Father and of the Son, and I hymn the sovereignty of the Holy Spirit: undivided, uncreated Godhead, Consubstantial Trinity, reigning unto ages of ages.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Крту твоему чтному, покланяемся Хрте: и воскрнїе твое, поемъ и славимъ: раною бо твоею мы вси йсцѣлихомъ.
items.english_text: We worship Thy precious Cross, O Christ, and we hymn and glorify Thy Resurrection; for by Thy wound we all were healed.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Поемъ спса, йже ѿ Двы воплощшагося: насъ ради распятъ ся, и третїй день воскресе, дарꙋѧ намъ велїю милость.
items.english_text: We hymn the Savior Who was incarnate of the Virgin; for our sake He was crucified, and on the third day He arose, granting us great mercy.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋщымъ въ адѣ, сошедъ Хртосъ блговѣсти, дерзайте глаголя, нынѣ побѣдихъ. азъ есмь воскрнїе: азъ вы возвождꙋ, разоръ смертныѧ врата.
items.english_text: Having descended unto those in Hades, Christ proclaimed glad tidings, saying: Take courage; now have I conquered! I am the Resurrection; I lead you forth, having shattered the gates of death.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Иже недостойнѣ стояще, въ пречтнѣмъ домꙋ твоемъ, вечернее пѣнїе возсылаемъ: йз глубины въ зывающе Хрте Бже, просвѣтивый мира тридневнымъ воскрнїемъ своимъ: йзми люди твоя йзруки врагъ, члколюбче.
items.english_text: Standing unworthily in Thy most honorable house, we send up an evening hymn, crying out from the depth, O Christ God, Who hast enlightened the world by Thy three-day Resurrection: snatch Thy people from the hand of the enemies, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Како не дивимся [недибимся], Бгомужному ржтвꙋ ти пречтаѧ: йскушенїа бо мужеска непрїемши, всенепорочнаѧ, родила еси бе Ѻца, Сна плотїю: йже прежде вѣкъ ѿ Ѻца рожденнаго, бе Матере. никакоже претерпѣвши йзмѣненїа, или смѣшенїа, или раздѣленїа: но ѡбоихъ сꙋщество свойство, цѣло сохранша. тѣмже Мати Дво вл꙯дчце, того моли спастися дшамъ нашимъ, православно Бцꙋ йсповѣдающихъ тя.
items.english_text: How should we not marvel at thy theandric childbearing, O Most Pure Lady? For without having accepted the trial of man, O All-Blameless One, thou didst give birth in the flesh without a father unto the Son Who was born without a mother of the Father before the ages, in no way undergoing change, or confusion, or division, but preserving intact the property of each nature. Therefore, O Virgin Mother, Sovereign Lady, entreat Him that our souls may be saved, who in orthodox manner confess thee to be the Mother of God.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: На Стихѡвнѣ Стры воскресны, Гласъ .г.:
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 3:* (fol. 38)[^56]

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Стр̄тїю твоею Хрте, ѡмрачивый слнце; й свѣтомъ твоего воскрнїа, просвѣтивый всяческая, прїими нашу вечернюю пѣснь, человѣколюбче.
items.english_text: O Christ, Who by Thy Passion didst darken the sun, and by the light of Thy Resurrection didst enlighten all things: accept our evening hymn, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Стихъ: Гдь воцрися, въ лѣпоту ѡблечеся:
items.english_text: Thy life-giving arising, O Lord, enlightened the whole universe, and summoned His corrupted creation. Therefore, being delivered from the curse of Adam, we all cry aloud: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Жизноподателное ти востанїе Гди, вселенную всю просвѣти, и свое созданіе истлѣвшее призва. тѣмже клятвы Адамовы вси йзмѣнишеся вопїем: всесилне Гди слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: Being God unchangeable, suffering in the flesh Thou wast changed; Whom creation, not enduring to behold hanging, was bowed down with fear, and groaning, it hymned Thy long-suffering. Having descended into Hades, Thou didst arise on the third day, granting life unto the world and great mercy.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Стихъ: Ибо оутверди вселенную, ꙗже неподвижится:
items.english_text: That Thou mightest deliver our race from death, O Christ, Thou didst endure death; and having arisen on the third day from the dead, Thou didst raise up with Thyself those who acknowledge Thee as God; and Thou didst enlighten the world: Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Безсѣмени ѿ Бжтвеннаго Дха, совѣтомъ же Ѻчимъ, зачала еси Сна Бжїа: ѿ Ѻца бе Матере, прежде вѣкъ сꙋща, насъ ради, и стебе без Ѻца бывша, плотїю родила еси, й младенца млекомъ питала еси, тѣмже непрестай молящи, йзбавитися ѿ бѣдъ душамъ нашимъ.
items.english_text: Without seed from the Divine Spirit, and by the Father's good pleasure, thou didst conceive the Son of God, Who was of the Father without a mother before the ages; for our sake and of thee, having come to be without a father, thou didst bear Him in the flesh, and thou didst nourish the Infant with milk. Therefore cease not to pray that our souls may be delivered from tribulations.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Нынѣ ѿпꙋщаеши. Святый Боже. По Ѻтче нашъ:
items.english_text: *Now Thou dismissest. Holy God. After Our Father:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Да веселятся небеснаѧ, и да радують ся земнаѧ: ꙗко сотвори державꙋ мышцею своею Гдь, поправъ смртїю смерть, первенецъ из мертвыхъ бысть, истреба Адова избавилъ естъ насъ, и подастъ мирови велїю милость.
items.english_text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earthly rejoice; for the Lord hath wrought might with His arm: He trampled down death by death, He became the Firstborn of the dead, He delivered us from the belly of Hades, and granted great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: [Т]ебе йсходотаившую спасенїе родꙋ нашему воспѣваемъ Бце Дво, плотїю бо истебе прїятою, Снъ твой и Бгъ нашъ, Кртнꙋю прїемъ страсть: йзбавилъ естъ насъ, и з йстлѣнїа, ꙗко человѣколюбецъ.
items.english_text: Thee, who didst mediate the salvation of our race, we hymn, O Virgin Mother of God; for having accepted the Passion of the Cross in the flesh taken from thee, Thy Son and our God delivered us from corruption, as Lover of mankind.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Канѡнъ на полꙋнощници, Троиченъ. Пѣснь .а҃. Гласъ .г. Ірмо́съ:
items.english_text: *At the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy Trinity. Ode 1, Tone 3. Heirmos: He Who of old by divine beckoning...* (fol. 39)[^57]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Иже воды древле, манїемъ Бжтвенны[мъ].
items.english_text: Incomprehensible, Sole Sovereign, and One Tri-hypostatic Godhead: deem me worthy of Thy Tri-radiant Light, that I may hymn Thee Who art unceasingly sung with thrice-holy hymns by angelic mouths!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Непостижимаѧ едина Гдоначалнаѧ, и едино Трчкое Бгоначалїе, трїсїяннаго свѣта мя твоего сподоби: ꙗко да воспою тя, пѣваемую непрестанно, три стыми пѣсньми, Агглкими оусты.
items.english_text: All the immaterial ranks sacredly sing of Thee as the sole Tri-radiant Creative Cause, the Supreme Light; Which human multitudes also harmoniously sing of, and faithfully glorify with earthen mouths.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Священно невещественнїи вси чинове поютъ, ꙗко Творческую винꙋ единственную трисвѣтлꙋю, началнѣйшїй свѣтъ, юже согласно поютъ, и человѣческая множества вѣрно славимъ бренными оусты.
items.english_text: The theologians fittingly and compositely call Thee Father, and Word, and Spirit: designating the Son impassibly from the Unbegotten Father, and together the procession of the Divine Spirit, O God, Sole Sovereign over all!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: ...щество, прїемъ Бжїи слове: Трчный косїалъ еси единоначалнѣйшій свѣтъ, единаго Бжтва препрославленну всѣмъ показавъ. рождшꙋю тя Двꙋ Пречистую.
items.english_text: As Lover of mankind by nature, taking human substance having assumed human nature, O Divine Word, Thou didst shine forth as the Tri-hypostatic, Supreme-Sovereign Light, having shown forth the undivided Godhead, exceedingly glorified unto all, through the Pure Virgin who bore Thee.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Иже ѿ несꙋщихъ вся приведъ словомъ, оустроити древле водꙋ, повелѣвъ Ілїа, на полѣнахъ: ѡбразно прояви всѣмъ Трочный съставъ, Единственнаго Бжїа Гдоначалїа.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who brought all things out of nothing...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣнное естество поетъ тя Зелнородныхъ единаго й трисвѣтлаго создателя неизмѣннаго, и вопїю ти блко, всякагомя напраснаго ства избави, и спси мя.
items.english_text: Bidding Elijah of old to arrange the water upon the logs, He figuratively revealed unto all the Tri-hypostatic constitution of the Sole Godhead's Dominion.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗвно вѣщающе словесемъ Пррческимъ: премудрыхъ Аплъ же и проповѣдникъ вѣрѣ; равнодѣтелную тя Трцу славословимъ вѣрныи Бже всѣхъ.
items.english_text: The corruptible nature of earth-born mortals hymns Thee, the One and Tri-radiant, unchangeable Creator; and I cry unto Thee, O Master: Deliver me from every sudden destruction, and save me!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: С Престола высокаго сниде слово: члвка вышшаѧ, ꙗко члколюбецъ. тобою Пречтаѧ. и трїсолнечный свѣтъ всѣмъ восїа.
items.english_text: Clearly proclaiming through prophetic words, and through the all-wise Apostles, preachers of the faith: we, the faithful, glorify Thee, the Equally-Effective Trinity, O God of all!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Трце нераздѣлнаѧ, и неразлꙋчнаѧ, насъ помилуй...
items.english_text: From the high Throne the Word came down to make man higher, as Lover of mankind, through thee, O Most Pure Lady; and the Tri-solar Light shone forth upon all.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: ...милуй покланяющихся ти ся, и воспѣвающихъ блгочестно, и зовꙋщїй, непрестанно тебѣ, спси ихъже собрала еси млрдїа ради мати, въ цркви стѣй твоей: еже славити державꙋ твою. ибо ꙗко милостивъ, вѣси срца нашего немощъ.
items.english_text: O Undivided and Inseparable Trinity, have mercy upon us who worship Thee, and who piously hymn and unceasingly call upon Thee: save those whom Thou hast gathered together in Thy holy Church because of mercy, O Mother, to glorify Thy dominion; for as Thou art merciful, Thou knowest the weakness of our heart (fol. 40).[^58]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Весь йзмѣнихся невоздержаніемъ моимъ, и безстрашіемъ моимъ несмысленный, нечувствїа ѡкаꙗнный: нетрепещу дне, егоже трепещꙋтъ вся видимаѧ и невидимаѧ. Блчнице помози ми: й срчное разори недоꙋмѣніе, сама бо еси оупованіе й предстателница рабомъ твоимъ.
items.english_text: I am completely changed through mine intemperance, and through my fearlessness, foolish, senseless, accursed in lack of feeling: I tremble not before the day at which all things visible and invisible tremble. O Lady, help me and destroy the perplexity of my heart; for thou thyself art the hope and protectress unto thy servants!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡтраслъ сꙋгꙋбъ ѿ Ѻца, ꙗко ѿ корене прозябе, Снъ и Дхъ правїи, соестественна прозябенїа, й бгосажденна и цвѣти собезначалны, ꙗко трїехъ быти свѣтила Бжтва.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou hast set firm love toward us: the...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Соборы оумныхъ сꙋществъ, непрестанно поютъ тя, недовѣдомаго Бга, съ нимиже и мы славимъ глюще: Трце пресꙋщнаѧ, своя...
items.english_text: A two-fold branch sprang forth from the Father as from a root: the upright Son and the Spirit, consubstantial offshoots, divinely planted and co-unoriginate flowers, so that the Godhead is of Three Lights.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: ...своя рабы спаси, ꙗко члѣкколюбецъ.
items.english_text: The assemblies of the noetic beings unceasingly hymn Thee, the Inscrutable God; with whom we also glorify Thee, saying: O Supremely Essential Trinity, save Thy servants, as Lover of mankind!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Воспалилъ еси насъ въ любовъ твою многомилостиве слове Бжїи, йже насъ ради воплощся, непреложнѣ, и трїсвѣтлое едино Божество, таинно сказавъ тѣмже тя славимъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst inflame us with Thy love, O Abundantly Merciful Word of God, Who for our sake wast incarnate without change, and mystically didst declare the Tri-radiant One Godhead; therefore we glorify Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Единаго Гдоначалника, ѡбразно ꙗко видѣ Исаїа Бга: въ трїехъ лицехъ славословима, пречтыми гласы, Серафїмъ посланъ быстъ проповѣдати а́бїе трисвѣтлое сꙋщество, и единицꙋ трисолнечную.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: As Isaiah figuratively beheld upon a throne...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Иже всѣхъ невидимыхъ и видимыхъ естество, ѿнесꙋщихъ прежде составльшіа, единице трїслнечнаѧ, иже единаго тя Бга вѣрно воспѣвающїй: ѿвсякихъ искушенїи йзбавиши: твоей славѣ сподоби.
items.english_text: As Isaiah figuratively beheld God, the One Sovereign, glorified in Three Persons with most honorable voices, a Seraph was straightway sent to proclaim the Tri-radiant Essence and the Tri-solar Monad.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Невѣстникъ свѣтоносенъ и чтъ Дво, бывшій Бгꙋ, въспѣваем та любовію, и блажимъ; й стебе бо родися Хртосъ, въ сꙋществахъ двꙋхъ хотѣніяхъ сꙋгꙋбыхъ, йже единый ѿ Трца и славѣ сый Гдь.
items.english_text: O Tri-solar Monad, Who didst establish the nature of all things invisible and visible out of non-being before: deliver from all temptations those who faithfully hymn Thee as the One God, and deem them worthy of Thy glory!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Преселникъ сый Авраамъ: сподобися ѡбразно воспрїяти, въ ѡбразѣ оубо Гда: въ трїехъ составѣхъ, пресꙋщественна, мужескими же зраки.
items.english_text: Having become the light-bearing and honorable bridal-chamber unto God, O Virgin, we hymn thee with love and bless thee; for of thee Christ was born in two natures, with dual wills, Who is One of the Trinity and the Lord existing in glory!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Направи срдца своихъ рабъ, къ свѣту непристꙋпномꙋ, ѡ Трїслнечне Гди, и твоеѧ слави сїянїе, подаждь дшамъ нашимъ: въ еже ѡблистаемомъ быти твоею добротою неизреченною.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: The uttermost abyss of sins hath encompassed me...* (fol. 41)[^59]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡверзи мнѣ двери свѣта, рождшагося ѿ оутробы твоеѧ Пречтаѧ, да зрю трисвѣтлꙋю лꙋчю Бжтва, и славлю тя всесвѣтлꙋю владычицꙋ.
items.english_text: Being a sojourner, Abraham was deemed worthy to receive figuratively, in the likeness of the Lord, the Supremely Essential One in Three Hypostases, under the forms of men.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Егда прїидеши влко на Землю, сꙋдити всѣмъ, ихже ѿземля создалъ еси, по своему ѡбразꙋ, ѡущедри ꙗко млтикъ, и йзбави всѣхъ сꙋда твоего првнаго, и не посли насъ въ ѻгнь геенскїй, ꙗко Единъ Хрте многомилостивъ.
items.english_text: Direct the hearts of Thy servants unto the Unapproachable Light, O Tri-solar Lord, and grant the radiance of Thy glory unto our souls, that we may be illumined by Thine ineffable beauty!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Егда прїидеши влко на Землю, сꙋдити всѣмъ, ихже ѿземля создалъ еси, по своему ѡбразꙋ, ѡущедри ꙗко млтикъ, и йзбави всѣхъ сꙋда твоего првнаго, и не посли насъ въ ѻгнь геенскїй, ꙗко Единъ Хрте многомилостивъ.
items.english_text: Open unto me the gates of the Light Who was born of thy womb, O Most Pure Lady, that I may behold the Tri-radiant beam of the Godhead, and glorify thee, the All-Radiant Lady!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Егда прїидеши влко на Землю, сꙋдити всѣмъ, ихже ѿземля создалъ еси, по своему ѡбразꙋ, ѡущедри ꙗко млтикъ, и йзбави всѣхъ сꙋда твоего првнаго, и не посли насъ въ ѻгнь геенскїй, ꙗко Единъ Хрте многомилостивъ.
items.english_text: When Thou comest, O Master, upon the earth to judge all whom Thou didst fashion from the earth according to Thine image: have compassion as Merciful One, and deliver all from Thy righteous judgment, and send us not into the fire of Gehenna, as Thou alone art Christ, the Abundantly Merciful!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: ...Стенаніе ми дарꙋй, ꙗкоже Мытареви Дво, и блꙋдници слезы, да тебѣ сїа приношаѧ, йззовꙋ: Помилуй мя всемлтивая, и сокрꙋши недоꙋмѣніе мое блтьтїю си: й ѡумиленїа тучю ми подающи: ктебѣ бо прибѣгохъ Пречтаѧ.
items.english_text: Groaning Grant me groaning, O Virgin, even as unto the Publican, and tears like the harlot, that offering these unto thee I may cry aloud: Have mercy on me, O All-Merciful Lady, and destroy my perplexity by thy grace, pouring down upon me a rain of compunction; for unto thee have I fled, O Most Pure Lady!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкоже древле блгочестивыѧ три [отроки].
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: As of old Thou didst bedew the three...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Храмъ мя покажи твоего Бжтва блко, трїсїяннаго, всего свѣтлаго: грѣховнаго ѡмраченїа лютаго, и страстей вышша! свѣтодателными твоими сїяніи, Бже Ѻцъ нашихъ Блгословенъ еси.
items.english_text: Show me forth as a temple of Thy Tri-radiant, all-luminous Godhead, O Master, higher than grievous sinful darkness and passions! By Thy light-giving radiances: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Бжтва твоего зракъ единъ взвѣщаемъ, въ Трїехъ съставныхъ й раздѣлныхъ свойствахъ: Ѻца, и Сна, и Дха, Блгвенъ еси зовꙋще, Бже ѻцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: We proclaim one appearance of Thy Godhead in Three Hypostatic and distinct properties: Father, Son, and Spirit, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗвися Аврааму Бгъ въ трїехъ съставѣхъ, оу дуба древле Мамврїйскаго: ѡстраннолюбїю мздꙋ Ісаака воздая за милость, егоже и нынѣ славимъ, ꙗко Бга Ѻцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: God appeared unto Abraham in three hypostases of old by the Oak of Mamre, granting Isaac as reward for hospitality through mercy; Whom we also now glorify as the God of our fathers.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗвися на земли, бывъ члккъ вседѣтель...
items.english_text: The Creator appeared on earth, having become man in God-befitting manner from thy virginal and most pure womb, and He renewed us: O blessed, most pure Mother of God, All-Pure Lady! (fol. 42)[^60]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: ...Бголѣпно ѿ Двчкїя й прчтыя ти оутробы: и насъ ѡбнови: Блгвеннаѧ пречистаѧ Бце Пречтаѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Gathered together in the unenduring fire, yet unharmed...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Безначална Ѻца, ꙗко ѿ корене Слово, и Дхъ собеначалнѣ по естествꙋ сꙋща, ꙗко ѿрасли пресꙋщественнаго Бгоначалїа, показаша Трци славꙋ единꙋ и силꙋ: юже поемъ вси вѣрнїи в вѣки:
items.english_text: From the Unoriginate Father, as from a root, the Word and the Spirit, co-unoriginate existing by nature, as offshoots of the Supremely Essential Godhead, showed forth the one glory and power of the Trinity; Which all of us, the faithful, hymn unto the ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Оуправляеши твоими свѣтлостми, чины нбныѧ, воспѣвати немолчно, трїстыми пѣснми бжественными: Ѻтче, Слове съ ѡбразне, и Дше, трїсвѣтлꙋю державꙋ, и равномощнꙋю, тѣмже тя поемъ въ вѣки.
items.english_text: By Thy splendors Thou directest the heavenly ranks to hymn unceasingly with thrice-holy divine songs: O Father, Word of the same form, and Spirit, the Tri-radiant and equally-potent dominion; therefore we hymn Thee unto the ages.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Изреченїа [Ирреченїа] Пррческаѧ, твое ржтво йздалеча видѣвше Бце, восхваляхꙋ, ꙗко безсѣмени, и паче естества рожшатося, Блчце й согласно сего поем, ꙗко Ца, и превозноси въ вся вѣки.
items.english_text: Beholding thy childbearing from afar, the prophetic utterances praised it, O Mother of God, as having been born without seed and beyond nature, O Lady; and harmoniously we hymn Him as King, and exceedingly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Видѣти славꙋ трїсїяннꙋю; бговиднїи безплотныхъ чинове ꙗвѣ: невещественными крилы...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A new wonder and God-befitting: for through the...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: ...дити желаютъ горѣ: но покрꙋютъ зѣло прѣнепристꙋпнымъ свѣтомъ, и пѣнїе непрестанно вопїютъ, съ сими согласно Единственная Трце тя славимъ.
items.english_text: Manifestly desiring to behold the Tri-radiant glory, the God-beholding ranks of the bodiless hosts with immaterial wings desire to ascend on high; but they veil themselves exceedingly with the unapproachable Light, and unceasingly cry out a hymn; with them harmoniously, O Sole Trinity, we glorify Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Несытною любовію йже на земли. ѻумнꙋю дꙋшꙋ ѿтебе прїимше, и словесную: тебе поемъ ꙗко. Бже вседержителю, единственное естество воистинну, и Трчное лицы ѿвсего срца. тѣмже щедре, ꙗко многомилостивъ ѡущедри насъ.
items.english_text: With insatiable love, we who are upon earth, having received from Thee a noetic and rational soul, hymn Thee as God the Almighty, the Sole Essence in truth, and Tri-hypostatic Persons from the whole heart; therefore, O Compassionate One, as Abundantly Merciful, have compassion upon us!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: Храмъ мя покажи, единоначалнаго, и трисвѣтлаго твоего Бгоначалїа, свѣтовиденъ: чистѣ слꙋжити тебѣ зиждителю, всѣхъ: и неизреченную ти славꙋ оумно зрѣти: млтвами единыя Бца, юже достойно преславнꙋю величаемъ:
items.english_text: Show me forth as a light-bearing temple of Thy Sole Sovereign and Tri-radiant Godhead: cleanly to serve Thee, the Creator of all, and noetically to behold Thine ineffable glory, through the prayers of the only Mother of God, whom worthily, as exceedingly glorious, we magnify!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 3)
items.slavonic_text: По семъ поемъ: Достойно есть. [Конецъ]
items.english_text: *After this we sing: It is truly meet. [End of Midnight Office]*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: В Неделю на Оутрени, по Бгъ Гдь: на 8: Гласъ 3. Тропарь: Да веселятся небесная (см. выше). Слава, и нынѣ. Богородиченъ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Хр̄тосъ ѿ мертвыхъ воста, начатокъ оумершымъ: первенецъ твари и содѣтель всѣмъ бывшимъ, й стлѣвшее естество рода нашего, собою ѡбнови, нектомꙋ смерти ѡбладаеши, ибо всѣхъ влка, державꙋ твою раздрꙋши.
items.english_text: *After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* (fol. 43)[^61]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Неизмѣннаго Бжтва, и волныя стр̄ти твоея Гди: оужасъся Адъ въ себѣ рыдаше глаголя: трепещꙋ плоти нетлѣннаго состава: виждꙋ невидимаго, таинно борꙋща мя: тѣмъ же и ихже держꙋ, вопїютъ: слава Хрте воскрнїю твоемꙋ.
items.english_text: Christ is risen from the dead, the First-fruits of those who have fallen asleep: the Firstborn of creation and the Maker of all things that have come to be; and He renewed in Himself the corrupted nature of our race. No longer dost thou have dominion, O death; for the Master of all hath overthrown thy power!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Небесная [Нбная] любовію веселяхуся, и земная трепетомъ оужасахуся. егда пречистый гласъ найде на тя Бце: едино бо торжество ѡбоимъ восїа: егда безплотный радость тебѣ принесе. тѣмже съ Аггломъ вопїем ти: Радꙋйся чтаѧ Бжїе жилище.
items.english_text: Adoring the unchangeable Godhead and Thy voluntary Passion, O Lord, Hades, terrified within himself, lamented, saying: I tremble at the flesh of incorruptible structure; I behold the Invisible One mystically warring against me! Therefore those whom I hold also cry aloud: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: По .в. Стїхословїи Сѣдаленъ, Гласъ .г.:
items.english_text: The heavenly beings rejoiced with love, and the earthly were terrified with trembling, when the most pure voice came upon thee, O Mother of God; for one triumph shone forth upon both when the Bodiless One brought joy unto thee. Therefore with the Angel we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Pure Lady, Dwelling-place of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Плотію смерть въкꙋшъ Гди. горесть смертную пресѣче востанїемъ своимъ. и члка паки оукрѣпи, первыя клятвы ѡдолѣніе...
items.english_text: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: ...призываѧ. Защитниче жизни нашеѧ Хрте Бже слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: Having tasted death in the flesh, O Lord, by His arising He cut short the bitterness of death, and strengthened man again, recalling the overcoming of the first curse O Defender of our life, Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Непостижимое распятїе, и несказанное въстанїе бгословимъ вѣрнїи, неизреченное таинство. Днесь бо смерть и Адъ плѣненъ бысть. родъ же члчкїй въ нетлѣніе ѡблечеся. тѣмже и блгрно вопїемъ: слава Хрте въскрнїю твоему.
items.english_text: We, the faithful, praise the incomprehensible Crucifixion and ineffable Resurrection, an unutterable mystery; for today death and Hades were despoiled, and the human race was robed in incorruption. Therefore also thankfully we cry aloud: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Непостижимаго и неѡписаннаго, единосꙋщнаго Ѻцꙋ и Дхови. въ оутробꙋ свою таинно въмѣстила еси Бце. едино и неслисно ѿ Трца Бжтво. познахомъ ржтво твое въ мїрѣ славити. тѣмже и блгодарственно вопїемъ ти. Радуйся блгодатная.
items.english_text: The Incomprehensible and Uncircumscribed One, consubstantial with the Father and the Spirit, thou didst mystically contain within thy womb, O Mother of God; we have come to know one and unconfused Godhead of the Trinity, to glorify thy childbearing in the world. Therefore also thankfully we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Full of Grace!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Оудивляѧ видѣніемъ, ѡрошаѧ гланїи; блистаѧся Агглъ, мѵроносицамъ глаше: что живаго йщете въ Гробѣ, воста йстощивый Гробы. тли премѣнителѧ разꙋмѣйте непремѣннаго. рцыте Бгови: коль страшна дѣла твоѧ, ꙗко родъ спаслъ еси человѣческїй:
items.english_text: Astonishing by his appearance, refreshing with words, the shining Angel said unto the myrrh-bearing women: Why seek ye the Living One in the tomb? He is risen, Who emptied the tombs! Understand the unchangeable Changer of corruption; say unto God: How awesome are Thy deeds, for Thou hast saved the human race!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Плѣнь Сїѡнь, ты йзѧтъ ѿ вавѵлона, й мене ѿстрастей къ животꙋ привлеци слове.
items.english_text: *Antiphon 1, Tone 3:* (fol. 44)[^62]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: В югъ сѣющїи слезами Бжтвенными, жнꙋтъ класы радостїю приноживотныя.
items.english_text: Thou didst deliver the captivity of Zion from Babylon; draw me also from passions unto life, O Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Стомꙋ Дхꙋ всяко блгодареніе. ꙗкоже Ѻцꙋ и Снꙋ. со ѡблистаетъ. ѡнемъ же всяческая живꙋтъ й движатся.
items.english_text: They that sow in the South with divine tears shall reap sheaves of ever-living joy.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Аще не Гдь созиждетъ домъ добродѣтелей, въ сꙋе трꙋждаемся. дꙋшꙋ же покрывающе, никтоже нашъ разоритъ градъ.
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit belongs every thanksgiving: even as unto the Father and the Son, He co-shines; in Him all things live and move.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Плода чревнаго, Дхомъ снотворени ти сꙋть Хр̄тꙋ, ꙗкоже и Ѻцꙋ, стїи всегда.
items.english_text: Unless the Lord build the house of virtues, in vain do we labor; and if He protect the soul, no one shall overthrow our city.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Стымъ Дхомъ, провидится всяка стыня, премꙋдрость. ѡсꙋществꙋетъ бо всяку тварь, томꙋ послꙋжимъ: Бгъ бо, ꙗкоже Ѻцꙋ й словꙋ.
items.english_text: Through the Spirit, the saints are ever adopted sons of the fruit of the womb unto Thee, O Christ, even as unto the Father.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Боящїися Гда блаженніи. въ путь ходяще Заповѣдей снѣдятъ бо животъ дающее всяко плодіе.
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit all holiness and wisdom are foreseen; for He gives essence unto every creature. Let us serve Him, for He is God, even as the Father and the Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Боящїися Гда блаженніи. въ путь ходяще Заповѣдей снѣдятъ бо животъ дающее всяко плодіе.
items.english_text: Blessed are they that fear the Lord, walking in the way of the commandments; for they shall eat of all the fruit that gives life.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡкрестъ трапезы твоеѧ, возвеселися, зря твоѧ Пастыремъ началнице исчадїа: носяща вѣтвы блгодѣянїа.
items.english_text: Be glad around thy table, beholding thy offspring bearing branches of good deeds unto the Chief Shepherd!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Стымъ Дхомъ, всяко богатство славы, ѿнегоже блгть и животъ всякой твари, со Ѻцемъ бо воспѣваемъ е́, и со словомъ.
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit comes every richness of glory; from Him is grace and life unto every creature; for He is hymned together with the Father and with the Word.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Рцѣте въ ꙗзицѣхъ, ꙗко Гдь въцрися. ибо исправи вселенную, ꙗже неподвижится.
items.english_text: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigns; for He hath established the world, which shall not be moved.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Всякое дыханїе да хвали Гда. Стихъ: Хвалите Бга во святыхъ Его.
items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord. Verse: Praise God in His saints.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Еѵаггелїе воскресно оутренее. Воскресенїе Христово видѣвше.
items.english_text: *Sunday Matins Gospel. Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Иже воды древле, манїемъ Бжтвенны, въ едино сонмище съвокꙋпивый, и раздѣливый море; Їильскимъ людемъ, сеи Бгъ нашъ. препрославленъ естъ. томꙋ единомꙋ воспоимъ, ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 1, Tone 3. Heirmos: He Who of old by divine beckoning gathered the waters into one gathering...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Иже землю ѡсꙋдивъ, престꙋпльшему потомъ йзнести плода тернїе: ѿтернїа же вѣнецъ йзрꙋки законопрестꙋпныхъ. сеи Бгъ нашъ, плотїю прїялъ естъ. клятвꙋ разрѣшилъ естъ. ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: He Who of old by divine beckoning gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, exceedingly glorified; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Побѣдитель и ѡдолѣтель смерти, йже смерти оубояся. ꙗвися, страстную бо плоть; ѡдꙋшевленную прїимъ: сеи Бгъ нашъ. й брався съ мꙋчителемъ: вся съвоскресивъ, ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: He Who condemned the earth, unto the transgressor afterward to bring forth the fruit of thorns: this is our God, Who received in the flesh a crown of thorns from the hands of the lawless; He dissolved the curse, for He hath been glorified! (fol. 45)[^63]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Истинную Бцꙋ вси ꙗзыци славятъ тя; ꙗже без сѣмени рожшꙋю. сошедъ бо въ оутробꙋ ѡсщтенную твою, сей Бгъ нашъ. йже понасъ ѡсꙋществовася, Бгъ же й члвкъ йстебе родися.
items.english_text: The Victor and Vanquisher of death, having appeared as One Who feared death; for having assumed animate, passible flesh, this is our God; and having wrestled with the tormentor, He resurrected all with Himself, for He hath been glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Другїи Канонъ, Кртовоскресный. Гласъ .г. Ірмос: той же:
items.english_text: All nations glorify thee as the true Mother of God, who didst bear without seed; for having descended into thy sanctified womb, this is our God, Who was substantialized for our sake, and was born of thee as God and Man!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь новꙋ воспоимъ людїе Бгꙋ сотворшему: родъ человѣчъ порабощенъ. мꙋчителемъ грѣхолюбнымъ. Кровїю Бжественною Хр̄тосъ йскꙋпи. и ѡбготворивъ ѡбновилъ естъ ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection. Tone 3. Heirmos: The same:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗко оубо смертенъ, смрти хотяй, йже живота сокровище, Хртосъ вкꙋси: ꙗко безсмертенъ сый естествомъ, мертвыя ѡживотворилъ естъ. ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: Let us, the people, sing a new song unto God Who wrought: the human race, enslaved by the sin-loving tormentor, Christ redeemed with His Divine Blood, and having deified it, He renewed it, for He hath been glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канонъ, Престѣи Бци. Ірмос: [тойже]
items.english_text: Even as mortal, Christ willed to taste of death, He Who is the Treasury of life; and being immortal by nature, He brought the dead to life, for He hath been glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канонъ, Престѣи Бци. Ірмос: [тойже]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos: [The same]*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Колѣна прекланяетъ всяко естество нбныхъ Дво, воплощшемуся истебе. съ земными же достолѣпно преисподняя. ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: Every nature of heavenly beings bends the knee unto Him Who was incarnate of thee, O Virgin, and together with earthly beings, fittingly those under the earth, for He hath been glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ примиренїи ꙗже к тебѣ: блгихъ бо независтный податель, ꙗко Бгъ: Дхъ Бжтвенный подавый намъ. плоть ѿтебе ѻтроковице прїятъ. ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: At the reconciliation that was toward thee: for as God, the begrudgeless Giver of good things, having given the Divine Spirit unto us, He assumed flesh of thee, O Maiden, for He hath been glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Иже ѿ несꙋщихъ, вся приведыи словомъ: созидаемая и совершаема Дхомъ. Вседержителю Блко, вълюбви своей оутверди мене.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who brought all things out of nothing...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Кртомъ твоимъ постыдѣся нечестивый, сотворилъ бо естъ ꙗмꙋ юже йскопа, впадеся. смиренным же воздвиже Хрте рогъ, въсвоемъ въскрнїи.
items.english_text: He Who brought all things out of non-being by the Word, which are fashioned and perfected by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Бгочтїа проповѣданіе ꙗзыкомъ; ꙗко вода покри море члколюбче. въскрст бо ѿ Гроба, Трческїи ѡкрылъ еси свѣтъ.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross the ungodly one was put to shame; for having made a pit which he dug, he fell into it; but in Thine arising, O Christ, Thou didst raise the horn of the humble.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Преславная глана быша, ѿтебѣ граде ѡдꙋшевленный, прно цртвꙋющаго: тобою бо Блчце сꙋщимъ на земли. Бгъ съпожилъ естъ.
items.english_text: The proclamation of godliness unto the nations covered the sea like water, O Lover of mankind; for having arisen from the tomb, Thou didst reveal the Tri-hypostatic Light!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: выхъ сокрꙋшилъ еси вражїи. щитъ стерлъ еси крѣпостїю блко Хрте. оутвержденіе наше: Стъ еси Гди.
items.english_text: Glorious things were spoken of thee, O animate City of Him Who reigns ever; for through thee, O Lady, God dwelt with those on earth!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Чистота пречтый Крте, Ідолскимъ ꙗвися ты нечистотамъ: ꙗко Іисъ пребжественный на тебѣ рꙋцѣ распростерлъ естъ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]:* (fol. 46)[^64]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Да вси вѣрнїи, живодателный Гробе тебѣ покланяемся: погребе бо ся въ тебѣ, и воста Хс. воистинну Бгъ нашъ.
items.english_text: ...Thou didst crush the [strength] of the enemies; the shield Thou didst wipe away by Thy might, O Master Christ, our confirmation: Holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after "God is the Lord": on 8: Tone 3. Troparion: Let the heavens be glad... (see above). Glory, both now. Theotokion.
