items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Согрѣшихъ, но ѿ тебе не ѿступих ѡкаянный оущедри мя трїсоставне, едино Бжство чтное, и лютагомѧ избави ѡсꙋженїа молбами Бгоѿроковица.
items.english_text: I have sinned, yet I have not departed from Thee, wretched one that I am; have compassion upon me, O Tri-hypostatic, one, honorable Godhead, and deliver me from grievous condemnation through the entreaties of the Maiden of God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Непостижимый Бже, и неприступный: иже единъ естествомъ, Благъ же, и млрдъ: Ѻч҃е, и Сне, и Дше пртый, соблюди и ѡсти, иже вѣрою вопіющихъ въ цркви стѣи твоей: в нощи, и къ дни: и непредаждь како, врагомъ ищущимъ нашея погибели.
items.english_text: O incomprehensible and unapproachable God, Who art one in Nature, good and merciful: Father, and Son, and Holy Spirit! Preserve and sanctify those who cry out with faith in Thine holy church by night and by day, and deliver us not in any way unto the enemies who seek our destruction!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Непремолчимъ прно Дво, блгрно воспѣвати...
items.english_text: We shall never cease, O Ever-Virgin, gratefully to hymn [^77] from the heart, we thy servants, thy mercies, O Sovereign Lady, calling out and saying: O Most Holy Virgin, go before us, and deliver us from invisible enemies, and from perils, and from every threatening; for thou art our Protection!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: ...ѿ срдца рабы твои, твоя млти Влчице зовуще и глюще: престаѧ Дво, предвари: и избави ѿ врагъ невидимыхъ, и бѣдъ, и всякаго прещенїа, ты бо еси наше Заступленіе.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the fiery furnace the Persian children of...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Въ пещи Авраамскїя, си дѣти персидстїи.
items.english_text: Imitating the heavenly natures established in rank, and the noetic orders, all we earthborn of the Orthodox glorify one Godhead in three Hypostases equal in action.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Въ чинъ поставленнымъ нбнымъ естества, и оумнымъ чиномъ, православныхъ вси земнороднїи подражающе: славимъ, едино Бжтво въ трїехъ равнодѣтелны съставѣхъ.
items.english_text: The eyes of the holy Prophets of old figuratively made Thee known as the only Creator of all the ages, the ineffable God and Lord, in three God-originating Hypostases.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡчи стыхъ Пррокъ, тя древле ѡбразно; единаго вѣкомъ всѣмъ творителна, проявиша, неизреченнаго Бга и Гда, Бгоначалными треми состави.
items.english_text: The Word, invisible by essence and all-effecting, Thou didst appear unto men, becoming man from the pure Mother of God, calling man unto communion with Thy Godhead.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Иже посꙋществу невидимое слово, и вседѣтелное, ꙗвился еси члвкомъ, члкъ ѿ чтыя Бгоматере: члвка призывая къ причастію твоего Бжтва.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Daniel, stretching forth his hands, [stopped] the gaping mouths of the lions...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋцѣ распростеръ Данїилъ, лвова зїаніа...
items.english_text: O unique and tri-radiant Light, unoriginate Essence, unfathomable Beauty: make Thine abode in my heart, and a radiant temple of Thy Godhead show me forth radiant and pure, as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him supremely unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: From my diverse passions, O indivisible Trinity, unconfused Unity, and from the darkening of transgressions deliver me, and illumine me with Thy divine rays, that I may reflect Thy glory and hymn Thee, the Lord of glory!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: The Father is indeed the unbegotten Mind, and the Word is of like form, and the Spirit is co-enthroned; one Essence, Power, and Existence: O super-essential, ineffable, majestic Trinity and Unity, preserve Thy flock by the intercessions of the Mother of God, as the only Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Let all earthborn leap for joy...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Unto Thee now I move all my heart and mind, and the intentions of my whole soul and body, unto my Creator and Redeemer, O tri-radiant Monarchy; and I cry unto Thee: Save me, Thy servant, from perils and all afflictions!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Lift up our mind and thought unto Thee on high; illumine us with Thine immaculate splendors, O Father, Word, and Comforter, Who dwellest in light unapproachable [^78] O Sun of glory and Holder of light, that we may ever glorify Thee, the one Principle, the Tri-hypostatic God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of the most honorable Gregory; the fourth song [Tone 4], the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Save those who believe in Thee, O Lord, and who proclaim the unoriginate, co-everlasting one Essence, and the three God-originating, conformed Persons of Thy Lordship, and make them worthy of divine glory, by the entreaties of the pure Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.*

items.english_text: *After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymn of the Resurrection, Tone 4:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Gazing upon the entrance of the tomb, and not enduring the angelic flame, the Myrrh-bearing women marvelled with trembling, saying: Has He been stolen away, Who opened Paradise unto the thief? Or is He risen, Who even before His Passion proclaimed His arising? Truly Christ is risen, granting life and resurrection unto those in Hades!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Thou didst arise as immortal from Hades, O Savior; Thou didst raise up Thy world from bonds; by Thy Resurrection, O Christ our God, Thou didst crush with Thy strength the dominion; Thou didst show forth the Resurrection unto all, O Merciful One; therefore we glorify Thee, O only Lover of mankind.

items.english_text: We magnify thee, O Mother of God, crying: Thou art the Mountain from which the Stone was ineffably cut without hands, and crushed the gates of Hades.

items.english_text: By Thine own free counsel Thou didst endure crucifixion, O Savior, and mortal men laid Thee in a new tomb, Who by a word didst establish the ends [of the earth]; therefore the stranger was bound, death was grievously despoiled, and all those in Hades cried out unto Thy life-bearing arising: Christ the Giver of life is risen, abiding unto the ages!

items.english_text: Gabriel descended from the heights of heaven, and approaching the stone where the Rock of life lay, appearing in radiant white, he cried unto the weeping women: Cease from the cry of lamentation, ye who possess ever tender compassion; for Whom ye seek weeping, be of good courage, for He is truly risen; therefore cry out unto the Apostles that the Lord is risen!

items.english_text: Joseph marvelled, beholding that which was beyond nature [^79] and brought to mind the rain upon the fleece, in thy seedless conception, O Mother of God; the bush unconsumed by fire, Aaron's rod that blossomed; and thy betrothed and guardian, bearing witness, cried unto the priests: A Virgin bears a Child, and after childbirth remains a Virgin still!

items.english_text: Going before, the Myrrh-bearing women proclaimed Thy glorious arising unto the Apostles, O Christ: that Thou art risen as God, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.english_text: From my youth many passions war against me; but do Thou Thyself help and save me, O my Savior.

items.english_text: Ye that hate Zion, be put to shame by the Lord; for ye shall be dried up by fire as grass.

items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit every soul is given life, and is exalted in purity; it is illumined by the Trinitarian Unity in sacred mystery.

items.english_text: I have cried unto Thee fervently, O Lord, from the depth of my soul; and let Thine ears be attentive unto me [even] Thine divine ears.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Everyone who possesses hope in the Lord is higher than all who grieve.

items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit streams of grace gush forth, watering all creation unto life.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Let my heart be lifted up unto Thee, O Word, and let nothing of the world's beauties entice me unto weakness.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: As anyone has love toward his mother, a warmer love ought we to have toward the Lord.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is the wealth of divine knowledge, contemplation, and wisdom; for in Him the Word reveals all the Father's decrees.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Arise, O Lord, help us, and deliver us for Thy name's sake!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Glory: Through the prayers of the holy Apostles... Both now: Through the prayers of the Most Pure Lady...*

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* (fol. 62)[^80]

items.english_text: Traversing the deep of the Red Sea with dryshod feet, Israel of old, by Moses' hands stretched out in the sign of the Cross, conquered the power of Amalek in the wilderness.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the immaculate Tree of the Cross, setting upright our fall, and healing ancient total destruction, O Master, for Thou art good and almighty.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: In the tomb bodily, in Hades with the soul as God, in Paradise with the thief, and on the throne wast Thou, O Christ, with the Father and the Spirit, filling all things, Thyself uncircumscribed.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Seedlessly, by the Father's will and from the Divine Spirit, having conceived the Son of God, thou didst bear Him in the flesh, Who is from the Father without mother, and for our sake from thee without father.

items.english_text: *Second Canon [Cross-Resurrection], Heirmos: I shall open my mouth...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Thou didst heal the crushing of mankind, O Lord; by Thy divine Blood Thou didst renew it, and didst crush him that was mighty in strength, who of old had crushed Thy creation.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Arising came unto the dead on account of Thy putting to death; for strength was taken away from death when it contended with eternal Life, which reigns over all in God incarnate...

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: ...Fair beyond the heavenly hosts was Thine animate divine temple, having borne in the womb, O Virgin, the holy Mountain of our God.

items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Heirmos: The captains of three ranks...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Peoples shook, nations were troubled, and mighty kingdoms bowed down, O Pure One, from the fear of thy childbearing; for my King came, cast down the tormentor, and delivered the world from corruption.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Showing forth His dwelling on high, coming down unto men, O Christ, Thou didst sanctify and reveal it unshakable; for she alone after childbirth preserved the virginal vessel, having borne the Creator.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Thy Church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying: Thou art my strength, O Lord, my refuge and my firm support!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: The Tree of life, the noetic true Vine, hangs upon the Tree, pouring forth incorruption unto all.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: How great, how fearful! having overthrown the haughtiness of Hades, and as incorrupt God, He is now bodily risen!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Thou alone for those on earth wast shown to be the Mediatress of supernatural goods, O Mother of God; therefore we bring unto thee "Rejoice!"

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: Establish thy singers, O Mother of God...* (fol. 63)[^81]

items.english_text: The serpent full of poison drove his teeth into me, O Savior; but Thou, O Almighty Lord, didst shatter them with the nails of Thy hands; for there is none holy among the saints save Thee, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Being willingly seen dead in the tomb, O Lover of mankind and Giver of life, Thou didst fling wide the gates of Hades unto the souls from the ages; for there is none holy among the saints save Thee, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: An unplowed furrow wast thou revealed, having brought forth the living Ear of grain that mediates immortality unto all that partake of Him Who is Holy among the saints, resting in holiness.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: He descended from on high...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: The essence of earthborn is cleansed, being joined through thee unto the unendurable Divine Fire; as upon embers, O Most Pure Virgin, the Bread was baked within thee, by Him Who preserved thee unharmed.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Who is this that is truly so close unto God, having surpassed all the angelic orders, alone by the beauty of virginity, shining as Mother of the Almighty?

items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up...*

items.english_text: Thou didst ascend the Cross, healing my passions by the passion of Thine immaculate flesh, wherewith Thou didst willingly clothe Thyself; therefore we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Death, tasting of Thy sinless, life-creating Body, was deservedly put to death; and we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Without bridegroom didst thou bear, O Virgin, and after childbearing thou wast shown to be a virgin still; therefore with unceasing voices, with unhesitating faith we cry unto thee, O Sovereign Lady: Rejoice!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: Perceiving the inscrutable divine counsel...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Israel, which had received the law, knew Thee not to be God Who had given the law, O Christ; but transgressing the law, like a lawless one they nailed Thee to the Cross, they that were unworthy of the giving of the law.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Thy deified soul, O Savior, despoiled the treasures of Hades, and raised the souls from the ages; [^82] and Thy life-bearing Body poured forth incorruption unto all.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: Thee, the truly only Ever-Virgin Mother of God, we glorify, whom the unconsumed burning bush prefigured unto Moses the God-beholder, O Most Pure Lady, having joined with fire.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos], the same:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: He lived among men; He Who is invisible was seen in the form of incomprehensible Godhead; and taking form from thee, O Virgin, He delivers from the stranger those who acknowledge thee as the pure Mother of God.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: The Virgin received materially the Immaterial One in the midst of matter, Who became an Infant from her; therefore in two natures is one known: God bearing flesh, and earthly, yet above nature.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: He Who dwelt in thee, the Virgin, preserved thee a virgin after childbirth; and born seedlessly, the Word and God remained, and in childbearing preserved thee a Virgin, as Master and Creator of all creation.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Thou, my Lord, art come as a light into the world: a holy light turning from gloomy ignorance those who hymn Thee with faith.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Thou, O Lord, didst mercifully come down unto the earth; Thou didst lift up fallen human nature being lifted up upon the Tree.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Thou didst take away from me the condemnation of transgression, O Christ; Thou didst loose the pangs of death, O Compassionate One, by Thy divine Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Thee do we set forth as an invincible weapon against enemies; thee have we acquired as firm support and hope of our salvation, O Bride of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: All things marvelled at thy divine [memory]...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Abyssal Hades received Thee wholly with its jaws; for seeing Thee nailed to the Cross, pierced by a spear, breathless, the simple one supposed the living God to be a mere man; but having tried the strength of Thy Godhead, he understood.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: The tomb and Hades, having divided the destroyed temple of Thy Body, O Lover of mankind, are both unwillingly judged and despoiled: the one indeed sending forth the souls of Thy saints, and the other their bodies unto immortality.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Behold, now is the prophetic utterance fulfilled; for thou, O unwedded Virgin, didst receive in thy womb God Who is over all, and didst bear the timeless Son, Who grants peace unto all that hymn thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: Now shall I arise, [the Lord said]...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.

items.english_text: *Troparion:* (fol. 65)[^83]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
