items.english_text: The Son of God, having dwelt within thee, O Pure One, made thee a house of glory, the holy Mountain of God, bride, bridal chamber, temple of sanctification, and delightful, everlasting Paradise for us.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: From the virginal blood Thou didst take flesh, O Christ, seedless, immaculate, and hypostatic, endowed with word and mind, animate, active and endowed with will, sovereign and self-determining.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: The virginal womb put to shame the understanding of tyrants; for the Infant examined with His hand the soul-destroying bite of the asp, and cast down the proud apostate, subduing him under the feet of the faithful.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries out unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the Blood that flowed in mercy from Thy side.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Thou didst ascend the Cross, girded with power, and grappling with the tormentor as God, Thou didst cast him down from on high; and Adam Thou didst raise up by Thine invincible power.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Radiantly beautiful, Thou didst arise from the tomb, O Christ, and didst scatter all Thine enemies by Thy divine power; and as God Thou didst fill all things with joy.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: O wonder, of all wonders the newest! For the Virgin, having conceived without knowing man, unconfinedly contained in her womb Him Who holds all things.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: I came into the depths [of the sea]...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Hades opened its throat and swallowed me, and the senseless one expanded its soul; but Christ having descended, bring up my life, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Death perished by death; for He that had died arose, granting incorruption unto me; and the Immortal One appeared unto us, proclaiming joy.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Thy pure womb was revealed as the receptacle of the unendurable Godhead, O Mother of God, upon Whom the heavenly ranks cannot gaze without fear.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos], the same:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Of old the serpent deceived me and put me to death through my foremother Eve; but now, O Pure One, He Who created me called me back from corruption through thee.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: An abyss of abysses, of ineffable tender compassion, did He show thee forth, O chosen Maiden of wonders; for from thee Christ, the Pearl, shone forth with the lightning of the Godhead.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: My Savior and Redeemer, as God, having raised the earthborn from bonds from the tomb, and crushed the gates of Hades, arose on the third day as Master!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: The Giver of life, Christ, Who arose from the dead on the third day from the tomb, and today crushed the gates of death by His power, and put Hades to death, and blunted the sting of death, and set Adam free with Eve: let all us earthborn hymn, eagerly crying out praise! For He, as the only mighty God and Master, arose on the third day!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the furnace the Abrahamite children, burned by the desire of piety rather than by the Persian flame, cried out: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: Unto incorruption was mankind recalled, washed by the divine Blood of Christ, gratefully singing: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Свѣте единственный и трїсїянный, сꙋщество беначалное, доброто недовѣдомая: въ срдци моемъ вселися, и храмъ твоего Бжтва, свѣтовиденъ...
items.english_text: As life-bearing, as truly fairer than Paradise, and more radiant than any royal chamber, O Christ, was Thy tomb revealed: the fountain of our resurrection! divine and holy dwelling of the Most High! Rejoice, for through thee joy is given, O Mother of God, unto those who cry unto thee: Blessed art thou among women, all-immaculate Lady!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: вышняго свщ҃енно Бж҃твенное селеніе. Радуйся, тобою бо радость дастся Бц҃е вопїющимъ ти: Бл҃женна ты въ женахъ всенепорочная Влч҃це.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: He Who bears all things...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Ірмо́съ [Крестовоскресенъ]: Непослушавша твари...
items.english_text: Thou didst humble, being lifted up upon the Tree, the lofty eye and the exalted brow, casting them down unto the earth, and Thou didst save man! O supremely hymned Lord and God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Смѣрилъ еси на древо воздвизаемъ, око высокое, и превознесенную бровь, на землю низложивъ! и спаслъ еси чл҃вка. Препѣтыи ѡц҃е Гд҃ь и Бг҃ъ бл҃гословенъ еси.
items.english_text: By Thy power, Thou didst exalt our horn, unto us who give ear unto Thee, Who didst arise from the dead and in Thy great love for mankind didst empty the wealth of Hades! O supremely hymned Lord and God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Силою твоею, рогъ нашъ возвыси слышащи тя, въскрсый из мертвыхъ, и многочеловѣчно Адово истощивъ богатство. Препѣтыи ѡц҃е Гд҃ь и Бг҃ъ бл҃гословенъ еси.
items.english_text: Following the divine decrees, we glorify the one Godhead as in three Lights, unconfused, indivisible, an everlasting flame enlightening all creation that cries: O supremely hymned Lord and God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Сеченіамъ Бж҃твеннымъ послѣдующе, славѧ едино Бж҃тво, ꙗко въ трїехъ свѣтехъ, несолїянно, непресѣкомо, пламень вѣчный просвѣщающїй всю тварь зовꙋщую: Препѣтыи ѡц҃емъ Гд҃ь и Бг҃ъ бл҃гвенъ еси.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: The three youths in Babylon...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Ірмо́съ [Богородиченъ]: Юноша три въ вавилонѣ...
items.english_text: Virginal love draws me unto singing, the fire which is in my heart, to cry unto the Mother: Rejoice, blessed one, the Lord of hosts is with thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Привлачитъ мя къ пѣнію любовь дѣвственная, ѡгнь иже въ ср҃дци, вопити Мт҃ри: Радуйся, бл҃гословенная, Гд҃ь силамъ с тобою.
items.english_text: Thou wast revealed higher than creation, having borne the Creator (fol. 67)[^85] and Lord; therefore I cry unto thee: O blessed Mother of God, the Lord of hosts is with thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Превышша твареи ꙗвися, ꙗко творца рож...
items.english_text: Honoring Thee as one Lordship in three illuminations, indivisibly I hymn the Tri-hypostatic Nature: O Blessed One, to praise Thee Who governest all things!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: ...ши и Гд҃а, тѣмже ти вопїю: Бц҃е бл҃гословенная, Гд҃ь силамъ с тобою.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Daniel, stretching out his hands, stopped the open mouths of the lions in the pit; and the Children, lovers of piety, girded about with virtue, quenched the power of the fire, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Господьство тя едино чтѧи, въ трїехъ свѣтеніяхъ, нераздѣлно, въспѣваю трїсупостасное естество: Бл҃женная възпивати тя ꙗже вся оуправляющаѧ.
items.english_text: Stretching out Thy hands upon the Cross, Thou didst gather all the nations unto Thyself, and as Master Thou didst reveal one Church, earthly and heavenly, singing unto Thee, in harmony crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Руцѣ распростеръ Данїилъ, лвова зїянїа въ ровѣ затче, ѡгненнуюже силу оугасиша, добродѣтелїю препоѧсавшеся: иже бл҃гчтїа рачители ѿроци зовꙋще: Блгвите всѧ дѣла Гднѧ Гда поите, и превозносите его въ вѣки.
items.english_text: White-robed appeared the Angel unto the women, flashing with the inaccessible light of the Resurrection: Why do ye seek the Living One in the tomb as dead? he cried; truly Christ is risen, unto Whom we cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Руцѣ распростеръ на Кртѣ, ꙗзыки всѧ къ себѣ събра, и единъ ꙗвилъ еси Влко Црковъ, воспѣвающꙋю тѧ, земную и нбнꙋю, согласно поющи: блгвите вся дѣла Гдня Гда поите, и превозносите его въ вѣки.
items.english_text: Thou alone in all generations, O Most Pure Virgin, wast shown to be the Mother of God; thou becamest the dwelling of the Godhead, all-immaculate one, unconsumed by the fire of the unapproachable Light; therefore all of us bless thee, O Mary, Bride of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Бѣлоѡбразенъ ꙗвися женамъ неприкосновенны свѣтомъ воскрнїа, блистаяся Агглъ: что живаго въ Гробѣ вопїа ищете ꙗко мертва; въ истинну въста Хс, емꙋже вопїем: блгсловите вся дѣла Гдня Гда поите, и превозносите его въ вся вѣки.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: The godly youths in the furnace...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Beholding Thine unjust slaying, creation darkened and lamented; for as the earth was shaken, the sun was clothed in darkness as in a crimson robe; but we sing of Thee, O Christ, and supremely exalt Thee unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Descending unto me even unto Hades, and making the Resurrection a way for all, Thou didst ascend again, taking me upon Thy shoulders, and didst bring me unto the Father; therefore I cry unto Thee: Works, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: We glorify the first Mind and Cause of all, the Father alone, Who has no cause; and the Word Who is co-unoriginate, and the Comforter Spirit, the one God of all, bowing down before the equally unoriginate Trinity, and supremely exalting It unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: Almighty Redeemer of all...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: He Who fashioned the frame of Adam is incarnate from thy virginity, the Lord of all, Whom hymning (fol. 68)[^86] we cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: In the tent Abraham beheld the mystery concerning thee, O Mother of God; for he received thy bodiless Son, singing: All works, bless the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: The prefiguration of thy virginity saved those equal in number to the Trinity; for in virginal bodies they trampled the flame, O Maiden, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A cornerstone uncut by hands was cut out from thee, an uncut mountain, O Virgin, even Christ, Who joined together the separated natures; therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Mother of God!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Whole as I was, Thou didst wholly assume me in unconfused union, granting salvation unto my whole being, O my God, through Thy Passion, which Thou didst endure bodily upon the Cross, by reason of Thy manifold tender compassion!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Thy Disciples, beholding Thy tomb opened and the God-bearing Shroud [Plashchanytsia] emptied by Thy Resurrection, with the Angel cried aloud: Truly the Lord is risen *Triadikon:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: ...Bowing down before the unity of the divine essence, yet Three Persons of the Trinity, in unconfused Hypostases, all we faithful now piously magnifying glorify the equal in power and equally honored!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: The Savior, born of earth...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Deceitfully creeping, the serpent dragged me captive from Eden; but the Almighty Lord, crushing the adversary upon the firm Rock of Cranium [Calvary] as if an infant, through the Tree of the Cross opened unto me an entrance into the sweetness [of Paradise]!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Having now laid waste the strong fortresses of the enemy, and plundered his wealth by Thine all-powerful hand, Thou didst raise me up with Thyself, O Christ, from the depths of Hades; and him that of old boasted immeasurably, Thou didst show to be an object of derision and mockery!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Come, visiting the affliction of Thy poor people, and by Thy merciful and mighty right hand strengthen the Cross-bearing King against the boastful enemies, and protect Thy choice heritage, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: The mystery of God, O Most Pure One...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* (fol. 69)[^87]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: We behold thee, O Most Pure One, as a lily adorned with a vesture dyed in the purple of the Divine Spirit, shining in the midst of thorns and filling with fragrance those who sincerely magnify thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Having received corruptible earthly nature from thine all-immaculate womb, the Incorruptible One showed it forth incorruptible within Himself, by reason of His tender compassion; therefore we magnify thee as the Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O thou that rulest over all creation, grant unto thy people victorious triumph, overthrowing the adversary, O Reconciler of the Church, that we may magnify thee as the Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 4:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O almighty Lord, Who didst endure crucifixion and death, and didst arise from the dead: we glorify Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou didst deliver us from the ancient curse; and by Thy death Thou didst bring to naught the devil who tormented our nature; and by Thine arising Thou didst fill all things with joy; therefore we cry unto Thee: O Thou Who didst arise from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ our Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy, O Thou Who didst arise from the dead: raise us up who have fallen into sin, stretching out Thy hand, O Lord, Lover of mankind, by the entreaties of Thy saints!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Without departing from the Father's bosom, O only-begotten Word of God, Thou didst come down unto the earth for the sake of Thy love for mankind, having become man without change; and Thou didst endure crucifixion and death in the flesh, while remaining passionless in Thy Godhead; and having arisen from the dead, Thou didst grant immortality unto the human race, as Thou alone art almighty!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian [Eastern], the same Tone:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Thou didst submit unto death in the flesh, mediating immortality for us, O Savior; and Thou didst take up Thine abode in the tomb, that Thou mightest free us from Hades, raising us up with Thyself; Thou didst suffer indeed as man, but Thou didst arise as God; therefore we cry: Glory to Thee, O Lord, Giver of life, only Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: The rocks split asunder, O Savior, when Thy Cross was planted upon Calvary; the gatekeepers of Hades were terrified when Thou wast laid in the tomb as dead (fol. 70)[^88]; for Thou didst bring to naught the power of death, and Thou didst grant incorruption unto all the dead by Thy Resurrection, O Christ, Giver of life, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: The women desired to see Thy Resurrection, O Christ God; Mary Magdalene went beforehand and came, and found the stone rolled away from the tomb, and an Angel sitting and saying: Why do ye seek the Living One with the dead? He is risen as God, that He might save all things!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection. Sessional hymns of the Resurrection, and the canons of the Octoechos to 8, and we also sing other Theotokia.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Where is Jesus, Whom ye were appointed to guard? Say, O Jews! Where is He Whom ye laid in the tomb, having sealed the stone? Give up the dead man, ye who have rejected Life! Give up Him that was buried, or believe in Him that is risen! Even if ye hold your peace, the stones shall cry out the Lord's rising, especially that rolled away from the tomb! Great is Thy mercy, great is the mystery of Thy dispensation: O our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 4:*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: On account of the tree was Adam banished from Paradise, but through the Tree of the Cross the thief took up his dwelling in Paradise; for the one by tasting rejected the commandment of Him that created him, while the other, crucified together with Thee, confessed Thee as the hidden God, crying: Remember me in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Having all of us the Cross of Christ in our minds, let us hasten to mortify worldly pleasures, making our soul a church unto the Holy Spirit, sending up the voice of the virtuous thief unto Him, we faithful: Remember us also in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Let us faithful entreat Him Who arose from the dead, and plundered the dominion of Hades, and was seen by the Myrrh-bearing Women, saying: Rejoice! that He deliver our souls from corruption, ever crying unto Him with the voice of the wise thief: Remember us also in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Unto Thy tomb, O Christ, the Myrrh-bearing Women came to anoint Thee, and finding not, O Good One, Thy life-bearing (fol. 71)[^89] and most pure Body, they were at a loss; weeping with tears, they sought Thee, but having seen Thee, O Master, their beloved One, they cried unto Thee: Remember us in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Truly Christ is risen, and the tomb bears witness, and unto you, O transgressors of the Law: for leaving His grave-clothes, He arose on the third day; the stone was sealed, and the guards stood before the tomb; Hades was plundered, death was slain, Christ was not stolen: believe with us in His Resurrection!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Having come unto the Disciples, and granting peace unto them, and assuring the doubting Thomas by the showing of Thy wounds: Thou didst raise up all the ends [of the earth], O Lord, to glorify Thee; and being now entreated, save those who cry, O Master: Remember us in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: The Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, let all we faithful with one mind pray worthily to doxologize: the Unity of the Godhead existing in Three Persons, abiding unconfused, simple, indivisible, and unapproachable, whereby we are delivered from fiery torment!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 4)
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Thy Mother, O Christ, who bore Thee in the flesh seedlessly, and truly remained an incorrupt Virgin after childbearing: her we bring unto Thee in prayer, O exceedingly merciful Master, to grant forgiveness of sins unto those who ever cry unto Thee: Remember us also in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried":*

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: By Thy precious Cross, O Christ, Thou didst put the devil to shame; and by Thy Resurrection Thou didst blunt the sting of sin, and didst save us from the gates of death: we glorify Thee, O Only-Begotten One!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: He Who gives resurrection unto the human race was led as a sheep to the slaughter; the princes of Hades were terrified of Him, and the gates of weeping were lifted up; for Christ, the King of glory, entered in, saying unto those in bonds: Come forth! and unto those in darkness: Reveal yourselves!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: A great marvel: the Creator of invisible things, having suffered in the flesh for the sake of His love for mankind, arose immortal! Come, families of the nations, let us worship Him for delivered from deceit by His tender mercy, we have learned to hymn the one God in Three Persons!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian [Eastern], the same Tone:*

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: An evening adoration do we offer unto Thee, the Unwaning Light, Who at the end of the ages, as in a mirror, didst shine forth in the flesh unto the world, and didst descend even unto Hades, and didst dispel the darkness there, and didst show forth the light of the Resurrection unto the nations: O Lord, Giver of light, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: The Author of our salvation, Christ, let us doxologize; for when He arose from the dead, the world was saved from deceit; the angelic choir rejoices, demonic deceit flees, fallen Adam arises, and the devil is brought to naught!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: They that were of the guard were instructed by the lawless ones to conceal Christ's Resurrection: Take silver pieces, and say: While we slept, the dead man was stolen from the tomb! Who ever saw, or who ever heard, of a dead man stolen at any time, especially one anointed with myrrh and naked, leaving behind his burial wrappings in the tomb? (fol. 73)[^91] Be not deceived, O Jews! Learn the prophetic utterances, and understand that He is truly the Redeemer of the world, the Almighty One!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O Lord, Who didst plunder Hades and trample upon death, our Savior, and didst enlighten the world by Thy precious Cross: have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Glory, both now. Dogmatikon Theotokion, Tone 5:*

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: In the Red Sea an image of the unwedded Bride was prefigured of old: there Moses was the divider of the waters, and here Gabriel was the minister of the wonder; then Israel traversed the deep dryshod, and now the Virgin bore Christ seedlessly; the sea remained impassable after the passage of Israel, and the Immaculate One remained incorrupt after the birth of Emmanuel: O Thou Who art and Who wast before, and hast appeared as man, O God, have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 5:*

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Thee, Who wast incarnate, O Christ Savior, and didst not depart from heaven, in voices of songs we magnify; for Thou didst accept the Cross and death for the sake of our race, as the Lord Who loves mankind; having shattered the gates of Hades, Thou didst arise on the third day, saving our souls!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: From Thy pierced side, O Giver of life, Thou didst pour forth streams of remission unto all, life and salvation; and having received death in the flesh, Thou didst grant immortality unto us; and taking up Thine abode in the tomb, Thou didst free us, raising us up with Thyself gloriously as God; therefore we cry: O Lord, Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Strange is Thy crucifixion and descent into Hades, O Lover of mankind; for having plundered it and raised up with Thyself the prisoners of old gloriously as God, Thou didst open Paradise and made them worthy to receive it; therefore grant remission of sins also unto us who glorify Thy third-day arising, making us worthy to dwell in Paradise, as Thou alone art tenderhearted!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O Thou Who for our sake didst receive death in the flesh, and didst arise on the third day from the dead: heal our fleshly passions, and raise us up from grievous transgressions, O Lover of mankind, and save us!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Glory, both now. Aposticha Theotokion:* (fol. 74)[^92]

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: A temple and a gate art thou, a palace and the throne of the King, O all-honored Virgin, from whom my Redeemer, Christ the Lord, appeared unto those sleeping in darkness, being the Sun of Righteousness, wishing to enlighten those whom He created according to His image with His hand; therefore, O Supremely Hymned One, having acquired maternal boldness towards Him, pray unceasingly that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: The Word, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, Who was born of the Virgin for our salvation, let us faithful hymn and worship; for He was well-pleased to ascend the Cross in the flesh, and to endure death, and to raise the dead by His glorious Resurrection!

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Glory, both now. Dismissal Theotokion, Tone 5:*

items.office: On Saturday evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried"
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Rejoice, impassable gate of the Lord! Rejoice, rampart and protection of those who flee unto thee! Rejoice, tempest-free haven and unwedded one, who bore in the flesh thy Creator and Lord: cease not praying for those who hymn and worship thy childbearing!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: The steed and rider into the Red Sea...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Hymning the dominion of the unitary and tri-solar countenance, we cry: Enlighten our mind, O almighty God, and raise it up, O Master, unto Thine ineffable glory!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: On high the angelic splendors of noetic beings unceasingly hymn Thee with thrice-holy songs, the threefold Unity and conforming Trinity, super-essential and almighty!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Grant unto my soul the divine drink of Thy love, sweet and light-producing, O Trinity, light-originating Unity, and divine cleansing compunction, O Master of all creation, exceedingly merciful!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: As rain upon the fleece, noiselessly from heaven did the divine Rain descend into thy womb, O Virgin, and saved all withered human nature, O Most Pure One!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: O Thou Who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command...* (fol. 75)[^93]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Having endowed noetic beings with reason, Thou didst establish them as unceasing singers of Thy Godhead, O Tri-radiant God and Creator of all; yet receive also the entreaty and supplication of us clay and earthborn, as Thou art tenderhearted!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O Thou Who by nature art susceptible to no change, unto us who are healed and who sing, unfathomable Fountain of Thy goodness, grant forgiveness of transgressions and salvation, as Thou art tenderhearted!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: We glorify the Father, and the Son, and the Spirit in the unchangeable form of the Godhead, Thee, the unitary and tri-radiant Lord of all, even as the Prophets and Apostles were clearly taught by Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Thou didst appear unto Moses in the bush as the Angel of Great Counsel of the Almighty, prefiguring Thine incarnation from the Virgin, O Word of God, whereby Thou didst recreate us and lead us up unto heaven!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Merciful art Thou, O indivisible Trinity, for Thou hast mercy upon all, as Thou art almighty and all-bountiful, compassionate and exceedingly merciful; therefore we flee unto Thee, weighed down by many sins, crying out: Cleanse Thy servants, and deliver us from every torment!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O all-holy Virgin, have mercy upon us who run with faith unto thee, the tenderhearted, and who ask for thy warm protection; for as good, thou art able to save all, as being the Mother of God, the Most High, through thy maternal prayers, O ever Grace-bestowed!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Perceiving Thy divine condescension with prophetic insight, O...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Daniel was mystically initiated into the tri-radiant [light] of the one Lordship, having beheld Christ the Judge coming unto the Father, and manifesting the vision of the Spirit!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Unto those who hymn Thee with clay lips, the super-essential God, Trinitarian in Hypostases, unitary in nature, vouchsafe angelic glory!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: One authority and one Lordship in three properties indivisibly we glorify: O Father, and Son, and Spirit, enlighten us, Thy servants!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* (fol. 76)[^94]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: An honorable and overshadowing mountain, which Habakkuk beheld of old, from whence the Holy One came forth, an unapproachable visible birth did he proclaim of thy conception, O Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O Thou Who out of goodness didst create man and fashion him according to Thine own image: dwell within me, O my tri-radiant God, as Thou art good and tenderhearted!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Guide me, O tri-solar Unity, unto the divine paths of salvation, and fill me with Thy radiance, for in nature Thou art God unsearchable in power!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: O indivisible Light of Thy nature, divided in characters, tri-radiant and unwaning: enlighten my heart with Thy rays!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: When of old the Prophet beheld thee, O pure and all-holy one, as a gate facing toward the never-setting Light, he immediately recognized thee as the dwelling-place of God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Surging with the storm of soul-corrupting passions, O...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты едина въ всѣхъ родѣхъ Дво Пречтая, Мти...
items.english_text: Being the Tri-radiant Godhead in Persons, Thou art unitary as conforming and equal in operation and in extension according to essence.

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Доволно изъяви Пррокъ, поя Ѻц҃у твоемꙋ свѣтꙋ, оузримъ Дхомъ свѣтъ Сна, единаго Бга трїсолнечнаго.
items.english_text: Abundantly did the Prophet make manifest, singing: In Thy light, O Father, we shall see by the Spirit the light of the Son, the one Tri-solar God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Несоставно сꙋщество, въ трїехъ свойствѣхъ, единъ власть идержаву имый, тѣми бо составится тварь всяческая и ѡбновляется.
items.english_text: An unoriginate Essence in three personal properties, having one authority and dominion; for by Them all creation was established and is renewed!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Прегрѣшенїи избавленіе, и напастемъ. Влко Бже единственное и трїсвѣтне, низпосли твоимъ пѣвцемъ, молбами Бгоматере.
items.english_text: Deliverance from transgressions and tribulations, O Master God, unitary and tri-radiant, send down unto Thy singers through the supplications of the Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Недоумѣвся ѡвсѣхъ, ктебѣ прибѣгохъ, къ надежди всѣхъ и прибѣжищꙋ, грѣшнымъ и смиреннымъ, зовый: согрѣших, и пребываю къ злыхъ, нечувствуя ѡкаянный: Помилуй мя прежде конца: ѡбрати мя й исхити всякоя муки раба своего.
items.english_text: Perplexed in all things, I have fled unto Thee, the hope of all and the refuge for the sinful and the humble, crying: I have sinned, and I abide in evil, insensible, wretch that I am! Have mercy upon me before the end; convert me and deliver Thy servant from every torment!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Трїсолнечное сїянїе славословимъ и Трци простѣй ннѣ поклонѣимся: ꙗко просвѣти насъ и помилова, й исхити ѿ тла весь родъ человѣческій, избавляющи ѿ прелести Їдолскїа весь мїръ, и цртво намъ подаде.
items.english_text: The tri-solar Radiance let us hymn with doxology, and unto the simple Trinity let us now bow down; for It enlightened and had mercy upon us, and snatched all the human race from corruption, delivering the whole world from the delusion of idols, and granted the Kingdom unto us!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗко имый бездну мати, Гди: й пучину неисчетную щедротъ, помилуй единаго тя поющихъ, трїсїяннаго Бга всѣхъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Lord God of our fathers, praised above...* [^95]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Неѡбмыслимаго единственна и трїсвѣтла, Бга тя и Гда поюще, въпїемъ ти: подаждь твоимъ рабомъ ѡчищеніе согрѣшенїи.
items.english_text: As Thou hast an abyss of mercy, O Lord, and an unsearchable deep of compassions: have mercy upon those who hymn Thee as the One, the Tri-radiant God of all!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Равно составнувъ единой державѣ чтꙋще раздѣлемъ, нераздѣлимо сꙋщество, Бга Ѻца, и Сна, и престаго Дха.
items.english_text: Hymning Thee, the incomprehensible, unitary, and tri-radiant God and Lord, we cry unto Thee: Grant cleansing of transgressions unto Thy servants!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡраслъ прозябла еси, Ѻц҃у собезначална, свѣт Бжества, стебль соприсносꙋщный Дво, дающаго жизнь всѣмъ человѣкомъ.
items.english_text: Honoring the equally unoriginate Hypostases in one dominion, we distinguish, without dividing, the essence: God the Father, and the Son, and the All-Holy Spirit!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Да единаго ѡкрыеши древле, ꙗвѣ Гдьства, Трчный составъ, ꙗвился еси Бже мои въ ѡбразѣ чл҃вѣкомъ Авраамꙋ: поющу твою державу единственную.
items.english_text: Thou didst bud forth an Offshoot co-unoriginate with the Father, the Light of the Godhead, an ever-coeternal Stem, O Virgin, Who gives life unto all mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the youth...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: That Thou mightest clearly reveal of old the Trinitarian Hypostases of the one Lordship, Thou didst appear, O my God, in human form unto Abraham, as he hymned Thy unitary dominion!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Vouchsafe me to look upon Thy beneficent rays, O unapproachable Light, O generous Father and Word, and Spirit, that I may look upon Thy beneficent rays, so as to be well-pleasing unto Thee always, O Lord of all!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Holy is God the Father, pre-eternal! Holy also is the Son, begotten of the Father! Holy also is the Life-creating Spirit, proceeding from the Father, and revealed through the Son!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thou didst shine forth unto us from the tri-solar glory the one Christ and Lord, O all-hymned one, mystically teaching all to sing unto the one Godhead in three Persons unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Rejoice, O Isaiah! For a Virgin hath conceived...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Human words cannot worthily hymn Thee, O divine Unity; yet daring according to our strength through faith, O divine co-enthroned Trinity, we offer glory and praise unto Thy dominion!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: With equal glory the Cherubim and Seraphim praise the one-originating, tri-radiant God with most pure lips; with them receive also us sinners, O Lord, who magnify Thy dominion!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Isaiah beheld Thee upon the Cherubic Throne, and the Seraphim standing round about Thee, covering their faces with wings, and crying: Holy, holy, holy art Thou, thrice-holy God, glorified (fol. 78)[^96] in three personal properties!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, the work of Mitrophanes.
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: As pure and immaculate and Virgin, thou didst bear the Son Who delivers us from temptations, the timeless God; pray Him even now to send down upon us remission of transgressions!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Let us praise the Cross of the Lord, let us honor His holy burial with hymns, and let us supremely glorify His Resurrection; for as God He raised the dead from the graves with Himself, having despoiled the dominion of death and the strength of the devil, and shone forth light unto those in Hades!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: O Lord, after Thy third-day Resurrection and the adoration by the Apostles, Peter cried unto Thee: The women took courage, but I was afraid! The thief confessed Thee as God, but I denied Thee! Wilt Thou then call me still to be a disciple, or wilt Thou show me forth again a fisher of the deep? But receive me in repentance, O God, and save me!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Terrifying is the wonder of thy conception, and ineffable the manner of thy childbearing; in thee it was made known, O pure Ever-Virgin! It astounds my mind and strikes awe into my thoughts: thy glory, O Mother of God, extended unto all, unto the salvation of our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou wast called dead, Who didst put death to death; Thou wast laid in a tomb, Who didst empty the graves! Above, soldiers guarded the tomb; below, Thou didst raise up the dead of all ages! O almighty and incomprehensible Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: O Lord, the transgressors nailed Thee in the midst of the condemned, and pierced Thy side with a spear, O most merciful One; and Thou didst accept burial, Who didst break down the gates of Hades, and didst arise on the third day! The women ran to see Thee, and announced the Resurrection unto the Apostles. Supremely exalted Savior, Whom the Angels hymn: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Rejoice, holy and God-trodden mountain! Rejoice, living and unconsumed bush! Rejoice, only bridge leading the world unto God, that translates (fol. 79)[^97] mortals unto eternal life! Rejoice, incorrupt Maiden who knewest not wedlock, who didst bear the salvation of our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Astounding the mind by their angelic appearance, and enlightening their souls by the divine Resurrection, the Myrrh-bearers announced the good tidings unto the Apostles: Proclaim among the nations the Resurrection, as the Lord works together with wonders, granting great mercy unto us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: When I am afflicted, like David I sing unto Thee, O my Savior: Deliver my soul from a deceitful tongue!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Blessed is the life of those who dwell in the wilderness, who are borne aloft on wings by divine longing!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit are all things held together, both visible and invisible; for being sovereign, One of the Trinity is He in truth!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Unto the mountains let us lift up ourselves, O my soul; thither go, whence help shall come!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: May Thy right hand, extended unto me also, O Christ, preserve me from every delusion!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit, speaking theology, let us say: Thou art God, life, longing, light, understanding! Thou art goodness, Thou reignest unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Concerning those who said unto me: "Let us go into the courts of the Lord", filled with great joy, I send up prayers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: In the house of David fearful things are wrought; for there is a fire that burns up every defiled mind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit belongs life-originating dignity, from Whom every living creature is animated, as in the Father, together also with the Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 5: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up, for Thou reignest unto the ages. Verse: I will confess Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart. 'Let every breath praise the Lord.' Verse: 'Praise God in His saints.' Matins Gospel. 'Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ.' Psalm 50. Glory: 'Through the prayers of the holy Apostles...'; 'Jesus having risen...':*

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: Horse and rider into the Red Sea, He Who shatters wars with a high arm, Christ, cast down; but Israel He saved, as they sang a song of victory.*

items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: With thorns did the Jewish assembly crown Thee, O Christ, not having preserved maternal love toward Thee, the Benefactor, Who loosest the thorny condemnation of the first father!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thou didst raise me up, who had fallen into the pit, bowing down, O sinless Giver of life; and having without experience of sin endured my foul-smelling corruption, O Christ, Thou didst perfume me with the myrrh of the divine nature!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: The curse is loosed, sorrow has ceased; for the blessed and full of grace dawned joy unto the faithful, bearing Christ, the blossom of blessing, unto all ends of the earth!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection, the same Tone:*

items.english_text: *Heirmos: Unto God the Savior, Who led the people dryshod in the sea...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Unto Him Who was willingly nailed in the flesh upon the Cross, and by the Tree freed him who fell through the ancient condemnation: unto Him alone let us sing, for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Unto Christ Who arose from the tomb from among the dead, and raised up fallen man with Himself, and adorned him by seating him together with the Father: unto Him alone let us sing, for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: O most pure Mother of God: pray unceasingly unto God Who was incarnate from thee, yet was not separated from the bosom of the Father, to deliver from every tribulation those whom He created!

items.english_text: O pure one, pray Christ, the Light Who took up His abode within thee and enlightened the world with the rays of the Godhead, to enlighten all who sing of thee, O Virgin Mother!

items.english_text: Adorned with the beauty of virtues, O full of grace, the all-pure one sings with the radiance of the Spirit of the beneficent majesty of Him Who made all things beautiful!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: The bush that prefigured thee of old upon Sinai was not consumed, O Maiden, when joined unto the fire; for as a Virgin thou didst give birth, and a Virgin didst remain, beyond understanding, O Bride of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who established the earth upon nothing by His command, and suspended its unsupportable weight: upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church, O only Good One and Lover of mankind!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Gall did they who sucked honey from the rock bring unto Thee, O Christ, Who didst work wonders in the wilderness; and vinegar instead of manna did the ungrateful children of Israel render unto Thee for Thy beneficence!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: They who of old were overshadowed by the light-bearing cloud (fol. 81)[^99] laid Christ, our Life, in a tomb; but having arisen by Thine own power, Thou didst grant unto all the faithful the radiance of the Spirit secretly overshadowing from on high!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Thou, O Mother of God, without wedlock didst give birth unto Him Who shone forth from the incorrupt Father, without maternal pangs; therefore we orthodoxly proclaim thee as the Mother of God, for thou didst bear the incarnate Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: By the power of Thy Cross, O Christ...*

items.english_text: Having arisen from the tomb, O Christ, Thou didst deliver from mortal corruption those who hymn Thy voluntary Crucifixion, O Giver of life!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
