items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearers hastened to anoint Thy Body with myrrh, O Christ, and not finding it, they returned, singing of Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Pray unceasingly, O pure one, unto Him Who came forth from thy loins, to deliver from the delusion of the devil those who hymn thee, the pure Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: The ladder whereby the Most High came down unto us, to restore our corrupted nature: thou, O pure one, wast visibly seen by all; for through thee the supremely Good One was well pleased to unite Himself unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: The mystery foreordained of old, O Virgin, and foreseen before the ages by God Who knows all things, in these last times took its fulfillment in thy womb, O all-immaculate one, and was made manifest!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: The condemnation of the ancient curse was loosed through thy mediation, O all-pure Virgin; for the Lord, appearing from thee, poured forth blessing unto all as the supremely Good One, thou only adornment of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Perceiving Thy divine emptying with foresight, Habakkuk cried out unto Thee with trembling, O Christ: For the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed, art Thou come!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Prefiguring Thy most pure Cross as in an image through the bitter waters of Marah, O Good One, Thou didst sweeten by the Tree that taste of sin which slays!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: The Cross in exchange for the tree of knowledge, and gall for sweet food didst Thou accept, O my Savior; and for the corruption of death Thou didst pour forth Thy divine Blood!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Without wedlock didst thou conceive incorruptibly in thy womb, and didst give birth before travailing, and after childbirth thou wast preserved a Virgin, having borne God in the flesh!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: I heard the report of the power of the Cross, that paradise was opened...*

items.english_text: When the Cross was set up on the earth, upon the Place of the Skull, the bars and the eternal gates were shattered, and they cried out: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: When the Savior descended as dead unto the bound, those who were dead from all ages arose with Him, and cried out: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: A Virgin gave birth, and knew not maternal pangs; yet she is truly Mother, and remained Virgin; singing unto her, we cry aloud: Rejoice, O Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: Perceiving Thy divine [emptying]...*

items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: With heart and mind, with soul and mouth, I piously confess thee in truth as the Mother of God, O pure one, embracing the fruit of salvation; and they are saved, O Virgin, through thy prayers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: He Who created all things out of nothing was well pleased, as the Benefactor, to be created from thee, the pure one, for the salvation of those who hymn thee with faith and love, O all-immaculate Lady!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: The choirs above the world hymn thy childbirth, O all-immaculate one, rejoicing with them who truly acknowledge thee to be the Mother of God, O undefiled Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Isaiah named thee the rod, from which blossomed forth unto us the fair flower, Christ God, for the salvation of those who flee with faith and love unto thy protection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: O Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee I rise early, and unto Thee I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou alone art tenderhearted!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: The Lord of glory, in an inglorious form, hangs dishonored upon the Tree of His own will, ineffably providing divine glory for me!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thou didst clothe me in incorruption, O Christ, having tasted mortal corruption incorruptibly in the flesh, and having shone forth from the tomb on the third day!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Having borne for us Christ, our righteousness and redemption, without seed, thou didst set free the nature of our forefather from the curse, O Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: Rising at dawn we cry unto Thee...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thou didst stretch out Thy hands upon the Tree, O our Savior, calling all unto Thyself, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Having delivered Adam from captivity, O my Savior, by Thy burial and by Thy Resurrection, Thou didst fill all things with joy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Having arisen from the tomb on the third day, O Giver of life, Thou didst pour forth imperishable immortality unto all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: We hymn thee as Virgin after childbirth, O Mother of God; for thou (fol. 83)[^101] didst bear God the Word in the flesh unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: O Thou Who clothest Thyself with light...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: All the Prophets clearly foretold thee, who wast to be the Mother of God, O all-pure Mother of God; for thou alone wast found completely pure and immaculate!

items.english_text: Seeing thee entirely fair and immaculate, sealed in purity with virginity, God Who is the only Tenderhearted loved thee and dwelt within thee!

items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Tossing in a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ: calm the sea of my passions and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art compassionate!*

items.english_text: The first father slipped into corruption, O Master Christ, having tasted of the forbidden food; and he was led back unto life by Thy Passion!

items.english_text: O Life, Thou didst descend into Hades, O Master Christ, and becoming corruptible unto him who had been corrupted: through incorruption Thou didst pour forth the Resurrection!

items.english_text: A Virgin gave birth, and having given birth, remained pure, bearing in her hands Him Who upholds all things, as truly a Virgin Mother!

items.english_text: Thou didst stretch out Thy hands, gathering together from afar the scattered assemblies of Thy nations, O Christ our God, by Thy life-bearing Cross, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: Having despoiled death and shattered the gates of Hades, Adam, who had been bound, was loosed and cried out unto Thee, O Savior: Thy right hand [hath done this], O Lord!

items.english_text: As the unconsumed bush, and the Mountain, and the living Ladder, and the heavenly Gate, we worthily glorify thee, O glorious Mary, the boast of the Orthodox!

items.english_text: He Who is the Cause of all, Who gives being unto all things, taking thee as cause, is incarnate for our sake, O all-immaculate Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Pouring forth a soul-nourishing fountain of healings unto those who flee with faith unto thy glorious protection, we know thee to be, O all-immaculate Lady!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Thou didst bear for us the Giver of life, the Author of salvation, Who grants eternal redemption unto those who truly proclaim thee to be the Mother of God!

items.english_text: Unto Hades, O my Savior, didst Thou descend, and having shattered its gates as almighty, Thou didst raise up the dead with Thyself as Creator, and didst break the sting of death; and Adam was delivered from the curse, O Lover of mankind; therefore we all cry: Save us, O Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Hearing the words of the Angel, the women put away their lamentation, becoming joyful and trembling, for they beheld a terrifying wonder; and lo, Christ drew near unto them, saying: Rejoice, be of good cheer, I have overcome the world and set free the prisoners! Hasten therefore unto the Disciples, announcing unto them: I go before you into the city of Galilee to preach; therefore we all cry unto Thee: Save us, O Lord!

items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Lord of the fathers, Who is supremely exalted, quenched the flame and refreshed the youths, as they sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God!*

items.english_text: Clothed in flesh, as with bait upon a hook, by Thy divine power Thou didst draw down the serpent, leading up those who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: He Who brought into being the unshakeable foundation of the earth is covered in a tomb according to the flesh, the Incomprehensible One, unto Whom we sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: One Hypostasis in two natures, O all-immaculate one, didst thou bear, the incarnate God, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.english_text: Blessed is the God of our fathers, Who through the Tree of the Cross loosed the delusion of idols!

items.english_text: Blessed is the God of our fathers, Who arose from the dead and raised up those who were in Hades with Himself!

items.english_text: Blessed is the God of our fathers, Who by His death destroyed the dominion of death, O Christ!

items.english_text: Blessed is the God of our fathers, Who was born of the Virgin and revealed her to be the Mother of God!

items.english_text: Abiding uncircumscribed and infinite, He was united in hypostasis according to the flesh, as the Tenderhearted One, within thee, the all-holy one: the only blessed God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: The choir in unison glorifies thee as the all-immaculate Bride, O Lady Mother of God, and the Throne of thy Creator, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.english_text: Purified by the Spirit, O Virgin, thou becamest the Mother of the King of all, Who created thee, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Saving us, O most pure Mother of God, the Lord was clothed with the garment of the flesh (fol. 85)[^103] from thee, unto Whom we sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the youths in the furnace, having woven an all-fair choir, sang: All ye works of the Lord, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!*

items.english_text: Thou didst pray concerning the cup of Thy saving Passion, voluntary yet as it were involuntary; for Thou bearest two wills, corresponding unto Thy two natures, O Christ, unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: By Thine all-operative descent, O Christ, stricken Hades cast forth all those who of old had been slain by delusion, who supremely exalt Thee unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thee who beyond understanding in godly manner didst bear the Lord by the Word, and remainedst a Virgin: all works bless thee, O Virgin, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: Unto Him Who was begotten before [the ages]...*

items.english_text: Unto Christ God, Who of His own will stretched out His hands upon the Cross, and destroyed the dominion of death: praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Unto Christ God, Who shone forth from the tomb as a bridegroom, and appeared unto the myrrh-bearers, proclaiming joy unto them: praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye people!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Thou wast revealed higher than the Cherubim, O pure Mother of God, having borne in thy womb Him Who is borne upon them, Whom with the bodiless hosts we earthborn hymn with doxology and supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: Unto Thee, the Creator of all...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: The voice of our forefather's grief has now ceased, since thou, O Mother of God, didst receive joy; therefore we unceasingly hymn thee, O Virgin, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: The assembly of the bodiless hosts hymns with us thine incomprehensible childbirth, O Virgin, having joined in one choir with love, and supremely exalting Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: A clear stream of immortality, O Maiden, came forth from thee, even the Lord of all, washing away the defilement of those who sing with faith and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Truly the divine and light-bearing throne, and the tablets of grace, do we confess thee to be, O Virgin Maiden, as having received the Father's Word, Whom we supremely exalt unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Rejoice, O Isaiah: for the Virgin held in her womb and brought forth a Son, Emmanuel, God and man, Dayspring is His name; Whom magnifying, we call thee blessed, O Virgin!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: Taking fallen man unto Thyself, O Master Christ, from virginal loins Thou didst unite Thyself wholly unto him, yet without partaking of sin in any way; and Thou didst set him wholly free from corruption through Thy most pure Passion!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: By the God-flowing and life-creating Blood poured forth from Thy (fol. 86)[^104] most pure side, O Master, the sacrifice of idols has ceased, and all the earth brings a sacrifice of praise unto Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Not a bodiless God, nor again a mere man, came forth from thee, O pure and undefiled Maiden, but perfect Man and truly perfect God, Whom we magnify together with the Father and the Spirit!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [Cross-Resurrection]: Thee, the Mother of God beyond mind and word...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thee Who didst endure the Passion upon the Cross, and didst shatter the power of Hades by death: we faithful orthodoxly magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thee Who didst arise from the tomb on the third day, and didst despoil Hades, and didst enlighten the world: we faithful with one mind magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Mother of God, Mother of Christ God! Pray Him Whom thou didst bear to grant remission of transgressions unto those who sing of thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos [to the Most Holy Theotokos]: Rejoice, O Isaiah...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: From thy pure blood flesh was supernaturally curdled for the Creator of all, the only-begotten Son of the Father, without a man and without seed, endowed with mind and animated with a soul, O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Ты мя къ твоимъ блгодѣтельнымъ лꙋчамъ, возирати сподоби свѣте неприступный Ѻч҃е...
items.english_text: Thou didst stop the irresistible circuit of death having in truth borne in the flesh beyond mind the eternal Life, Whom touching with bitter lips, Hades was abolished, O most holy Virgin Mother!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: ло стремленіе, рожши плотію въистинну паче оума жизнь вѣчную, еиже прикося оусты горькими Адъ оупразднися. Престаа Мти Дво.
items.english_text: Sitting upon the throne in Master's state, Thy Son placed thee, O pure one, at His right hand, shining brightly with the gold of divine virtues, rendering honor unto thee as His Mother, O all-immaculate one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: На пртолѣ сѣдя Снъ твои влчнѣ ѡдесны тя златми бжтвенных добродѣтелей свѣтъ сїяющу, ѡдесную постави себе чистаа: дая честь ꙗко Матери тебѣ всенепорочнаа.
items.english_text: Beyond mind is thy childbirth, O Mother of God; for the conception in thee was without a man, and the birth was virginal; for God is He Who was born, Whom magnifying, we call thee blessed, O Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Паче оума ржтво ти Бгомати: безмужа бо зачатїе в тебѣ, й дѣвки рожденїе бысть; ибо Бгъ есть рождеися, егоже величающе тя Дво оублажаемъ.
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 5:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: На Хвалитехъ Стихиры воскресны. Глас .є҃:
items.english_text: O Lord, though the tomb was sealed by transgressors of the law, Thou didst come forth from the tomb even as Thou wast born of the Mother of God. Thine incorporeal Angels knew not how Thou didst take flesh; the soldiers who guarded Thee perceived not when Thou didst arise; for both were sealed to those who would inquire, but the marvels were revealed unto those who bow down in faith before the mystery: which as we hymn, grant unto us joy and great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди, запечатлѣнну Гробу ѿ законопреступникъ: проиде из Гроба, ꙗкоже родися ѿ Бца. Не разумѣша како воплотися безплотнїи твои Аггли. Нечюша когда воскрсе стрегущїи тя воини. Ѡбоа бо запечатлѣшася йспытующимъ: ꙗвишажеся чудеса, кланяющимся вѣрою таинству, еже въспѣвающи: воздаждь намъ радость, й велїю млть.
items.english_text: O Lord, having shattered the eternal bars and broken the bonds asunder, Thou didst arise from the tomb, leaving behind Thy grave-clothes (fol. 87)[^105] as a witness of Thy true three-day burial, and Thou didst go before into Galilee, O Thou Who wast guarded in the cave. Great is Thy mercy, O incomprehensible Savior: have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди, верїа вѣчныа сокрушъ, й ѹзы расторгъ, ѿ Гроба воскрлъ еси, ѡставл своя погребтелнаѧ
items.english_text: O Lord, the women ran unto the tomb to see Thee, the Christ Who suffered for our sake; and having arrived, they found an Angel sitting upon the stone, rolled away through fear, and he cried unto them, saying: The Lord is risen! Say unto the disciples that He is risen from the dead, saving our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: наѧ, въ свидѣтелство истиннаго тридневнаго ти погребенїа: й предварилъ еси въ Галилеи, иже въ пещери стрегомый. велїа твоа млть: непостижимый, Спсе, помилуй насъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, even as Thou didst come forth from the sealed tomb, so didst Thou enter, the doors being shut, unto Thy disciples, showing them the bodily passions which Thou didst endure, O long-suffering Savior; as of the seed of David Thou didst endure wounds, and as the Son of God Thou didst set the world free. Great is Thy mercy, O incomprehensible Savior: have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди, жены текоша на Гробъ, видѣти тебе Хрта: йже насъ ради пострашаго. й пришедше, ѡбрѣтоша Аггла на камени сѣдящи, страхомъ ѿкаленнѣмъ: й къ нимъ возопи гла: воскрсе Гдь, рецѣте ѹчнико, ꙗко воскрсе ѿ мртвы, спсаяи дша наша.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian [Eastern], the same Tone:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди, ꙗкоже изыиде ѿ запечатлѣнна гроба: тако вниде, й дверемъ затворенно, къ ѹчником своим: показуя имъ телесныа стрти, ꙗже подъятъ, Спсе, долготерпѣ. ꙗко ѿ сѣмени Двдова ꙗзвы претерпѣлъ еси, ꙗко Снъ Бжїй мїра свободилъ еси. велїа твоа млть, непостижимыйи Спсе, помилуй насъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, King of the ages and Creator of all, Who for our sake didst accept crucifixion and burial in the flesh, that Thou mightest set us all free from Hades: Thou art our God; besides Thee we know no other!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди Црю вѣкомъ, й творче всѣхъ, иже на ради распятїе й погребенїе плотїю прїемъ: да насъ ѿ Ада свободиши всѣ. Ты еси Бгъ нашъ: развѣ тебе, йнаго незнаемъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, who shall declare Thy supremely radiant marvels, or who shall tell of Thy fearful mysteries? For having become man for our sake as Thou Thyself didst desire, Thou didst manifest the dominion of Thy power; and by Thy Cross Thou didst open Paradise unto the Thief, and by Thy burial Thou didst shatter the bars of Hades, and by Thy Resurrection Thou didst enrich all things: O compassionate One, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearing women, having reached Thy tomb very early, sought to anoint Thee with myrrh, the immortal Word and God; and having been instructed by the words of the Angel, they returned with joy to proclaim openly unto the Apostles that the Life of all is risen, and Thou grantest cleansing and great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Concerning the God-receiving tomb, the guards said unto the Jews: O your vainly-wise counsel! Ye attempted to guard the Incircumscribable; in vain did ye labor! Wishing to hide the Resurrection of the Crucified, ye clearly revealed it by your vainly-wise assembly! Why do ye again take counsel to conceal that which cannot be hidden? Rather, hear from us and be willing to believe the truth of what has come to pass: a lightning-bearing Angel, (fol. 88)[^106] having descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, through fear of whom we were held fast by deadness; and crying out with a mighty voice unto the wise Myrrh-bearing women, he said: Do ye not behold the slaying of the guards, and the breaking of the seals, and the emptying of Hades? Why do ye seek Him as dead Who abolished the victory of Hades and shattered the sting of death? Go quickly and announce the good tidings of the Resurrection unto the Apostles, crying out without fear: Truly the Lord is risen, having great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the sessional hymns: 'God is the Lord', in Tone 5. Troparion: 'The Word, co-unoriginate...'; Glory, both now: 'Rejoice, gate of the Lord...' After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5

items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 5:*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The Thief, believing Thee to be God upon the Cross, confessed Thee purely from the heart, O Christ, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Unto Him Who from the wood of the Cross made life to blossom forth for our race, having withered the curse that came from the tree: as Savior and Creator let [us sing] with one accord!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: By Thy death, O Christ, [Thou didst destroy the dominion] of death, and didst raise up together with Thyself those who had [died] from the ages, [as they sing unto Thee as] the true God and our Savior!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Having arrived at Thy tomb, O Christ, the honorable women sought to anoint Thee, the Life-giver, with myrrh; and an Angel appeared unto them, crying: Truly the Lord is risen!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, between the two condemned Thieves, one indeed blaspheming Thee was condemned righteously, while the other, confessing Thee, went to dwell in Paradise!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The utterance of Thine Apostles filled all the earth, O Christ, and drove away the night of godlessness, shining the light of knowledge upon all the faithful!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: We bow down before Thee, O Trinity Unity, unoriginate and equally honorable; and we glorify Thee with the hosts on high, crying out in a Trinitarian manner: Holy art Thou, O unoriginate God!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 5)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Rejoice, O living temple of God, and impassable gate! Rejoice, O unburnt and fiery throne! Rejoice, O Mother of Emmanuel, Christ our God!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 6:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Having victory over Hades, O Christ, Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, that Thou mightest raise up together with Thyself those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, free among the dead, pouring forth life from Thine own light: O almighty Savior, have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Today Christ, having trampled down death, is risen even as He said, and granted joy unto the world, that we all crying out might say this hymn: O Fountain of life, O unapproachable Light, almighty Savior, have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Whither shall we sinners flee from Thee, O Lord, Who art in all creation? In heaven Thou Thyself dwellest; in Hades Thou didst trample down death; into the depths of the sea, even there is Thy hand, O Master. Unto Thee we flee, and falling down before Thee we pray: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian [Eastern], the same Tone:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: In Thy Cross do we boast, O Christ, and Thy Resurrection do we hymn and glorify; for Thou art our God, besides Thee we know no other!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Glory to Thy power, O Lord, for Thou didst abolish him that had the dominion of death, and hast renewed us by Thy Cross, granting unto us life and incorruption!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Ever blessing the Lord, we hymn His Resurrection; for having endured the Crucifixion, by death He destroyed death!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Thy burial, O Master, having shattered and torn asunder the bonds of Hades, and Thy Resurrection from the dead enlightened the world: O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Glory, both now. Theotokion [Dogmatikon], Tone 6:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Who does not call thee blessed, O all-holy Virgin? Or who will not sing of thy most pure childbirth? For the only-begotten Son, Who shone forth timelessly from the Father, the Same came forth from thee, pure one, having ineffably become incarnate, being God by nature, and [having become man] by nature for our sake; not divided into two persons, but known in two natures without confusion. Him beseech, O pure and all-blessed one, that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 6:* [^108]

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, the Angels hymn in the heavens: vouchsafe also us on earth to hymn and glorify Thee with a pure heart!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Having shattered the brazen gates and smashed the bars of Hades, as God almighty Thou didst raise up the fallen human race; therefore we also cry out with one accord: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Desiring to set us upright from the ancient corruption, O Christ, Thou wast nailed to the Cross and placed in the tomb; Whom the Myrrh-bearing women sought with tears, and weeping said: Woe unto us, O Savior of all! How didst Thou accept to dwell in a tomb? And having dwelt therein willingly, how wast Thou stolen away? How wast Thou moved? What place hid Thy life-bearing Body? But, O Master, appear unto us as Thou didst promise, and assuage our tearful lamentation! And as they wept, an Angel cried unto them: Cease from weeping, and say unto the Apostles that the Lord is risen, granting cleansing and great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Thou wast crucified...

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Thou wast crucified as Thou didst will, O Christ, and by Thy burial Thou didst take death captive; on the third day Thou didst arise as God with glory, granting eternal life and great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: My Creator and Deliverer, Christ the Lord, having come forth from thy womb, O all-pure one, and having clothed Himself in me, delivered Adam from the first curse; therefore unto thee, O all-pure one, as truly the Mother of God and Virgin, we cry unceasingly with the Angel's voice: Rejoice, O Lady, protectress, and veil, and salvation of our souls!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart. Trisagion. Our Father:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb, and the guards became as dead; and Mary stood at the tomb, seeking Thy most pure Body. Having despoiled Hades, and not being tempted by it, Thou didst meet the Virgin, granting life: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: He Who called His Mother blessed, came unto the Passion by voluntary counsel, shining forth upon the Cross, seeking to search out Adam, and saying unto the Angels: Rejoice with Me, (fol. 91)[^109] for the lost coin has been found! O Thou Who hast wisely ordered all things, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity. The acrostic whereof is: A six-fold song I offer unto Thee, O Godhead:*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 6. Heirmos: Traversing the deep on foot as on dry land...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: We hymn the three God-originating Hypostases of the unitary essence, the unchangeable Form of the good God Who loves mankind, Who grants us cleansing of transgressions!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O supersubstantial Lord, One and tri-radiant in personal characters, existing in one Godhead: grant us understanding, and vouchsafe us Thy divine radiance!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Adorning as a bride the Church from the Gentiles, Paul taught her to worship Thee, the one three-hypostatic God, from Whom, and through Whom, and in Whom all things were made!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: From thy womb came forth the noetic Sun, O Mother of God, illuminating us with the rays of the tri-radiant Godhead Whom hymning, we piously call thee blessed!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: There is none holy as Thou, O Lord...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O tri-radiant God, Who hast adorned the heavenly ranks, Thou didst appoint them to sing unto Thee with thrice-holy voices; with them receive also us who hymn Thy goodness!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Hymning the one unchangeable, co-formal, unitary Trinitarian Principle of the Godhead, we fervently pray: Send down now unto us forgiveness of our many sins!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O unoriginate Mind, the Father, O co-formal Word of God, and O divine, good, and upright Spirit: preserve those who faithfully hymn Thy dominion, as Thou art compassionate!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: My God, having become man according to essence in thy womb, O pure one, destroyed the pasture of corruption, and alone set our forebears free from the former condemnation!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O Master God, look down from heaven and behold our lowliness, as Thou art generous, and have compassion, O all-good Lover of mankind; for we have no hope from anywhere of receiving forgiveness for the evil things wherein we have sinned: therefore be Thou with us, and none shall be against us!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O pure Lady, look down, O Mother of God, behold the painfulness of our wounds, and take pity, O all-pure one, and heal the burning of conscience, bedewing it with thy mercy, and saying unto thy servants: I am with you, and none shall be against you! [^110]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Christ is my power, God and Lord!" the...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O tri-radiant Unity, Thou Who exaltest the mind: lift up swiftly the soul and heart of Thy singers, and vouchsafe them Thy radiance and brightness!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Turn us and transform us from every malice unto virtue, O only Uncircumscribed and Unchangeable One, and enlighten us with Thy rays!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Having conceived before, Thou didst wisely establish the ranks of Angels as servants of Thy goodness, O three-hypostatic Unity; with them receive also my praise!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: He Who by nature is uncreated, ever-existing God, taking upon Himself created human nature, formed it again in thy holy womb, O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: With Thy Divine light, O Good One, illumine...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Contemplating the God-originating nature, providential and saving of all, which is the Master, tri-radiant and yet One: unto Thee we rise early, asking forgiveness of our transgressions!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O unoriginate God the Father, and co-ever-existing Son, and Holy Spirit: O monarchic Trinity, establish Thy singers, and deliver them from every temptation and tribulation!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Guide me by Thy beneficent rays, and lead me ever unto the well-pleasing of Thy three-hypostatic Godhead, O Sun of glory, and make me a partaker of Thy divine Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O unchangeable Word of God, Who upholdest and preservest all things by Thine almighty hand: protect and preserve those who glorify Thee, through the prayers of the Mother of God who bore Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Being swallowed up by the abyss of sins...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Grant wisdom and understanding, O tri-radiant Principle of the Godhead, unto Thy singers, and vouchsafe that all may be illumined with the rays of the beauty of Thy beneficent goodness! *(Twice)*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O Light indivisible according to essence, tri-radiant, almighty, unapproachable: illuminate the hearts of those who faithfully praise Thy dominion, and wing them unto divine love!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: In thee, O Ever-Virgin, the Sustainer and Lord of all openly made His abode, and taught mankind to bow down before the one tri-radiant form of the Godhead! [^111]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O Father and Son, with the Holy Spirit: look upon us who worship Thee in faith and glorify Thy dominion, O compassionate One, with our earth-born clay; for we know no other besides Thee: and cry Thou unto those who hymn Thee: I am with you, and none shall be against you!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Look upon us, O all-hymned Mother of God, shine forth enlightenment upon darkened hearts, and illumine thy flock, O all-pure one; for as much as thou wilt, thou art able to do, as thou art the Mother of thy Creator: and cry unto those who pray unto thee: I am with you, and none shall be against you!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Angel made the furnace sprinkle dew for...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Establish in me a steadfast mind, O Unity tri-radiant in personal characters, so as to keep and observe Thy divine commandments, and ever to sing unto Thee with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: As Thou art hymned through identity of nature, O ineffably unitary God, yet bearing the number of a Trinity in Persons: preserve us all from diverse temptations and assaults!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: As co-natural and co-ever-existing we glorify Thee, the one God according to essence, O Trinity, clearly presenting what is distinct in unconfused hypostatic properties simply in an unchangeable Form!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The supersubstantial God accepted our mixture openly from thy pure womb, O all-pure one, in His love for mankind, and taught all to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Grant me swiftly cleansing of transgressions and deliverance from multiform passions, O co-formal Trinity, three-hypostatic Unity: that I may glorify Thee unto all ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Known as rich in mercy, since Thou art a merciful God: have mercy upon all, O tri-radiant Unity and all-good Trinity, who doxologize Thy majesty!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: From the Light, the ever-existing Father, the co-ever-existing Light, the begotten Word, with the Light, the proceeding Spirit, do we glorify in faith, and supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Thou didst bring forth the Physician of mankind, O all-pure one, the almighty Word, (fol. 94)[^112] Christ the Lord, Who heals the ancestral wounds of all who supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: It is impossible for men to see God...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The Cherubic ranks, O Master, unable to gaze upon the beauty of Thy glory, covering themselves with their wings, unceasingly cry out the Trinitarian hymn, glorifying the three-hypostatic dominion of Thy unitary Godhead!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Grant Thy rays, O unsetting Sun, unto the hearts of Thy servants: and enlighten their souls, and deliver them from many transgressions, O only All-merciful and Three-hypostatic One, and vouchsafe us Thine incorruptible life!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O true Godhead, the Light equally honorable, tri-solar, and light-creating: illuminate those who hymn Thee in faith, and deliver them from dark wickedness, and vouchsafe them Thy most radiant mansions, as Thou art supremely good!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Thy Son wisely created man of old, O Virgin, and through thee He renewed him when corrupted, O all-hymned one, and filled with the unwaning rays of divine light all who in faith glorify thee as the true Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
