items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: The tomb being opened and Hades weeping, Mary cried unto the hidden Apostles: Come forth, ye workers of the vineyard, preach the word of the Resurrection! The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Life lay in the tomb, and with a seal the stone was sealed; as a sleeping king the soldiers guarded Christ, and having struck His enemies with blindness, the Lord is risen!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin, pray Thy Son, Christ our God, Who was willingly nailed unto the Cross and is risen from the dead, that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O Lord, Mary Magdalene, standing before Thy tomb, wept, crying aloud, and supposing Thee to be the gardener, said: Where hast Thou laid the eternal Life? Where hast Thou hidden Him Who sits upon the Cherubic throne? For those who guarded Him became as dead from fear. Either give me my Lord, or cry out with me: (fol. 95)[^113] O Thou Who wast among the dead and hast raised the dead, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Jonah prefigured Thy tomb, and Simeon makes known Thy divine rising, O immortal Lord; for Thou didst descend into the tomb as dead, O Thou Who didst destroy the gates of Hades, and Thou didst arise without corruption as Master, for the salvation of the world, O Christ our God, Who hast enlightened those who were in darkness!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Gideon prefigured the conception, and David tells of thy childbirth, O Mother of God; for like rain upon the fleece, the Word descended into thy womb, and thou didst bud forth without seed, O holy earth, the salvation of the world, Christ our God, O full of grace!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: By Thy voluntary and life-creating death, O Christ, having shattered the gates of Hades as God, Thou didst open the ancient Paradise unto us, and having risen from the dead, Thou didst deliver our life from corruption!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Then the Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi], Antiphon 1, Tone 6:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Unto heaven do I lift up mine eyes, unto Thee, O Word: have compassion upon me, that I may live unto Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Have mercy upon us who are despised, fashioning us as vessels well-fitted for Thee, O Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: In the Holy Spirit is the cause of all salvation; if upon anyone He breathes worthily, quickly does He lift him up from earthly things, wings him, makes him grow, and establishes him on high!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: [Through the Holy Spirit...]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: If the Lord had not been among us, not one of us would have been able to withstand the enemy's warfare; for they that conquer are exalted from hence!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Let not my soul be seized by their teeth like a bird, O Word: woe is me! how shall I escape the enemy, being a lover of sin?

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is deification unto all, good will, understanding, peace, and blessing; for He works equally with the Father and the Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: They that trust in the Lord are fearful unto enemies and marvelous unto all; for they look on high!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Unto iniquities the righteous lot will not stretch out its hands, having Thee as Helper, O Savior!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Of the Holy Spirit is the dominion over all, Whom the hosts on high worship, together with every breath below!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: O Lord, stir up Thy power, and come to save us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Let every breath praise the Lord. The Matins Resurrection Gospel.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Canon, Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* [^114]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Traversing the deep on foot as on dry land, Israel beheld the pursuer Pharaoh drowning, and cried out: Let us sing a song of victory unto God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: With outstretched palms upon the Cross, O good Jesus, Thou didst fulfill the Father's good pleasure in all things; therefore a song of victory we all sing unto Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: In fear, as a maidservant, death, having been commanded, drew near unto Thee, the Master of life, Who through it grantest us endless life and resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: Having received Thine own Creator, as He Himself willed, ineffably incarnate from thy seedless womb, O pure one, thou didst truly appear as the Lady of creation!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: By the wave of the sea...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Гди, превозсїяющая твоа чудеса, кто исповѣст, или кто возвѣститъ, страшная твоа таинства: ко-
items.english_text: In fear the gates of death open unto Thee, and the eternal bars are torn asunder; for by Thy venerable descent the dead of old arose, thankfully hymning Thy Resurrection, O Christ!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Въ ровѣ положися Хе преисподнѣмъ, мертвъ бывъ, й оумертвилъ еси оумертвителя: й оузники иже въ адѣ свободилъ еси. чтное твое блко, славящихъ воскресеніе.
items.english_text: Thou wast laid in the lowest pit, O Christ, having become dead, and Thou didst slay the slayer, and didst deliver the prisoners in Hades who glorify Thy venerable Resurrection, O Master!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Радуйся свѣтоносная сѣни и свѣщниче, цркви й Трапезо, й Горо стая. радуйся полато славы: й Пртоле Бга ншго. радуйся стѣно необоримая намъ воспѣвающимъ.
items.english_text: Rejoice, light-bearing tabernacle and candlestick, church and table, and holy mountain! Rejoice, palace of glory and throne of our God! Rejoice, unassailable rampart unto us who sing praise!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Причащшися Еѵва, сада преслушаннаго крашна; клятву въведе: но сїю разрѣшила еси чтая блгословенїю началника, Хрта рождши.
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: As on dry land...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Иже бисера бжтвенныхъ молныи Хрта порождша, страстей моихъ мглу, й согрѣшеніи смощеніе чтая разжени, свѣтомъ твоеѧ свѣтлости.
items.english_text: Having partaken of the pleasant garden of disobedience, Eve brought in the curse; but this hast thou loosed, O pure one, having given birth to the Author of blessing, Christ!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗзыкомъ чаднїе Іаковъ, йстебе воплощаемаго провидяше тайно, оуцѣныма ѡчима Бга: йзбавляющаго насъ ходотайствомъ ти.
items.english_text: Having given birth to Christ, the Pearl of divine lightnings: disperse the mist of my passions and the turmoil of my transgressions, O pure one, by the light of thy brightness!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Оскꙋдѣвшымъ княземъ, ѿ колѣна Іудова, пречтая, Снъ твой й Бгъ, проше кождъ наконьцы земными, ннѣ воистинну воцарись.
items.english_text: With prophetic eyes Jacob secretly foresaw the expectation of the nations, God incarnate from thee, delivering us through thine intercession!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Нѣсть ста, ꙗкоже ты Гди Бже мой, вознесый рогъ вѣрныхъ
items.english_text: The rulers from the tribe of Judah having failed, O all-pure one, Thy Son and God came forth, a Leader unto the ends of the earth, and now reigns in truth!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: ныхъ твоихъ блаже, и оутверждеи ихъ накамены. исповѣданія твоего.
items.english_text: There is none holy as Thou, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established them upon the rock of Thy confession!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Бга распинаема плотію, зрящи тварь растаяшеся страхомъ. но вседержительною дланію насъ ради Распятаго крѣпко держима бѣ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* [^115]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Смертію смерть разоренна, лежитъ ѡкаꙗнная бездыханіа живота бо нетерпящи бжтвеннаго прираженіа, оумерщвляется крѣпкїй, и даруется всѣмъ воскресеніе.
items.english_text: Beholding God crucified in the flesh, creation dissolved in fear; yet by the almighty hand of Him Who was crucified for our sake, it was firmly held together.

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Бжтвеннаго ржтва ти чтая, всякїй естества чинъ превосходитъ чꙋдо, Бга бо, паче естества зачала еси въ чревѣ: и рождши пребываеши прно Дваа.
items.english_text: Shattered by death, wretched death lies breathless; for unable to endure the divine assault of Life, the strong one is slain, and resurrection is granted unto all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе воскршаго трїдневно, й женамъ ꙗвльшагося мироносицамъ Спсе: йсим Радуйтеся рекша, исповѣдающе, глемъ: Нѣсть ста развѣ тебе Гди человеколюбче.
items.english_text: The wonder of thy divine childbirth, O pure one, surpasses every order of nature; for beyond nature thou didst conceive God in thy womb, and having given birth, thou remainest ever a Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Слава твоему востанію Спсе нашъ, ꙗко насъ ѿ ада, тлѣніа, й смерти исхитилъ еси, ꙗко всесиленъ: и поюще глемъ, Нѣсть ста развѣ тебе Гди человѣколюбче. Второ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: Hanging Thee upon the waters...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Confessing Thee Who didst arise on the third day and appeared unto the Myrrh-bearing women, O Savior, and said unto them: "Rejoice!", we say: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord, Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Glory to Thy rising, O our Savior, for Thou hast snatched us from Hades, corruption, and death, as Thou art almighty; and singing we say: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord, Lover of mankind! *(Twice)*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: [Confessing] the Word incarnate from the holy Child of God incarnate Word from the holy Child of God, and Him Who saved fallen Adam, the first-formed, from deception, we gloriously hymn: There is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: There is none holy as the Lord...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Having ineffably received my corruptible and mortal flesh from thy womb, O all-venerable Mother of God, the Master, having clothed it in incorruption, bound it eternally unto Himself!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Beholding God incarnate from thee, O Virgin, the ranks of Angels were struck with fear, and as the Mother of God, they glorify thee with unceasing hymns!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The Prophet Daniel was struck with awe, beholding thee as the noetic mountain, from whence a stone was cut without hands, which mightily crushed the demonic altars, O Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: No human word nor tongue can worthily praise thee, O Virgin; for from thee without seed, Christ the Giver of life was well-pleased to become incarnate, O all-pure one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church divinely cries aloud, keeping festival in the Lord with a pure mind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The Tree of true life has blossomed forth, O Christ, for the Cross was set up; and being watered with blood and water from Thy corruptless side, it budded forth life unto us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* [^116]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: No longer does the serpent falsely suggest deification unto me; for Christ, the Deifier of human nature, has now unhindered opened unto me the path of life!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Truly ineffable and incomprehensible are the mysteries of thy divinely-fitting childbirth, O Mother of God, both on earth and in heaven, O Ever-Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: Foreseeing Thy divine emptying upon the Cross...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Co-existing divinely with the Father on high, Thou wast bodily nailed unto the Tree for our sake, loosing the curse that was in Paradise, as Thou art almighty!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The all-pure flesh of the Redeemer lying in the tomb was not corrupted, but as almighty He shattered the bars of Hades, and arose in glory on the third day, as God! *(Twice)*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Having risen from the dead, our Savior cried out unto the Myrrh-bearing women, saying: "Rejoice!", and called unto them: Go, announce the good tidings unto My Apostles!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: Christ is my power...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The assembly gathered through thee hymns thee, O all-pure and all-spotless one, and piously singing we cry aloud: Blessed art thou, O Ever-Virgin, who hast given birth to God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth to the unsetting Light, O Virgin, shining in the flesh unto those who are in the darkness of life, O all-blessed one, and unto those who hymn thee, thou hast poured forth joy, O Ever-Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Grace has blossomed forth, the Law has ceased through thee, O all-hymned one; for thou, O pure one, didst give birth to the Lord Who grants us forgiveness forever, O Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The tasting of the garden showed mankind to be dead; but the Tree of Life that appeared from thee, O all-pure one, raised them up, and made them heirs of the delight of Paradise!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: With Thy divine light, O Good One, enlighten with love the souls of those who rise early unto Thee, I pray, that they may behold Thee, the Word of God, the true God, drawing them forth from the darkness of sin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The Cherubim now yields unto me, and the flaming sword turns its back before me, O Master, having beheld Thee, the Word of God, the true God, making a way into Paradise for the Thief!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: No longer do I fear the return unto the earth, O Master Christ; for from the earth Thou didst lead me up, who was forgotten, because of Thy great compassion, unto the height of incorruption by Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Save those who confess thee from the soul to be the Mother of God, O good Lady of the world; for we have gained thee as an unconquerable intercessor, the true Theotokos!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: With Thy Divine light, O Good One, illumine...* [^117]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Out of compassion, O Good One, having taken upon Thyself our form, Thou wast willingly nailed unto the Cross for my sake, who had formerly rejected Thy holy commandment through eating; and Thou diest as man, granting me life!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Beholding Thee upon the throne as God, and among the dead reckoned as dead, wretched Hades vomited forth those whom it formerly held; and on the third day, O Mighty One, Thou didst co-resurrect fallen nature, and Thou Thyself didst enlighten the whole world, O Christ, as Thou art merciful!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst not suffer corruption in thy womb, having received a virginal childbirth, but again as before thou didst remain, O unwedded Mother of God; therefore pray fervently for thy flock that glorifies thee, that we may be delivered from temptations and perils!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: Shining forth brightly in the morning...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Having shone forth brightly in the morning, a divine dwelling was prepared for the Master, O all-hymned one; for thou alone didst appear as the Mother of God, O pure one, having carried Him in thine arms as an infant!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Possessing noetic beauty, fair above all in thy soul, thou wast called the Bride of God, sealed with virginity, O pure one, and illuminating the world with the light of purity!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Let the assembly of the impious lament, who do not openly confess thee as the pure Mother of God; for thou hast appeared unto us as the gate of divine light, driving away the darkness of sins!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Beholding the sea of life surging with the storm of temptations, and fleeing unto Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Greatly-merciful One!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Nailed with nails, O Master, Thou didst wipe away the curse that was against us; and pierced with a spear in the side, tearing up the handwriting of Adam, Thou didst deliver the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Adam was brought down, tripped by deceit unto the abyss of Hades; but as God and merciful, Thou didst descend in search of human nature, and taking it upon Thy shoulders, didst raise it up with Thyself!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: O all-pure Lady, who didst give birth to the Lord, the Helmsman of the universe: calm the unstable and fierce tumult of my passions, and grant stillness unto my heart!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: Jonah was seized, yet not held fast...* [^118]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: How Thou didst endure wounds, insults, and spitting, O Word! Thou didst willingly suffer in the flesh as man, being crucified upon the Tree between two Thieves, and Thou didst save our nature from corruption, as Thou art almighty!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou wast laid below in the tomb for my sake, O Savior, as dead, and Thou didst shine forth light unto those held in darkness and the shadow of death, and didst shine forth on the third day; and meeting the Myrrh-bearing women, Thou didst cry aloud unto them: Truly rejoice, and tell further unto My Apostles!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: O Virgin, favored Mother and Bride of God, who without knowing man didst receive in thy womb and bear incarnate Him Who was begotten of the unoriginate Father before the ages: pray Him on behalf of us all, that He send down the multitude of His compassions unto us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: Beholding the sea of life...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Great Moses among the Prophets prefigured thee as the Ark, the Table, the Candlestick, and the Urn, figuratively signifying the incarnation of the Most High from thee, O Virgin Mother!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Death is slain, and the corruption of Adam's condemnation is abolished O Lady, having clashed against Thy fruit; for thou didst bear Life, delivering from corruption those who hymn thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The Law grew weak and the shadow passed away, when grace beyond mind and understanding appeared unto me through the birth of God and the Savior from thee, O Virgin, much-hymned one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: With His life-originating palm, Christ God, the Giver of life, having raised up all the dead from the dark valleys, granted resurrection unto the human race; for He is the Savior of all, the resurrection and life, and God of all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thy Cross and burial, O Giver of life, we the faithful hymn and venerate, for Thou hast bound Hades, O Immortal One, as almighty God, and hast raised the dead with Thyself, and shattered the gates of death, and cast down the dominion of Hades as God! Therefore we earth-born doxologize Thee with love, Who art risen, and hast cast down the all-destructive power of the enemy, and raised up all who believe in Thee, and delivered the world from the serpent's arrows and from the enemy's deception, as Thou art God of all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* [^119]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The Angel made the furnace bedewing for the holy children, while the command of God consumed the Chaldeans, persuading the tyrant to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Lamenting at Thy Passion, the sun clothed itself in gloom, and by day throughout all the earth the light was darkened, O Master, singing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The nethermost regions clothed themselves in light at Thy descent, O Christ; and the Forefather appeared full of gladness, dancing and leaping for joy, crying: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Hymning the Trinity ruling over all, the three-hypostatic Nature, the boundless goodness, and the abyss of light, let us the faithful cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: Ineffable wonder...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The lawless children of the impious crucified Thee, the Savior, at the Place of the Skull; Who didst shatter the brazen gates and bars for our salvation, as we sing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Redeemer!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst destroy the dominion of death and didst arise, granting resurrection unto those who truly glorify Thee as Lord, and in orthodox faith cry unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God our Redeemer! *(Twice)*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth to One of the Trinity, O all-pure one, Who appeared upon earth in two natures out of mercy; Whom pray unceasingly to save our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: The furnace did not burn the three youths...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The furnace did not burn the three youths, prefiguring thy childbirth; for the divine fire did not consume thee, but took up its abode in thee, and taught all to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The ends of the earth bless thee, O all-venerable Mother, as thou didst foretell; illumined by the radiant rays of thy light, and singing in grace, they cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The all-evil serpent plunged his destructive fangs into me; but these Thy Son shattered, O Mother of God, granting us strength to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou alone becamest the propitiation of our nature, O divinely-blessed one; for carrying in thine arms God Who sits upon the Cherubic shoulders, thou criest aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the holy ones, and didst consume the sacrifice of the righteous one with water; for Thou doest all things, O Christ, whatsoever Thou willest, and we supremely exalt Thee unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The Jewish people, who of old were murderers of the Prophets, envy now made murderers of God, lifting Thee upon the Cross, O Word of God; Whom we supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Without leaving the vault of heaven, and descending into Hades, Thou didst raise up entirely the human being lying in the dungheap, O Christ, who supremely exalts Thee unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The one Nature of the Trinity, of unreckonable power, surpassing every word, nature, and thought, we ever preach in orthodox manner and supremely exalt unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: Be astonished, O heaven...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Every ear was astonished at how the Most High willingly descended unto the earth, shattered the power of Hades by His Crucifixion and burial, and raised all to cry: Bless Him, ye children; praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye peoples, unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: O Thine ineffable love for mankind, O Christ, and unspeakable goodness! For seeing me perishing in the prison of Hades, having endured the Passion Thou didst snatch me away; therefore we bless Thee, the Master of all, and supremely exalt Thee unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Rejoice, Gate of God! Rejoice, rampart of the faithful Rejoice, Unwedded Mary! Rejoice, all-pure Mother of God! Rejoice, thou who alone didst bear God for the earth-born, unto Whom we cry: Bless Him, ye children; praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye peoples, unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: In a vesture of gold...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Having adorned thee with a vesture of gold like a Queen, illumining thee with the ray of the Spirit, Thy Son set thee at His right hand, O all-pure one; Whom supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: He Who established the world by His sole will borrowed flesh from thy most pure womb, desiring to fashion it again from above; Whom supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: By the union of the Word with me, man, thou becamest a divine dwelling, O all-pure one, shining brightly with the splendor of virginity; therefore we hymn thee unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: The golden candlestick prefigured thee, who ineffably received the unapproachable Light that enlightens all things with its understanding; therefore we hymn thee, O pure one, unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: It is not possible for man to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O all-pure one, the Word was manifested unto us incarnate, Whom magnifying, together with the heavenly hosts we call thee blessed!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst remain unpartaker of passions, O Word of God, though sharing in sufferings in the flesh; but Thou loosest man from passions, having become subject to passions through Thy Passion, O our Savior, for Thou alone art passionless and almighty!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Having accepted mortal corruption, Thou didst deliver our nature from corruption, Thy body remaining untasting thereof; and Thy life-creating and divine soul, O Master, was not abandoned in Hades, but rising as from sleep, Thou didst raise us up with Thyself!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: God the Father, and the co-unoriginate Son, all of us earth-born glorify with pure lips; and honoring the ineffable and all-glorious power of the All-holy Spirit, we confess the one almighty, indivisible Trinity!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: Weep not for Me, O Mother...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Though Thou didst descend into the tomb as dead, O Giver of life, yet Thou didst tear asunder the power of Hades, O Christ, and didst raise with Thyself the dead whom it had formerly swallowed; and as God Thou didst grant resurrection unto all who magnify Thee in faith and love!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Let creation rejoice, and let all the earth-born be glad; for Hades, the enemy, has been despoiled! Christ is risen, and the first-formed arose with Him in glory, being delivered from corruption; unto the Myrrh-bearing women the Angel cries: Let creation rejoice, and let it blossom like a lily! For Christ is risen from the dead as God; where is thy victory, O Hades? He has cast thee down to the earth, having exalted our horn, as He is compassionate!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Creation rejoices with thy childbirth, O Virgin; for Bethlehem opened Eden unto us, and enjoying the Tree of Life in faith, we cry fervently: Fulfill our petitions, O Lady!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: It is not possible for man to see God...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: A Star shining with the rays of the Godhead from Jacob shone forth unto those held by darkness; for through thee, O all-holy one, Christ God the Word was incarnate, by Whom being enlightened, with the heavenly hosts we call thee blessed!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Strengthened by thy power and grace, I have fervently offered a hymn from the heart unto thee; do thou receive it, O pure Virgin, granting in return thy radiant grace from incorruptible treasures, O divinely-blessed one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst appear openly as a divinely-woven loom, whereon the Word wove the vesture of the flesh, deifying my form, O Virgin; and clothed therein, He saved all who with a pure mind magnify thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Resurrection has now been granted unto the dead by thine ineffable and unspeakable childbirth, O all-venerable Mother of God; for Life, clothed in the flesh from thee, has shone forth unto all, and openly destroyed the infirmity of death!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Praises, Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 6:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, is life and resurrection unto Thy people; and hoping thereon, we sing unto Thee, our risen God: Have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thy burial, O Master, opened Paradise unto mankind, and being delivered from corruption, we sing unto Thee, our risen God: Have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: With the Father and the Spirit let us hymn Christ Who is risen from the dead, and cry unto Him: Thou art our life and resurrection, have mercy upon us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: On the third day Thou didst arise from the tomb, O Christ, as it is written, and didst raise our Forefather with Thyself; therefore the human race glorifies Thee, and hymns Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: O Lord, great and fearful is the mystery of Thy Resurrection; for in such manner didst Thou come forth from the tomb like a Bridegroom from His chamber, having shattered death by death that Thou mightest set Adam free; therefore in heaven the Angels dance, and on earth mankind glorifies Thy tender mercy shown unto us, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: O lawless Judeans, where are the seals and the silver coins that ye gave unto the soldiers? The treasure was not stolen, but is risen as mighty; ye yourselves were put to shame, having rejected Christ, the Lord of glory, Who suffered and was buried, and is risen from the dead: worship Him!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Though the tomb was sealed, how were ye robbed, O Judeans, having set a guard and placed signs? While the doors were shut, the King came forth: either produce Him as dead, or worship Him as God, singing with us: Glory to Thy Cross, O Lord, and to Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 6: "The angelic hosts were upon Thy tomb." Glory, both now. Theotokion
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Reaching Thy life-receiving tomb early in the morning with weeping, O Lord, and bearing sweet spices, the Myrrh-bearing women sought to anoint Thy most pure body; but they found a radiant Angel sitting upon the stone, and speaking unto them [^123] saying: Why weep ye for Him Who poured forth life unto the world from His side? Why seek ye the Immortal One in the tomb as dead? Run rather, announce unto His disciples His glorious Resurrection and worldwide joy; through which do Thou Who hast enlightened us also grant cleansing and great mercy!
