items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *At the Divine Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 6:*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom, and save me as the only Lover of mankind!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Adam was deceived by a tree, but by the Tree of the Cross Thou didst again save the Thief who cried: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Let us hymn Christ our God, Who was willingly crucified and buried, and arose in glory on the third day; Who shattered the gates and bars of Hades, O Giver of life, and raised up all who were in Hades, crying: O compassionate Savior, glory to Thy rising!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: [He Who arose from the tomb on the third day, having foretold His rising] before the Passion, [...] let us all harmoniously sing praise [unto Him]!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Having appeared as the light of the world, the Apostles drove away all the darkness of deception by the divine rays of their teachings!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: We doxologize the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, saying: O Holy Trinity, save our souls!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 6)
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Rejoice, gate opened unto God, Who ineffably took up His abode in thee and came forth from thee, O Ever-Virgin!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: *On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, Who shattered the dominion of death and enlightened the human race, crying with the bodiless hosts: O our Creator and Savior, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Thou didst endure the Crucifixion and burial for our sake, O Savior; and by death as God Thou didst slay death. Therefore we worship Thy third-day Resurrection: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Beholding the Resurrection of the Creator, the Apostles marveled, singing angelic praise: this is the glory of the Church, this is the wealth of the Kingdom! O Thou Who didst suffer for our sake: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже ѿ стыя Бгоѡтроковица воплощша-
items.english_text: Though Thou wast seized, O Christ, by lawless men, yet Thou art my God, and I am not ashamed I was scourged on the back, and I do not deny it; I was nailed to the Cross, and I do not conceal it; I boast in Thy Resurrection. For Thy death is my life, O almighty Lover of mankind: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: бїенъ бысть по плещима, й не ѿмѣтаюся: на Кртѣ пригвожденъ бысть, й нетаю: воскрнїем твоимъ хвалюся. смрть бо твоя животъ мой, всесилно члколюбче, Гди слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: Fulfilling David's prophecy, O Christ, Thou didst reveal Thy majesty in Zion unto Thy disciples, showing Thyself praiseworthy and ever glorified together with the Father and the Holy Spirit: first indeed bodiless as the Word, but later incarnate for our sake as man, and risen with power as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Двдкаго Пррочествїа исполняя Хрте, величество въ Сїѡнѣ своимъ оучникомъ ѡкрылъ естъ хвалима показуя себе, й славима прно съ Ѻцемъже й Дхомъ стымъ. первѣе оубо безплотна ꙗко Слова: послѣдиже, на ради воплощенна бывша ꙗко члвка, й въскрша съ властїю, ꙗко члколюбца.
items.english_text: Thou didst descend into Hades, O Christ, as Thou didst will; and Thou didst overthrow death as God and Master, and didst arise on the third day, raising Adam with Thyself from the bonds and corruption of Hades, as he cried out, saying: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Сошелъ еси въ Адъ Хрте, ꙗкоже йзволи: й спроверже смерть, ꙗко Бгъ й Влка: й въскрсе трїдневно, съ воскрсивъ Адама, ѿ Адовыхъ оузъ й тлѣнїа: възывающа й глюща. слава воскрнїю твоемꙋ, едине члколюбче.
items.english_text: Thou wast laid in the tomb as sleeping, O Lord; and Thou didst arise on the third day as mighty in strength, raising Adam with Thyself from the corruption of mortals, as almighty God!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Въ Гробѣ положенъ бы, ꙗко спя Гди: й воскресе трїдневенъ, ꙗко силенъ въ крѣпости, съ воскрсивъ Адама ѿ тля смертных, ꙗко Бгъ всесиленъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast known as a Mother above nature, O Mother of God, and didst remain a Virgin above word and understanding; and the tongue cannot tell the wonder of thy childbirth! Glorious indeed is thy conception, O pure one, and incomprehensible is the manner of thy giving birth; for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome! Therefore, knowing thee all as the Mother of God, we pray thee fervently: intercede that our souls may be saved! [^125]

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Мати оубо познася, паче естества Бце, пребыстьже Двою, паче слова й разꙋма: й чудеси
items.english_text: Risen from the tomb, O Savior of the world, Thou didst raise man with Thyself together with Thy flesh: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: си ржтва твоего, сказати языкъ не можетъ. Преславну оубо сущꙋ, зачатїю чтая: непостиженъ естъ ѡбразъ рожденїя: йдеже бо хощетъ Бгъ, побѣждается есттва чинъ. Тѣмже тя вси, Мтръ бжїю свѣдꙋще, молимътися прилежно, моли сптисѧ душамъ нашимъ.
items.english_text: Come, let us worship Him Who arose from the dead and enlightened all things; for from the tyranny of Hades He set us free by His third-day Resurrection, and granted us life and great mercy!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Воскресъ из Гроба Спсъ мїру: й съ воскрсивъ члвка съ плотїю своего. Гди слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: Descending into Hades, O Christ, Thou didst despoil death, and rising on the third day, Thou didst raise us with Thyself, who glorify Thine almighty rising: O Lord, Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Стих: Господь воцарися, въ лѣпоту облечеся:
items.english_text: Fearful didst Thou appear, O Lord, lying in the tomb as sleeping; but rising on the third day as mighty, Thou didst raise Adam with Thyself, who cried: Glory to Thy Resurrection unto Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind! Glory. Both now.

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Воскршемꙋ йз мертвы, й просвѣтившемꙋ всяческая: прте поклонимся: ѿ Адова бо мꙋчителства на свободилъ е: своимъ трїдневны воскрнїемъ, животъ намъ дарова, й велію мить.
items.english_text: Fleeing under thy protection, O Lady, all of us earth-born cry aloud unto thee: O Mother of God, our hope, deliver us from our boundless transgressions, and save our souls! *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart. Trisagion through Our Father.*

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Стих: Ибо утверди вселенную, яже не подвижится:
items.english_text: Thou didst destroy death by Thy Cross, and didst open Paradise unto the Thief; Thou didst transform the lamentation of the Myrrh-bearing women, and didst command the Apostles to preach that Thou art risen, O Christ God, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Saturday Evening at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 7
items.slavonic_text: Въ адъ сошедъ Хрте, смрть плѣнилъ еси, й трїдневно воскрес, насъ совоскрсилъ еси, славящихъ твое всесилноє востаніе: Гди члвколюбче.
items.english_text: As the treasure of our Resurrection, O all-hymned one, lead up from the pit and depth of transgressions those who trust in thee; for having given birth to our Salvation, thou hast saved those guilty of sin: who before childbirth wast a Virgin, and in childbirth a Virgin, and after childbirth art still a Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Стих: Дому Твоему подобаетъ святыня, Господи, въ долготу дній:
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 7. Heirmos: By Thy nodding upon earth, the form was transformed...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Open my intelligible lips of the heart and material lips unto Thy praise, O thrice-radiant single Godhead of all, that I may sing a light-bestowing hymn of thanksgiving unto Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* [^126]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: That Thou mightest show the exceeding abundance of Thy goodness, Thou didst create man, O Trinity of unassailable power, only as an earthen image of Thy primordial Masterhood, O Creator!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The unoriginate Father having begotten the co-everlasting Word, and the co-unoriginate Spirit having shone forth: grant us to worship the one God, identical in essence and three-hypostatic!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou didst appear unto Moses at the bush, O Word of God, as a cleansing fire that consumed it not at all, prefiguring Thy fleshly incarnation from the Virgin, wherewith Thou didst re-fashion mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: In the beginning, the heavens by Thine almighty word...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Hymning Thee, the Master, as single, thrice-shining, and all-creating, we ask deliverance from sins and trials, O God of unassailable power: do not overlook those who glorify Thy goodness in faith!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: A shoot sprouted forth from the Father, as from an unoriginate root, God the Word, equal in power with the co-sprouting and the divine Spirit; and therefore we the faithful glorify the Trinity in Persons, the one Lordship!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Equally glorified and co-sprouting, we the faithful all doxologize Thee, the three-hypostatic Nature indivisibly and divisibly, the monarchical Trinity; and bowing down, we ask forgiveness of transgressions!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Inalterably Thou wast made like unto men in all things, O Word of God, openly coming forth from the pure Maiden; and Thou didst show unto all the thrice-shining and single Godhead, of inalterable Hypostases in essence!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Have mercy upon Thy servants who have sinned, O Holy Trinity, and receive those who repent unto Thee, O Compassionate One, and vouchsafe forgiveness!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Assuage our souls afflicted with sins, O all-holy Mother of God; deliver from transgressions those who hymn thee, O Bride of God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: All-holding, thrice-radiant Unity, divine Principle and Savior of all: protect now Thy singers, and save them from sorrow, passions, and every affliction!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Through symbolic sayings of Thine incomprehensible [^127] thrice-radiant Godhead, at a loss we sing unto Thee, O Lover of mankind, O Lord, and we glorify Thy power!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: On earth as in heaven, together with the bodiless choirs, O Unity and Trinity, we divide Thee indivisibly, and with love we glorify Thee, as doing good unto all existing things!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Without departing from the Father's glory, Thou didst willingly descend unto our lowliness: incarnate, O supersubstantial One, Thou didst raise us up unto divine glory, as Thou art compassionate!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Night is without light unto the unbelieving, O...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: O light-originating Nature, Trinity in hypostatic forms, and Unity in counsel, glory, and honor: establish us in Thy love!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Glorifying the Mind, the Word, and the Spirit, one divine-principled and thrice-solar Nature, we pray to be snatched away from trials and all afflictions!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Taking form in human nature from the holy Virgin, O Word of God, Thou didst teach us to hymn the Trinity in Unity, of one form and co-enthroned!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Sailing in the surge of the billows of...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The co-glorified dominion, and the single-principled divine Principle: existing in three Hypostases, without confusion with one another we glorify, possessing difference only in the manner of subsistence of each personal property!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The intelligible ranks of angelic splendors praise Thee, the thrice-solar divine Principle; with whom also we with earthen lips, as the Creator of all things, hymn and faithfully glorify as one!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: By an incomprehensible word, the Word begotten of the Father the Sun, another Sun before the ages, shone forth at the end of times from the Virgin, and proclaimed the one incomprehensible God in three Persons!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: O consubstantial Trinity, three-hypostatic Unity: have mercy upon those whom Thou didst create, O Immortal One, burning up the malice of sinners, and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn Thy compassion: O our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Brighter than fire, more efficacious than light is the mercy of thy goodness, O Lady, burning up the sins of mankind, and bedewing the thoughts of those who praise thy wonders, O most immaculate Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* [^128]

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Ever shining with light-beaming flashes, O thrice-radiant God, unapproachable and supersubstantial Unity: save those who piously believe in Thee, O Master, and bow down before Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Obeying the sayings of the divine Prophets, Thee alone as God we glorify in every way in three Persons, crying thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: With earthen lips together with the immaterial ranks we sing hymns unto Thee, O Holy Trinity, in unity of essence, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: That He Who fashioned Adam might renew him again, He openly became man from thee, bringing mankind to life, who cry thus: Blessed, O all-pure one, is the fruit of thy womb!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Unconsumed by fire, communicating at Sinai...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Vouchsafe the hearts of Thy singers to be enlightened with the light-bestowing rays of the thrice-shining Sun, and grant now to all who hymn Thy majesty in similar faith, ever to behold Thy beauty as far as is possible, O Unity-Trinity, unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou holdest all things, O Trinitarian and single unoriginate Lordship; and Thou rulest both heaven and earth. Therefore, drawn ever by Thy love, preserve Thy singers to sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; hymn and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: By Thy grace make me a temple of Thy thrice-radiant dawn, O Lover of mankind; and show me unapproachable in participation and communion unto invisible enemies and fleshly passions, O Master, my single-principled God and Lord of glory, to hymn Thee, O God, unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The divine-principled Light, shining forth from thy womb, O most pure Mother of God, illumined the whole world with thrice-solar light, and revealed the earth as another heaven, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; hymn and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A Mother unto God and a Virgin, giving birth and remaining a virgin...*

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: We earthen ones are unable worthily to praise and hymn Thee in elevated words, Whom the Seraphim on high unceasingly hymn; yet daring in every way as our Master, we magnify Thee as our most loving God!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Deliver from bodily diseases and spiritual attach- [^129] -ments Thy faithful singers, O single, indivisible Trinity, and grant them to be preserved unharmed, delivering them from every worldly calamity!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: O equal in power, divine-principled, thrice-radiant, almighty Dominion, inalterable beauty, substantial Goodness: grant remission of transgressions unto Thy servants, and deliverance from trials and passions!

items.office: On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Having taken mind and soul and fleshly commingling from thy most pure womb, O Mother of God, God the Word in truth appeared as man, and openly revealed man as a partaker of the divine nature!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.

items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: While the tomb was sealed, Thou didst shine forth Life from the tomb, O Christ God; and while the doors were shut, Thou didst stand before the disciples, renewing an upright Spirit in us through them according to Thy great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: He Who by His three-day burial despoiled death, and by His life-bearing rising raised up corrupt man, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind: glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: As thou hast tender mercy for our help, look upon those on earth, upon helpless people; have mercy, O blessed Mother of God, remain praying that we perish not grievously; as thou art compassionate, pray the merciful God that our souls may be saved, O most holy Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.

items.english_text: Life lay in the tomb, and seals lay upon the stone; as a sleeping King soldiers watched Christ, and Angels glorified Him as immortal God; and the women cried aloud: The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Unto the tomb ran the women with tears, bearing sweet spices; and while soldiers were guarding the King of all, they said among themselves: Who will roll away the stone for us? The Angel of Great Counsel is risen, trampling down death: O almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Unceasingly pray Him Who was crucified for our sake, Christ our God, and Who cast down the dominion of death, O Virgin Mother of God, that He may save our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou Who didst take our form and endure the Crucifixion in the flesh: save us by Thy Resurrection, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind! [^130]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *The Hymns of Degrees, Tone 7. Antiphon 1:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Turning back the captivity of Zion from deception, quicken me also, O Savior, delivering me from the slavery of passions!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: They that sow in the south with tears the sorrows of fasting, shall reap joyous sheaves of ever-living nourishment!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is the fountain of divine treasures, from Whom comes wisdom, understanding, and fear: unto Him be praise and glory, honor and dominion!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Except the Lord build the house of the soul, in vain do we labor; for without Him neither deed nor word is accomplished!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Of the fruit of the womb, the saints, moved by the Spirit, sprout forth paternal traditions of adoption!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit all things have their being; for before all He is God, the Lordship of all, unapproachable Light, and the Life of all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: They that fear the Lord, having found the way of life, now and ever are blessed with incorruptible glory!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Beholding thy offspring round about thy table like shoots, rejoice and be glad, bringing them unto Christ, the Chief Shepherd!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is a great depth of gifts, the wealth of glory, a great depth of judgments; for He is equally glorified with the Father and the Son, and co-worshipped!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 7: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up, forget not Thy poor unto the end. Verse: I will confess Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.

items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord. Matins Resurrection Gospel. Psalm 50.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: By Thy nodding upon earth, the form was transformed, the nature of water which formerly flowed freely, O Lord; whence Israel passed dry-shod, and sings a song of victory unto Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The tyranny of death was condemned by the tree, when Thou, O Lord, wast condemned to an unjust death; whence the prince of darkness, failing to prevail against Thee, was justly cast out!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* [^131]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Hades drew near unto Thee, and not being able to crush Thy body with its teeth, shattered its own jaws; and Thou, O Savior, having loosed the pangs of death, didst arise on the third day!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The sorrows of our foremother Eve were loosed; for having escaped pangs, without knowing man thou didst give birth; whence knowing thee openly as the Mother of God, O all-pure one, we all glorify thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection, Same Tone.*

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: In the deep He overwhelmed Pharaoh...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Two life-bearing streams the Savior poured forth unto us upon the Cross from His pierced side; let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Having lodged in the tomb, and risen on the third day, Christ granted hope of incorruption unto mortals; let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.

items.english_text: Thou didst appear as the only Virgin even after childbirth; for thou didst bear incarnate the Creator of the world: Rejoice! we all cry unto thee.

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: By Thy nod upon earth is fashioned the...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.

items.english_text: O Virgin who didst bear the Abyss of compassion, enlighten my soul with thy light-bearing radiance, that I may worthily hymn the abyss of thy wonders!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Beholding those wounded by the arrow of sin, the Word beholding them, as Benefactor had compassion; whence ineffably the all-divine One was united, O all-pure one, to the flesh taken from thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Mankind's nature became subject unto death, corruptible and mortal, O Lady; but having conceived Life, thou didst lead it up from corruption unto life!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: In the beginning having established the heavens by Thine almighty Word, O Lord Savior, and all their host by the all-creating and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Ascending the tree, Thou didst willingly sorrow for our sake, O compassionate Savior, and didst endure wounding that intercedes for reconciliation and salvation unto the faithful; whereby, O Merciful One, we were all reconciled unto Thy Father!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Cleansing me from the wound, who was wounded in soul by the serpent's bite, O Christ, Thou didst show light unto me who of old lay in darkness and corruption; for descending into Hades by the Cross, Thou didst raise me with Thyself!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: By the prayers of Thy Mother who knew not man, grant peace unto the world [^132] O Savior, and give victory unto the king over opposing enemies, and vouchsafe those who glorify Thee to partake of Thine ineffable glory!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The flaming sword Thou didst quench with the blood that flowed from Thy side, O Lord, when lawless people nailed Thee to the tree of the Cross; whereby the Thief found Paradise, and I boast in hope of the Cross, that receiving remission of sins for its sake, O Christ, I may hymn Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Risen from Thy tomb, O Christ, Thou didst first appear unto the women, and didst loose the sorrows of Eve; and Adam fallen into corruption Thou didst raise up with Thyself as compassionate God: therefore we all hymn Thy rising!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The Lord Whom thou didst receive in a virginal womb, and Whom thou didst bear in the flesh, O pure one: through thy maternal prayers grant Him to be propitious unto us, His servants, as we know thee alone as a haven of compassion towards God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: The serpent creeping out of Eden...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The serpent creeping out of Eden, having deceived me through desire of deification, cast me down unto the earth; but He Who is merciful by nature and compassionate, had mercy having compassion, He made me godlike, taking up His abode in thy womb, and became like unto me, O Mother Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O Virgin Mother of God, joy of all; for thou didst bear joy and true gladness unto all the world, which dispels the sorrow of sins, O Bride of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou didst bear eternal Life and Light and Peace unto us, O Mother of God, Virgin, calming through faith and confession of thy grace the ancient warfare of men towards God and the Godhead!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Without leaving the Father's bosom, and descending unto earth, O Christ God, I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Offering His back unto wounds, He Who was incarnate from the Virgin, the guiltless Master, is scourged for the servant who sinned, loosing my transgressions!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Before the judgment seat, the lawless judge holds Him guilty as the condemned; and He is struck with an earthen hand, Who created man as God, and judges the earth in righteousness!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: As truly the Mother of God, pray Thy Creator and Son [^133] O all-immaculate one, to direct me unto the saving haven of His glorious will!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: The Prophet, beholding the last things...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Knowing no sin, yet for this cause Thou becamest, O Lord, what Thou wast not, taking what was alien unto Thyself, that Thou mightest save the world and slay the tyrant by deceit!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and didst loose the sin of Forefather Adam; on account of which I have heard of Thy power, that Thou didst come to save all Thine anointed ones!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Proceeding from the mountain of the Pharan division, the Virgin was enrolled with the servants, delivering all from slavery, ruling unto the ages: therefore we glorify thee who gavest birth!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Without leaving the Father's bosom...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Appearing all-elect and fair unto God before creation by thy brightness, O all-pure one, enlighten with light-bestowing grace those who hymn thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou didst bear God for mankind, O pure one, incarnate of thy pure blood, delivering from many transgressions those who glorify and honor thee with love, O Virgin Mother!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: The rational nature celebrates a sacred ministry: shining forth from thee, O all-hymned one, having now learned the ineffable mystery of thy childbirth, O most blessed one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Night without light unto the faithless, O Christ, but unto the faithful enlightenment in enjoyment of Thy words; therefore early in the morning do I rise unto Thee, and hymn Thy Godhead!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: For the sake of Thy servants Thou wast sold, O Christ, and Thou didst endure buffeting upon the cheek, interceding for freedom unto those who sing: Early in the morning do I rise unto Thee, and hymn Thy Godhead!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: By Thy divine power, O Christ, through fleshly weakness Thou didst cast down the strong one; and Thou didst reveal Him as the conqueror of death, O Savior, for the sake of the Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thou didst bear God, O pure Mother, divinely incarnate from thee, O all-hymned one; since thou knewest not male seed, but didst give birth from the Holy Spirit!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: O Lord my God, from the night I rise early unto Thee...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: When Thou wast reckoned among the lawless, being lifted up upon the Place of the Skull, the luminaries hid themselves, the earth quaked, and the temple veil was rent in twain, revealing the falling away of the Hebrews!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Thee Who didst destroy all the power of the tyrant by the might of Thine incomprehensible Godhead, and didst raise the dead [^134] by Thy Resurrection, we glorify with hymns!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: O Mother of the King and God, all-hymned Mother of God: through thy prayers send down cleansing of transgressions unto those who ever praise thee in faith and love with hymns!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Night without light unto the faithless...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Beholding the ladder fixed on high, Jacob was taught the figure of thee who knewest not wedlock; for through thee, O all-venerable Lady, God communicated with mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Having now found eternal deliverance through thee, O Virgin, fervently we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Bride of God! And having rejoiced in thy light, O all-pure one, with hymns we magnify thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Finding thee alone as a lily among thorns, shining with the brightness of purity and with the lights of virginity, O all-hymned one, the Bridegroom brought thee as a bride!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Страшенъ ꙗвился еси Гди, въ Гробѣ лежа ꙗко спа: въскрсъ же трїдневенъ ꙗко силенъ, Адама совоскрсилъ еси зовꙋща: слава воскрнію...
items.english_text: Sailing in the surge of worldly cares, sinking with the ship through sins, and cast before the soul-destroying beast, like Jonah I cry unto Thee, O Christ: Lead me up from the deadly deep!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Воспоминахꙋ тя затворенный, въ адѣ, ѡставишася дша праведныхъ: и ѿ тебе спнію моляхуся, еже Кртомъ Хрте подалъ еси сщымъ въ преисподній, пришедъ, ꙗко бл҃гоꙋтробенъ.
items.english_text: The imprisoned in Hades remembered Thee, the souls of the righteous who were left; and they prayed for salvation from Thee, which Thou, O Christ, hast granted by the Cross unto those in the nethermost parts, having come as the Tender-hearted!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Къ ѡдꙋшевленноумꙋ ти й нерукотворенному ти храму, разрушенну бывшу страданьми, воззрѣти древле ликъ Аплскїй ѿчаявся, но паче надежда поклонься, воскрша всюду проповѣда.
items.english_text: Looking upon Thy living and not-made-with-hands temple, which was destroyed by sufferings, of old the choir of Apostles despaired; yet beyond hope having worshipped, they proclaimed Thy Resurrection everywhere!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Неизреченнаго ржтва твоего всенепорочнаа ѡбразъ, Дво бгоневѣстная: йже насъ ради кто ѿ члвкъ сказати возможетъ, ꙗко Бгъ неѡписанный, слово мнѣ съединися, плоть йстебе бысть.
items.english_text: Who among men can declare the image of thine ineffable childbirth, O all-immaculate Virgin, Bride of God, for our sake? For God the uncircumscribed Word was united unto me, and became flesh from thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Ірмосъ. Возопихъ Господи въ скорби:
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: I cried unto the Lord in my affliction...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Сътрясе всю землю распенся Влка, й йсцѣли тако блгъ лютаа еа сокрушенїа.
items.english_text: Being crucified, the Master shook all the earth, and as good healed its grievous afflictions!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Смерть разрушися, й плѣненъ бысть Адъ, Хс бо воста, путь твора члвкомъ воскрніемъ.
items.english_text: Death was destroyed, and Hades was despoiled; for Christ is risen, making a path unto mankind by His Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Счтая Влчце, оупованіе йзвѣстное, йже любовію поющаа тя, ꙗко истинную Бцꙋ съхрани.
items.english_text: O most pure Lady, certain Hope: preserve those who in love hymn thee as the true Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Законныи тя ѡбразы, и Пррческая прореченїа, ꙗвѣ превозвѣщахꙋ: хотящую роди-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Sailing in the surge...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: -ти блгтлю чтаꙗ всеа твари. йже многочастнѣ й многоѡбразнѣ блгодѣйствовавшаго, вѣрно въспѣвающихъ тя.
items.english_text: The types of the Law and the prophecies of the Prophets clearly foretold thee, who wast to give birth [^135] unto the Benefactor of all creation, O pure one, Who in many parts and in diverse manners hath shown goodness unto those who faithfully hymn thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстраншагося древле навѣтомъ чловекооубійца, Адама первозданнаго, Райскїа божественныя сладости Бгоневѣсто паки ковела еси рожши йже ѿ преступленїа насъ йсхитившаго.
items.english_text: Adam the first-formed, who became alienated of old by the counsel of the murderer of man, thou hast led back, O Bride of God, into the divine delights of Paradise, having given birth unto Him Who snatched us from transgression!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Иже свѣтомъ бжтвеннымъ, содѣтельною же силою, всяческая съставлей й несущїй: въ оутробы твоеа Чтаа произыйде, й сѣдящаа въ тмѣ смерти й, бгоначалными лꙋчами ѡсїа.
items.english_text: He Who by divine light and creative power framed and upholds all things, came forth from thy womb, O pure one, and shone with divine-originating rays upon those sitting in the darkness of death!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Не ктомꙋ держава смертнаа возможе держати члвки: Хртосъ бо сошед сокрушаа йразорѧя силы еа, связуемъ бываетъ Адъ, Прроци согласно радꙋются, преста, глаголюще: Спса сщымъ въ вѣрѣ: йзыйдѣте вѣрнїй въ воскресеніе.
items.english_text: No longer can the dominion of death hold mankind; for Christ came down, shattering and destroying its powers! Hades is bound; the Prophets rejoice with one accord, saying: The Savior hath appeared unto those in faith; come forth, ye faithful, unto the Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The nethermost parts below trembled today, Hades and death, before the One of the Trinity; the earth shook, and the gatekeepers of Hades, seeing Thee were terrified! And all creation, rejoicing with the Prophets, sings unto Thee a song of victory, unto our Deliverer God, Who hath now destroyed the power of death! Let us shout aloud and cry out unto Adam and unto those born of Adam: The Tree hath led him in again; come forth, ye faithful, unto the Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Of old the Children showed the fiery furnace dew-bearing, hymning the one God and saying: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted, blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: By the tree Adam is put to death, having willingly committed disobedience; but by Christ's obedience he is renewed again; for for my sake the Son of God, the supremely glorified, is crucified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: All creation hymns Thee, O Christ, risen from the tomb; for Thou, the supremely glorified Light, hast blossomed forth as Life unto those in Hades, the Resurrection of the dead, and unto those in darkness!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Rejoice, daughter of corruptible Adam; rejoice, only Bride of God; rejoice, through whom corruption was driven away, for thou didst bear God, Whom implore [^136] O pure one, that we all may be saved!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O Thou Who on the tree of the Cross didst blunt the sting of sin, and didst tear up the handwriting of Adam's transgression by the spear of Thy side: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O Thou Who wast pierced in the side, and by the sprinkling of divine blood didst cleanse the earth defiled by the blood of idols: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Orthodoxly we theologize the indivisible Nature: God the unoriginate Father, and the Word and Spirit of the same dominion, crying: Blessed art Thou, O consubstantial Trinity!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: The Children did not burn in the furnace...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Having thee as an adorned and gilded vessel, O Virgin, Thy Creator and Lord loved thee: the God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Isaiah of old was cleansed, O Maiden, having received the coal, seeing in figure and symbolically thy divine childbirth, [hymning] the God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Symbolic types of old of thy divine childbirth beholding, the divine Prophets, joyfully singing, cried aloud: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Communing with the fire on Sinai without burning, the bush revealed God unto slow-tongued and heavy-voiced Moses; and the zeal of God showed the three Children unharmed singers in the fire: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Slain for the world, the all-pure spiritual Lamb brought to an end the sacrifices offered according to the Law, cleansing transgressions by His blood as God, of those who ever cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Our flesh, which was assumed by the Creator, being incorruptible before the Passion, was made after the Passion and Resurrection untouched by corruption, and renews mortal man, who cries: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thy precious and all-immaculate [giving birth], O Virgin, cleansed the foul and abominable defilement of the world, and became the cause of our reconciliation unto God, O all-pure one; therefore [^137] thee, O Virgin, do we supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: The only unoriginate...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Him Who willingly endured the Passion, and by His own desire was nailed unto the Cross, and shattered the power of Hades: praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Him Who abolished the dominion of death, and rose with glory from the tomb, and saved the human race: praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The only Tender-hearted, the pre-eternal Word, Who in the last times was born of a Virgin, and loosed the ancient curse: praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Communing with the fire without burning...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: With the light of thy childbirth, in marvelous splendor thou didst enlighten the universe, O Birth-giver of God; thou bearest in thine arms the existing God, Who sanctifies the faithful who ever cry: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Piously thy womb hymns thee, O pure one, which held God ineffably incarnate, Who grants unto all the faithful the illumination of the knowledge of God, unto those who ever cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
