items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: By the flashings of thy light, make those who hymn thee light-bearing, O Mother Virgin who gavest birth to the Light; for thou wast shown to be the dwelling of Light, shining with light upon those who cry: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Having given birth without experience of corruption, and having lent flesh unto the all-craftsman Word, O Mother who knewest not man, Virgin Mother of God, vessel of the Uncontainable, dwelling-place of thine uncircumscribed Creator: thee do we magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Let all the strange-minded who ascribe suffering unto the Godhead be put to shame; for the Lord of glory was crucified in the flesh, yet was not crucified in His divine nature, as in two natures we magnify the One!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Let those who do not believe in the resurrection of bodies go unto the tomb of Christ, unto the Teacher: for He was put to death, and rose again, the flesh of the Life-giver, in assurance of the final resurrection, the hope whereof we hold!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Honoring the Trinity not in Godhead, but in Persons; nor the Unity in Persons, but in Godhead: we cut off those who divide It, and we refute again those who dare [^138] confusion concerning It: Whom we magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos: A Mother unto God and a Virgin, giving birth...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Beholding in Christ the fleshly sufferings and the might of the Godhead, let them be ashamed who imagine one single nature; for as man indeed He dies, and as Creator of all He arises!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Myrrh unto the dead, but praise unto the Living; tears unto the dying, but a hymn unto the Life of all did ye women bring; and the herald of the Rising cried aloud, announcing the good tidings of Christ's Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Light from Light, the Father's radiance of glory, shone forth ineffably; as in darkness unto human life Christ dawned, chasing away the gloom: Whom unceasingly we faithful magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: I know no other God beside Thee, the Church cries unto Thee, Who hast chosen Thy Bride from the unbelieving nations; grant therefore salvation unto the faithful, O Word, through the prayers of her who bore Thee, as Thou art tender-hearted!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Same Heirmos.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: As the Mediatress of eternal joy and gladness hast thou ever appeared unto us, O Virgin Maiden, having borne the Deliverer, unto those who honor Him in truth and the divine Spirit, as God Who delivers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Singing, David thy forefather, O all-pure one, calls thee the holy divine Ark, which contained God beyond nature: Who sits in the Father's bosom; Whom unceasingly we faithful magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Truly thou art higher than all creation, O Maiden, for bodily thou didst bear the Creator of all; therefore as the Mother of the only Master, thou bearest sovereign victory against all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 7:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Christ is risen from the dead, having broken the bonds of death; announce, O earth, great joy: hymn the glory of God, ye heavens!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the holy Lord Jesus, the only sinless One!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: We cease not worshipping Christ's Resurrection; for He hath saved us from our iniquities: holy is the Lord Jesus, Who revealed the Resurrection unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: What shall we render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto us? For our sake God is among men; for corrupted nature the Word became flesh and dwelt among us; unto the ungrateful the Benefactor, unto the captives the Liberator, unto those sitting in darkness the Sun of righteousness, upon the Cross the Immortal [^139] One, in Hades the Light, in death the Life, the Resurrection for the sake of the fallen: unto Whom let us cry aloud: O our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The gates of Hades Thou didst shatter, O Lord, and abolish the dominion of death by Thy mighty power; and Thou didst raise up the dead who slept from the ages in darkness, by Thy divine and glorious Resurrection: O our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, and let us be glad in His Resurrection; for He raised the dead together with Himself from the unbreakable bonds of Hades, and as God granted unto the world eternal life and great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Shining brightly, the Angel sat upon the stone of Thy life-receiving tomb, and announced good tidings unto the myrrh-bearing women, saying: The Lord is risen, as He told you before; announce unto His disciples that He goes before you into Galilee, and grants unto the world eternal life and great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, on "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 7: Thou didst destroy [death] by Thy Cross... Glory. Both now. Theotokion.
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Why have ye set at nought the Chief Cornerstone, O law-transgressing Jews? Behold, this is He Whom God placed in Zion: Who poured forth water from the rock in the wilderness, and pours forth immortality unto us from His side; this is the Stone that was cut without male desire from the virginal mountain: the Son of Man coming upon the heavenly clouds unto the Ancient of Days, as Daniel said, and His Kingdom is eternal!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, The Beatitudes, Tone 7:*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Fair was the fruit and good for food that slew me; Christ is the Tree of Life, eating of which I die not, but cry with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, O Compassionate One, and didst blot out the handwriting of Adam's ancient sin, and saved all the human race from deception; therefore we hymn Thee, O Benefactor Lord!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Laid in the tomb as dead, O Christ, Life of all: Thou didst shatter the bars of Hades, and rising in glory on the third day as mighty, Thou didst enlighten all: glory to Thy rising!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: By Thy rising Thou didst raise up Adam with Thyself [^140] O Christ Giver of life, granting the ancient incorruption that was in Paradise; therefore I cry with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Risen on the third day from the tomb, the Savior granted life, as He said, peace unto His disciples; and having blessed them, He sent them forth, saying: Bring all into My Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The evil serpent once poured venom into the ears of Eve; but Christ, on the sharp wood of the Cross, poured forth unto the world the abundance of sweetness; therefore we cry: Remember me who cry out in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The Father is Light, the Son and Word is Light, the Holy Spirit is Light; yet the three are one Light; for God is one in three Persons indeed, yet in one Nature and Principle, indivisible and unconfused, abiding pre-eternal!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 7)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thou didst bear the Son and the Father's Word in the flesh for our sake, as He Himself knows, O Mother of God; therefore, O Virgin Mother, having been made godlike through thee, we cry: Rejoice! unto thee, the boast of Christians!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: An evening hymn and rational service do we offer unto Thee, O Christ: for Thou wast well pleased to have mercy upon us by the Resurrection!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O Lord, Lord, cast us not away from Thy presence: but be well pleased to have mercy upon us by the Resurrection!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Rejoice, O holy Zion, Mother of the Churches, dwelling-place of God: for thou wast the first to receive remission of sins by the Resurrection!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The Word born of God the Father before the ages, and in the last times the Same incarnate of her who knew not wedlock, of His own will enduring the death of the Cross, and saved man who of old was slain, by His Resurrection!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* [^141]

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thy Resurrection from the dead do we glorify, O Christ, whereby Thou didst free the race of Adam from the tyranny of Hades, and as God didst grant unto the world eternal life and great mercy!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Glory to Thee, O Christ Savior, only-begotten Son of God, Who wast nailed to the Cross and didst rise from the tomb on the third day!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thee do we glorify, O Lord, Who for our sake didst willingly endure the Crucifixion; and Thee do we worship, O almighty Savior: cast us not away from Thy presence, but give ear and save us, for the sake of Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion [Dogmatikon]:*

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The King of heaven, through love for mankind, appeared upon earth and lived among men; for taking flesh from the pure Virgin and coming forth from her with the assumption [of our nature], He is one Son, twofold in nature, but not in Person; therefore, truly proclaiming Him as perfect God and perfect man, we confess Christ our God: Whom implore, O unwedded Mother, that our souls may have mercy!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thou didst ascend the Cross, O Jesus, Who camest down from heaven; Thou camest unto death, O immortal Life; unto those in darkness the true Light, unto the fallen the Resurrection of all and Enlightenment: O our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Let us glorify Christ, Who rose from the dead: for having assumed soul and body, by His Passion He severed them one from the other; His all-pure soul indeed descending into Hades, which He also despoiled, while in the tomb His holy body saw not corruption: the Deliverer of our souls!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: With psalms and hymns do we glorify Thy Resurrection from the dead, O Christ, whereby Thou didst free us from the tyranny of Hades, and as God didst grant eternal life and great mercy!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O incomprehensible Master of all, Creator of heaven and earth, by the sufferings of the Cross Thou didst pour forth passionlessness unto me; and having accepted burial, and risen in glory, Thou didst raise up Adam with Thyself by Thine [^142] all-powerful hand! Glory to Thy three-day rising, whereby Thou hast granted unto us eternal life and cleansing of sins, as Thou alone art tender-hearted!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O unwedded Virgin, who didst ineffably conceive God in the flesh, Mother of God the Most High: receive the entreaties of thy servants, O all-immaculate one, who bestowest upon all cleansing of transgressions, now receiving our supplications: pray that we all may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart. Trisagion. And after Our Father.*

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thou didst descend from on high, O Compassionate One; Thou didst accept three-day burial, that Thou mightest free us from passions: O our Life and Resurrection, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday Evening, at Great Vespers, on "Lord, I have cried," Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O Good One, Who for our sake wast born of a Virgin and didst endure the Crucifixion, Who by death didst despoil death, and as God didst manifest the Resurrection: despise not those whom Thou didst create with Thine own hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O Merciful One; accept the Mother of God who bore Thee, who intercedes for us; and save, O our Savior, a despairing people!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *On Sunday, at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, of which the acrostic is: "O Unity, [preserve] the powers of Thy servant." Work of Metrophanes.*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 8. Heirmos: He submerged the armed Pharaoh, working wonders...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Unto the thrice-sunlike King, and Builder, and Provider in every way, being good alone in nature, and possessing the unique glory of the Godhead, unto God of single principle we fall down, singing the thrice-holy hymn!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Divine utterances and prophecies from on high, fulfilling clearly, glorify the divine-originating single Nature, ever-existing, co-unoriginate, in three Persons: Father, and Son, and Spirit: all-powerful, creative!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Abraham, having become an initiate of sacred mysteries, sacredly of old received the Creator of all, and God, and Lord, in three figures indeed, rejoicing; and in three Hypostases he recognized the single Dominion!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O thou who knewest not wedlock, thou didst bear Christ, Who for our sake assumed our [^143] nature, O all-pure one, and remained inalterable in both [natures]: Whom implore unceasingly to grant me remission of sins and deliverance from trials!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: In the beginning, having established the heavens with understanding...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Isaiah, beholding Thee, the unapproachable God and King of glory, upon a high throne, and the Cherubim and Seraphim glorifying Thee with unceasing hymns: [glorified Thee as] the single tri-hypostatic God!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Having attained by the wind of understanding and the teachings of the Scriptures the one Word born of the Father as from the Mind, and the Spirit proceeding ineffably: we venerate the one thrice-radiant God!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: The unbegotten Father, having incorruptibly begotten the Son, the radiance of His essence, Light from Light, appropriately brings forth the co-sprouted Light of the Spirit: all-creating and equally honored!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: A pure temple wast thou shown to be, O Virgin Mother Mary, unto Christ Who all-powerfully and all-wisely fashioned all things, and set them in order and upholds them: Whom make propitious unto me by thy maternal prayers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Ye faithful, let us now hymn the power of the thrice-sunlike and precious Godhead, how by a nod alone He framed all things, the supreme angelic choirs, and the lower ecclesiastical hierarchies, to cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O all-good God; glory and song be unto Thy dominion!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the inalterable God: my heart, ever growing slothful through sin and indolence by the suggestions of the deceitful one, as good strengthen by thy maternal prayers, that I also may gratefully glorify thee, O Mary Birthgiver of God: have mercy on thy flock which thou hast acquired, O all-immaculate one!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Thou art my Lord, O Christ, Thou art my strength, Thou art my God; having appeared as the dawn of the Godhead, He dispersed all the gloomy darkness of passions, and the Sun of righteousness shone forth: simple in essence, yet thrice-radiant in Persons: Whom we ever hymn and glorify!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Hymned by the mouths of the Seraphim, with earthen lips do we glorify the single and Trinity Lord of glory, crying out in nature and hypostasis: O holy [^144] King, grant unto Thy servants remission of their diverse transgressions!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: All-holding unto all existing things, invisible, all-bountiful, tender-hearted, loving mankind, O holy and divine-originating Trinity: forget not me Thy servant unto the end, nor make void the covenant which Thou hast covenanted with Thy servants, for the sake of Thine ineffable mercy!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Finding thee alone, O all-pure one, fair from all ages, the beauty of Jacob, the pre-unoriginate Word dwelt in thee for the sake of tender mercy, and renewed human nature: Whom implore unceasingly to deliver me from every affliction!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: We glorify the three co-ever-existing Persons, and one Lord, Thee the divine Nature, simply distinguishing and uniting, and faithfully we cry aloud: O holy Trinity of single origin, deliver Thy servants from afflictions!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: I weep bitterly for the weakness of my mind: how unwillingly I suffer; an involuntary change in truth! Therefore I cry: O holy, life-originating Trinity, establish me in the state of good things!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡстрепеташа долѣ преисподньаа днь, Адъ й смерть единаго ѿ Трци: земла поколѣбася, вратници же Адовы видѣвше тя оужасо-
items.english_text: Weighed down by the slumber of my sin, and having need unto the sleep of death: as Thou art loving mankind, and all-good, and all-merciful, O holy, divine-originating Trinity, show tender mercy and raise me up!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: къ сонъ смертный: ꙗко чл҃колюбиваа й преблгаа, й всемилостиваа Бгоначалнаа Трце ст҃аа, ѡущедри й къздвигнима.
items.english_text: O Virgin Maiden, all-pure, all-immaculate Mother, full of divine grace: by thy prayers make Thy Son, God, and Lord propitious unto me, and quickly deliver thy servant from passions and transgressions!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Мати Дво Ѻтроковице, Пречтаа всенепорочна Бгорадованнаа, твоими молитвами, Сна й Бга твоего й Гда милостива сотвори мнѣ, й страстей й согрѣшеній, твоего раба йзбави въскорѣ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .ѕ҃. Ірмосъ: Очисти мя, Спасе, многа бо беззаконія моя:
items.english_text: Imitating the hierarchies of the heavenly minds, O Trinity transcendent in essence, of single origin over all: with thrice-holy hymns do we glorify Thee with our earthen lips!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Нбныхъ оумовъ чиноначалїа подражающе, единоначалнаа всѣхъ Трце пресꙋщественная: трїстыми пѣснми тя славословимъ, бренными нашими оусты.
items.english_text: Unto Him Who created man according to His own image, and all-wisely fashioned all things from non-existence, unto God in three Persons do I bow down, and I honor, sing, and magnify Him!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Иже по ѡбразу своему члка содавшемꙋ, й ѿ несꙋщїй вся премрѣ составльшемъ, Бгꙋ трїсоставному покланаюся й чту й пою й величаю.
items.english_text: O Almighty God, and only Uncircumscribed One: dwell in me for the sake of Thine ineffable mercy, O thrice-sunlike Master; and enlighten me and grant me understanding, as Thou art tender-hearted!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Вседержителю Бже, йедине непредѣлный; вселиса въ ма за неизреченную млть, трїслнечный Влко: й просвѣтима, й кразꙋми, ꙗко бл҃гоꙋтробенъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast shown to be a temple unto the uncontainable God, O all-pure one: show me also to be a temple unto Him [^145] of divine graces, O all-holy Mother of God, by thy supplications, and preserve me unharmed!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Храмъ ꙗвилася еси Бгꙋ некомѣстимомꙋ, Пречтаа: храмъ й мене томꙋ покажи, бжтвенныхъ
items.english_text: Ye faithful, let us truly hymn with our mouths the unoriginate Father, the co-unoriginate Son, and the divine Spirit, unconfusedly, inalterably, and immutably: the simple, holy, and co-sprouted Trinity, crying aloud with the Angels: Holy art Thou, O Father and Son, with the Spirit, simple and precious: have mercy on those whom Thou hast created according to Thine image, O Master!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: ных блгти, престаа Бц҃е, твоими молбами й соблюди невредима.
items.english_text: We ever bless thee, O Mother of God, and we magnify thee, and we worship thee, hymning thy birthgiving, O full of grace, crying out unceasingly: Save us, O all-merciful Virgin, as thou art good, in the hour of examination, that we thy servants may not be put to shame!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Сѣдаленъ, Гласъ .и҃, Подобенъ: Повеленное таинственно (Повеленное):
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The fire was ashamed before the condescension of...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻца безначална вѣрнїй, Сна собезначална; й Дха Бжтвеннаго, въистинну оуснословимъ, неслїяннѣ, непревратнѣ, й неизмѣннѣ: Трцу просту, стꙋ й сораслну, вопїюще съ Агглы, стъ еси Ѻче Сне, съ Дхомъ пртымъ й чтнымъ, помилуй ихже созда, по Ѻбразу твоемꙋ Влко:
items.english_text: By Thine ineffable wisdom and the abyss of goodness, show Thy servant to be freely shown mercy; and now, as of old, deliver me from wickedness, O God, Trinity in Unity, from sins and passions!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гимъ ти прно Бц҃е й величаем, тя й покланяемся: воспѣвающе ржтко твое Ѡбрадованнаа, вопїющи непрестанно: спси насъ Дво премилостиваа, ꙗко блгаа: въ часъ йспитаніа, да неосрамлени бꙋдемъ рабы твой.
items.english_text: The Mind is the unbegotten Father, and the Word begotten of Him and the divine Spirit, proceeding ineffably: O God of single origin, thrice-sunlike, I sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, the God of our fathers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь .з҃. Ірмосъ: Божія снисхожденія огнь устыдеся:
items.english_text: I have been slain, O all-pure one, made to drink of the poison of sin; and with faith I flee unto thee who didst bear the Author of life: by thy prayers give life unto thy servant, and deliver me from temptations and passions, O thou who alone art pure!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Премростїю неизгланною ти, й пучиною блгтына, туне своего раба помилованна покажима: й нынѣ ꙗкоже древле йзбави ѿ злобаенїа; Трце единице Бже, грѣховъ й страстей.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Sevenfold the furnace the Chaldean tyrant fiercely kindled...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Being unwaning Light, thrice-radiant and thrice-sunlike, and of single origin, sovereign, most simple, incomprehensible God, and sovereign Lord: now enlighten my dark and darkened heart, and show it to be radiant and light-bearing, to sing and glorify Thee faithfully unto all ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: With most fiery, most divine wings the Seraphim reverently veil their faces and feet, unable to endure the glory of Thine incomprehensible goodness: O divine-originating, divine-originating, self-originating, all-holy Trinity; yet we also dare to hymn Thee and glorify Thee unto all ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* [^146]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: O Lordship without beginning, all-powerful and all-good, perfectly unoriginate, beneficent, and supreme; the Cause having no cause, creative, pre-existing, provident, and saving unto all, Unity in essence and Trinity in Persons: I glorify Thee, my God, faithfully unto ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Upon earth shone forth the unwaning Sun through thy virginal birthgiving, O all-pure Lady, and delivered earthly ones from idolatrous and deceitful dark gloom; therefore now also enlighten me with rays of that divine origin, and preserve thy servant!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: The heaven was amazed at this, and the...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The Nature reigning over all and all-creating, pre-originate, timeless, life-originating, tender-hearted, loving mankind, good, Trinity of single origin: Thee do we now glorify, asking remission of sins, peace for the world, and concord for the Churches!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: One Lordship and thrice-radiant, unique divine origin, thrice-sunlike: accept Thy singers fittingly, and deliver from transgressions and afflictions, and hardships; and quickly grant peace, in Thy love for mankind, and unity unto the Churches!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having entered into the virginal womb, O Christ my Savior, Thou wast manifested unto Thy world, as God-man, inalterable, unconfused in truth; and Thou didst promise to be manifestly ever with Thy servants: therefore, by the prayers of her who bore Thee, establish peace unto all Thy flock!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *"God is the Lord..." Troparion, Tone 8: "Thou didst descend from on high, O Compassionate One..." Glory... Both now... Theotokion.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou didst rise from the dead, O Life of all; and a radiant Angel cried unto the women: Cease from tears, announce good tidings unto the Apostles, cry aloud singing: That Christ the Lord is risen, Who was well pleased as God to save the human race!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Glory... Podoben: "The disciple of wisdom" (Премудрости):*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having truly risen from the tomb, Thou didst command the venerable women to proclaim the rising unto the Apostles, as it is written; and running swiftly [^147] Peter stood before the tomb, and seeing light in the tomb, he was astonished; therefore also seeing the linen cloths lying alone, which none could see lying in the night, having believed, he cried aloud: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, for Thou savest all, O our Savior, for Thou art the radiance of the Father! Both now...

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Let us hymn the heavenly Gate and Tabernacle, the all-holy Mountain, the radiant Cloud, the heavenly Ladder, the rational Paradise, the deliverance of Eve, the great treasure of the whole world: for salvation was wrought in it for the world, and remission of ancient transgressions; therefore we cry unto thee: Pray to thy Son and God to grant remission of transgressions unto those who piously worship thine all-holy birthgiving!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Men sealed Thy tomb, O Savior, and an Angel rolled away the stone from the doors; and the women, beholding Thee risen from the dead, announced good tidings unto Thy disciples in Zion: That Thou art risen, O Life of all, and the bonds of death are loosed: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having brought burial myrrh, the women heard an angelic voice from the tomb: Cease from tears, and in place of sorrow bring joy; cry aloud singing: That the Lord is risen, Who was well pleased as God to save the human race! Both now...

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: All creation rejoices in thee, O full of grace: the angelic assembly and the race of man; hallowed temple and rational paradise, virginal boast, of whom God became incarnate and became a Child, Who is our pre-eternal God; for He made thy womb a throne, and made thy body more spacious than the heavens; all creation rejoices in thee, O full of grace: glory to thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearers, standing before the life-giving tomb, sought the immortal Master among the dead; and having received the joy of good tidings from the Angel, they announced unto the Apostles: That Christ God is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: From my youth the enemy tempts me, and with pleasures [^148] burns me; but hoping in Thee, O Lord, I vanquish the enemy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Let them that hate Zion become as grass before it is plucked up; for Christ shall cut off their necks with the cutting of torments!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit all things have life: Light from Light, great God; we sing unto Him with the Father and with the Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: I cried unto Thee, O Lord: give ear unto me, incline Thine ear unto me who cry, and purify me before Thou takest me hence!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: He that hath hope in the Lord shall not be terrified then, when He shall judge all things with fire and torment!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is theology, the Trinity in Unity; for the Father is unoriginate, from Whom the Son sprouted timelessly, and the Spirit, co-enthroned, co-formed, shone forth together from the Father!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Let my heart be covered with Thy fear, thinking humbly, lest being lifted up it fall away from Thee, O All-compassionate One!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Whosoever departs unto his mother earth is straightway dissolved, to receive either torments or honors for what he has lived!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit, whosoever is godlike beholds and foretells; he works high wonders, singing of one God in three Persons; for though it be thrice-radiant, the Godhead reigns as one Principle!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Behold now, what is so good, or what is so fair, as for brethren to dwell together in unity? For concerning this the Lord promised eternal life!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Concerning his clothing, He Who adorns the lilies of the field commands that we ought not to take thought!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit, through a single Cause, all things are held together in peace-giving manner; for He is God, truly consubstantial with the Father and the Son!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The Lord shall reign unto eternity; thy God, O Zion, unto generation and generation!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Let every breath... Praise God in His saints... The Resurrectional Gospel. Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ... Psalm 50, and the rest.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection.* [^149]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 8. Heirmos: He submerged the armed Pharaoh, the rod of Moses working wonders of old, striking in the form of a cross and dividing the sea; but it saved Israel fleeing on foot as a traveler, singing a hymn unto God!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: At the all-powerful Godhead of Christ how shall we not marvel? From passions pouring forth passionlessness and incorruption unto all the faithful, and from His holy side trickling an immortal fountain, and life from the tomb unto ever-existing ones!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: How comely appeared the Angel now unto the women, bearing bright natural images of immaterial purity, and by his appearance proclaiming the light of the Resurrection, crying aloud: The Lord is risen!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Most glorious things were spoken concerning thee in generation of generations, who didst contain the Word of God in thy womb, yet remained pure, O Mary Mother of God; therefore do we all honor thee, our protectress after God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Heirmos: Having traversed the water as dry land...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The gates of sorrow were lifted up, and the gatekeepers of Hades were terrified, beholding in the nether regions Him Who in the highest is above all nature!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The angelic ranks marvelled, beholding fallen human nature, which had been shut up in the nether parts of the earth, seated upon the divine throne!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The angelic and human ranks unceasingly praise thee, O unwedded Mother; for thou didst carry in thine arms as an infant the Creator of these!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Let us sing unto the Lord...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: O all-pure Mother of God, who didst bear beyond nature the incarnate ever-existing and transcendent Word: we hymn thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: A life-bearing cluster of grapes did the Virgin bear, O Christ: dripping the sweetness of salvation upon all the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The race of Adam, having been led up through thee unto beatitude that is beyond understanding, O Mother of God, worthily glorifies thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: In the beginning, having established the heavens with understanding...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: ...and founded the earth upon the waters: establish me, O Christ, upon the rock of Thy Church; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind! [^150]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Adam having been condemned through the tasting of sin, by the saving suffering of Thy flesh Thou didst justify, O Christ; for Thou Thyself, being sinless, wast not liable to the trial of death!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The light of the Resurrection shone forth unto those sitting in the darkness and shadow of death, even Jesus my God; and having bound the strong one by His Godhead, He despoiled his vessels!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou wast shown to be higher than the Cherubim and Seraphim, O Mother of God; for thou alone didst receive the uncontainable God in thy womb, O undefiled one; therefore all we faithful bless thee with hymns, O pure one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: O Lord, Maker of the celestial vault...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Him who at first disobeyed the commandment of the Lord Who truly made me, Thou didst banish, in which he was formed; and having taught obedience by Thyself, Thou didst renew him by the Crucifixion!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: O Lord, Who by wisdom didst foreknow all things, and by Thy understanding didst establish the nether regions: by Thy descent, O Word of God, Thou didst deign to raise up him who was made according to Thine image!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having dwelt bodily in the Virgin, O Lord, Thou wast manifested unto man as it was fitting to see Thee; and her Thou didst show forth as true Queen and helper unto the faithful, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Thou art the establishment of those that flee unto Thee, O Lord...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Grant us help by thy prayers, O all-pure one, repelling the assaults of grievous afflictions; thou wast the setting-aright of our foremother Eve, having borne for the world the Author of life, O Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Gird me with power, O all-pure one, who in truth didst bear God in the flesh: the hypostatic Power of the Father!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art my power; Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing; Who, without leaving the bosom of the Father, hast visited our poverty; therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: When I was at enmity, Thou didst love me exceedingly; by a strange emptying Thou didst descend upon earth, O tender-hearted Savior, not rejecting the reproach of my lowliness; and abiding on the height of Thine all-pure glory, Thou didst glorify him who before was dishonored!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Who, beholding now, O Master, is not astonished? Sufferings having destroyed death, by the Cross corruption is put to flight, and by death the riches of Hades are despoiled by the divine power of Thee Who wast crucified: a terrifying work, O Lover of mankind! [^151]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou art the boast of the faithful, O unwedded one; thou art the protectress, thou art the refuge of Christians, a rampart and a harbor; for unto thy Son thou bearest supplications, O all-immaculate one, and dost save from perils those who with faith and love know thee as the pure Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The children of the lawless nailed Thee to the Cross, O Christ God, whereby Thou didst save, as Thou art compassionate, those who glorify Thy sufferings!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb, Thou didst raise up with Thyself all the dead in Hades, and didst enlighten, as Thou art tender-hearted, those who glorify Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: God Whom thou didst bear, O all-pure Mary: Him implore to grant remission of transgressions unto thy servants!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: As the unplowed furrow that sprouted the life-creating Ear of wheat, Who grants life unto the world, O Mother of God, save those who hymn thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Enlightened, we all know thee to be the bush, O all-pure one, for thou didst bear the Sun of righteousness, O Ever-Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Grant cleansing unto our negligences, as Thou art sinless, and give peace unto Thy world, O God, by the prayers of her who bore Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy presence, O unwaning Light, and a strange darkness hath covered me, the wretched one? But turn me back, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my ways, I pray Thee!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Mocked, Thou didst endure to be clothed in a purple robe before Thy Passion, O Savior, healing the shameless nakedness of the first-created man; and naked to be nailed to the Cross, stripping off the garment of slaying, O Christ!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: From the dust of death, rising, Thou didst rebuild my fallen nature; and Thou didst make it unaging, O Christ, showing it forth again, like a royal image, gleaming with the light of incorruption!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having maternal boldness toward thy Son, O all-pure one, the kindred care for us [^152] despise not, we pray, for thee alone do we Christians mercifully offer as cleansing unto the Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Guide us by the power of Thy Cross, O Christ: for by it we fall down before Thee; grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Govern our life now, O all-good Christ our God, who hymn Thy rising, and grant us peace, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Implore thy Son and our God, O pure one, unwedded Mary all-pure, to send down great mercy upon us, the faithful!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Rising at dawn we cry to Thee, O Lord...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Calm the unstable tempest of my passions, O Virgin, who didst bear God, the Helmsman and Lord!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Unto thy birthgiving minister the angelic ranks and human assemblies, O all-pure Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: O Mary, unwedded Mother of God: bring to light the hopes of the enemies, and gladden those who hymn thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: ...and give ear unto me, O God of my salvation!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: By the tree the author of evil mightily cast me down; but Thou, having been lifted up upon the Tree, didst mightily cast him down, having exposed him by the Cross, and didst raise up the fallen one!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou didst have compassion on Zion, having shone forth from the tomb; Thou didst make it new instead of old, as Thou art tender-hearted, by Thy divine Blood; and now Thou reignest in it unto the ages, O Christ!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: May we be delivered from grievous transgressions by thy prayers, O pure Mother of God; and may we obtain, O all-pure one, the divine radiance of the Son of God Who was ineffably incarnate of thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou didst stretch out Thy palms upon the Cross, healing the incontinently outstretched hand of the first-created man in Eden; and of Thine own will having tasted gall, O Christ, Thou didst save as mighty those who glorify Thy sufferings!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The Deliverer tasted death of the initial decree, that He might destroy the kingdom of corruption; and having descended into the nether regions, Christ arose [^153] and saved as mighty those who sing His Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Cease not to pray for us, O all-pure Mother of God and Virgin, for thou art the establishment of the faithful, and by hope in thee are we strengthened, and with love we ineffably glorify Him Who became incarnate of thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Grant me a tunic of light...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: A temple of God, and an Ark, and an animate bridal chamber, and heavenly gates do the faithful proclaim thee to be, O Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: As God, the destroyer of heathen temples, Thy birthgiving, O Mary Bride of God, is worshipped with the Father and the Spirit!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The Word of God showed thee unto earthly ones as the heavenly Ladder, O Mother of God: for through thee He descended unto us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb, Thou didst raise up the dead, and didst resurrect Adam, and Eve dances in Thy Resurrection, and the ends of the world celebrate in Thy rising from the dead, O Many-merciful One!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Having despoiled the realms of Hades, and raised up the dead, O Long-suffering One, Thou didst meet the Myrrh-bearing women, bringing joy in place of sorrow; and unto Thine Apostles Thou didst announce tokens of victory, O my Savior and Giver of life; and Thou dost enlighten creation, O Lover of mankind; therefore also the world together rejoices in Thy rising from the dead, O Many-merciful One!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: At the condescension of God, the fire was ashamed in Babylon of old; therefore the children in the furnace, with dancing foot, rejoiced as in a bridal chamber, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The glorious emptying, the divine wealth of Thy poverty, O Christ, astonishes the Angels, beholding Thee nailed to the Cross in the flesh, to save those who cry with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: By Thy divine descent the nether regions were filled with light, and the darkness that formerly pursued was driven away; therefore the prisoners from the ages arose, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: The Lord of all indeed, the Father of the only-begotten Son alone, we orthodoxly proclaim, theologically declaring Thee; and we know Thy single upright Spirit, proceeding forth, consubstantial and co-ever-existing!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: He Who from Judea of old...* [^154]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, we prophetically cry aloud: for having been lifted up upon the Tree, Thou didst call all who cry with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Risen from the tomb as from sleep, O Compassionate One, Thou didst raise up the world with Thyself; creation was assured by the Apostles who proclaimed the Resurrection: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: We worship the Father, and honor the Son, and the Holy Spirit, acknowledging three consubstantial Persons, and calling upon the one God and Lord: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Incarnate of a virginal womb, Thou wast manifested for our salvation; therefore knowing Thy Mother to be the Mother of God, we orthodoxly cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Thou didst bud forth as a rod from the root of Jesse, O Virgin, bearing the all-blessed fruit, the saving Flower, crying with faith unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻумъ нерожденный Ѻцъ, й Слово рождшееся ѿ него,
items.english_text: Fill all with [Wisdom] of divine essence, which came to be for the sake of the Mother of God, unto those who sing unto Thee with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃ственныѧ, составнаѧ пр҃емрости бывшаго. Бц҃я ради. иже вѣрою тебѣ поющыхъ: Ѿцъ нашихъ Бж҃е бл҃гвенъ еси.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: The Chaldean tyrant furiously burned the furnace sevenfold for the godly; but having seen them saved by a better power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Седмь седмицею пе́щъ, Халде́йскїи мꙋчи́тел, Бго҃чести́вымъ лю́тѣ ражде́же, си́лою же лꙋ́чшею: сп҃сенныхъ же си́хъ видѣ́въ, Творцꙋ́ Избавителю вопїа́ше. Дѣ́ти блгви́те, сщ҃енници воспо́ите, лю́дїе превозносите къ всѧ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: The divine, transcendent power of Jesus has divinely shone forth in us: for entering bodily into the tabernacle of death's strength for the sake of all, He destroyed the strength of Hades; Whom ye children unceasingly bless, ye priests hymn, ye people supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: И́сова Бж҃тка, пребж҃ственная сила, въ на́съ бг҃олѣ́пно восіѧ́ла е́стъ: плотїю во кꙋ́щꙋ за всѣ́хъ, смр҃ти крѣ́пныѧ, разори А́довъ крѣ́пость: его́же непрестанно, дѣ́ти блгви́те, сщ҃енный по́ите, людїе превозносите къ всѧ вѣки.
items.english_text: The Crucified One is risen, the boastful one is fallen; he who had fallen and been crushed is set upright; corruption has been overthrown, and incorruption has blossomed forth; for that which was mortal has been swallowed up by life! Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Распя́тый воскр҃се, велича́вый паде́ся: пады́й, и҆ съкрꙋши́выйся, и҆спра́вися: тлѧ̀ ѡпроверже́на бы́ст, и҆ нетлѣ́нїе процвѣте́: живото́ бо мер́твенное пожерто бы́. Дѣ́ти блгви́те, сщ҃енници воспо́ите, лю́дїе преконосите въ всѧ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: The thrice-radiant Godhead, shining forth a single ray from the one nature in three Persons: the unoriginate Father, and the co-sprouted Word of the...

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Трїсїѧ́нное Бж҃тво, еди́нственную просїѧва́ющее зарю́, Ѿ еди́наго трїсоставнаго е́стьва: Роди́телѧ безначѧлна, и҆ единора́сна же Слово

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ́чее, и҆ въкꙋ́пѣ цр҃твꙋющъ единосу́щенъ Дх҃ъ. Дѣ́ти блгви́те, сщ҃ренници воспо́ите, людїе превозносите въ всѧ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: ...Father, and the consubstantial Spirit reigning together: ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: И҆же на дре́вѣ, рꙋ́цѣ мнѣ̀ просте́ршаго, ѡбнаженному: призикающа мѧ̀, свое́ю бл҃гоѡбразною съгрѣ́ѧти нагото́ю. Блгви́те, сщ҃енници воспо́ите, людїе превозносите въ всѧ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Conquerors of the tyrant...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: И҆же йспреисподнїи А́да, возне́сша ма̀ па́дшаго: и҆ вы́сео ко прѣто́лною сла́вою Роди́телѧ почетшаго: блгви́те всѧ дѣ́ла Гднѧ Гда по́ите, и҆ превозноси́те е҆го̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Him Who stretched out His hands upon the Tree unto me who was naked, calling me to warm myself with His noble nakedness: bless, ye priests, hymn, and ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: И҆же въ трїе́хъ лице́хъ и҆зѡбразꙋ́емо, нераздѣлно Бж҃тво трїсоста́вно, в еди́номъ съще́ствѣ̀ и҆ сла́вѣ. блгви́те всѧ̀ дѣ́ла Гднѧ Гда по́ите, и҆ превозноси его къ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Him Who raised me up, the fallen one, from the nethermost parts of Hades, and honored me with the enthroned glory of the Father on high: bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Сопроти́вны раждеже́нныѧ, и҆ пламеноки́дыѧ на насъ, оу҆гасѝ стрѣ́лы, ꙗко да тѧ̀ поемъ чтѧ́а въ всѧ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: The Godhead portrayed in three Persons, undivided, in three Hypostases, in one essence and glory: bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Па́че е́стьва содѣ́телѧ и҆ Сп҃са, Бга Слово родила есѝ Дв҃о, е́го́же превозно́си къ всѣ́ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Quench the kindled and fiery arrows of the adversary that are against us, that we may hymn thee, honoring thee unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Beyond nature hast thou borne God the Word, the Creator and Savior, O Virgin: Whom we supremely exalt unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Thee, the illuminating and golden-beaming lamp, the inaccessible Light that dwelt in thee, O Virgin, the inaccessible Light showed thee forth as a lamp unto all ages!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Heaven was astonished at this, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God was manifested unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens; therefore, O Mother of God, the hierarchies of Angels and men magnify thee!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Being simple in nature, divine and unoriginate, Thou wast compounded by the assumption of the flesh, having hypostasized this within Thyself, O Word of God; and Thou didst suffer as man, yet remained free from passions as God: therefore in two natures, indivisibly and unconfusedly, do we magnify Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: [Glorifying] the Father according to His divine essence, as Thou didst become man in nature: being the transcendent God, Thou didst descend unto servants; and having risen from the tomb by the grace of the Father, Thou didst establish Him as God and Master according to nature unto the earthborn: with Him all of us magnify Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Thou wast seen, O Virgin, Mother of God, having borne beyond nature in the flesh the good Word, Whom the Father poured forth from His heart before...

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: ...all ages, as He is good; Whom now also we understand to be transcendent over bodies, even though He clothed Himself in a body!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Every hearing was affrighted...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Knowing the Son of God by nature, conceived in the womb of the Mother of God, and become man for our sake, and beholding Thee upon the Cross, suffering indeed in human nature, but remaining immortal as God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The murky darkness was dispersed, for from Hades shone forth Christ, the Sun of righteousness, enlightening all the ends of the earth, beaming with the rays of the Godhead: heavenly Man, earthly God; Whom in two natures we magnify!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Direct, and save, and reign, O Son of the Mother of God, subduing the Ishmaelite peoples that war against us unto the Christ-loving king; for as an invincible weapon He granted the Cross with the lance unto those who approach Thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Truly the Mother of God...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Full of joy and gladness is thy memory, pouring forth healings unto those who draw near and piously proclaim thee to be the Mother of God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: With psalms do we hymn thee, O full of grace, and unceasingly we cry unto thee: Rejoice! For thou hast poured forth rejoicing unto all!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Comely did thy fruit bud forth, O Mother of God, mediating incorruption and life unto those who partake thereof, who magnify thee with faith!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
