items.english_text: O Lord, though Thou didst stand at the judgment seat judged by Pilate, yet Thou didst not withdraw from the throne, seated with the Father; and having risen from the dead, Thou hast freed the world from the bondage of the stranger, as Thou art compassionate and the Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast given us Thy Cross as a weapon against the devil: for he trembles and shakes, unable to bear looking upon its power; for it raises the dead and has abolished death: therefore do we worship Thy burial and Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, though the Jews laid Thee in the tomb as one dead, yet soldiers watched Thee as a sleeping King, and sealed Thee with a seal as the treasure of life; but Thou didst rise and hast granted incorruption unto our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Thine Angel, O Lord, who proclaimed the Resurrection...

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: ...terrified indeed the guards, and crying out unto the women, he said: Why seek ye the Living One among the dead? He is risen, being God, and has granted life unto the universe!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Thou didst suffer by the Cross, being immortal in Godhead; Thou didst accept three-day burial, that Thou mightest free us from the bondage of the enemy, and having made us immortal, mightest quicken us, O Christ God, through Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: I worship, and glorify, and hymn, O Christ, Thy Resurrection from the tomb, for the sake of which Thou hast freed us from the insoluble bonds of Hades, and granted unto the world, as God, eternal life and great mercy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: While the lawless were watching Thy life-receiving tomb, having sealed it with a custody then, Thou, as immortal God and almighty, didst rise on the third day!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: When Thou didst come to the gates of Hades, O Lord, and break them down, the captives cried thus: Who is this that He is not condemned to the nether parts of the earth, but has destroyed the prison-house of death as a shadow? I received Him as one dead, and I tremble at Him as God: O Almighty One, have mercy on us!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins.
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Glory... Evangelical Sticheron. Both now... Theotokion: "Most blessed art thou..." Great Doxology, and Dismissal.*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, The Beatitudes, Tone 8:*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree; and make all of us worthy of Thy heavenly kingdom, O only Compassionate One!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Hear, O Adam, and rejoice with Eve, for he who formerly stripped you both naked, and through deceit took you captive, has been abolished by the Cross of Christ!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Nailed to the Tree of Thine own will, O our Savior, Thou didst deliver Adam from the curse of the tree, restoring unto him, as Thou art compassionate, the dwelling in Paradise that is according to Thine image!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Today Christ is risen from the tomb, granting incorruption unto all the faithful, and renewing joy unto the Myrrh-bearing women after His Passion and Resurrection!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Even as the multitude of Angels in heaven, so also upon earth the human race celebrates Thy holy Resurrection, [praising] Thy goodness, O Lord!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Raise us up from the tomb of sin, O Savior, who are slain by many passions; and by Thy rising destroy the tyranny of death, as Thou art the Lover of mankind! Glory...

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Unoriginate Trinity, undivided Essence, co-enthroned Unity, equal in honor of glory, supreme Nature and Kingdom: save those who hymn Thee with faith! Both now...

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Rejoice from us, O holy Mother of God! Rejoice, thou who didst bear joy unto the world! Rejoice, only protectress of mankind, and salvation of our souls!

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *There the Prokeimenon, according to the Tone.*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Brethren: Having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through Whom also we have obtained access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and boast in hope of the glory of God. And not only so, but we boast also in afflictions, knowing that affliction produces endurance, and endurance approved character, and approved character hope; and hope puts not to shame, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit Who was given unto us. For while we were yet weak, in due time Christ died for the ungodly. For scarcely for a righteous man will one die; though perhaps for a good man someone might even dare to die. But God proves His love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us. Much more then, having now been justified by His Blood, shall we be saved by Him from wrath. For if, being enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved by His life.

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *The Gospel according to Matthew, Section 18:*

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The Lord said: The lamp of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be simple, thy whole body shall be full of light. But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great...

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: SUNDAY LITURGY: THE BEATITUDES (TONE 8)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: ...is that darkness! No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will hold to the one and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon. Therefore I say unto you: Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than raiment? Behold the birds of the heaven: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are ye not much better than they? Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature? And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: and yet I say unto you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. If then God so clothe the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, shall He not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith? Therefore take no thought, saying: What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? For after all these things do the Gentiles seek; for your heavenly Father knows that ye have need of all these things. But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and His righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, Who camest into the world to call sinners: the robbers, the publican, and the harlot, and Who didst receive the prodigal: call me also, who have sinned against Thee more than all, O my Christ, and who nowise repent, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, Who didst appoint a pastor for Thy Church from among publicans, and didst make him who before was a persecutor to be now an intercessor: by their prayers, show me also to be Thine own sheep, O Savior, that being unprofitable I may not become food for strangers!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Weep, O wretched soul, before the end, and cleave unto God, crying unto Him from the heart with groanings, O all-defiled one: I have sinned against Thee, O Christ! Despise me not, I pray Thee, but choose good things, as Thou art merciful, and make me worthy of forgiveness!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Bodiless Powers, the same Tone:*

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, the assemblies of the Bodiless Powers unceasingly glorify Thee, delighting in Thy beauty and ineffable loveliness, richly enlightened with thrice-sunlike rays: by their prayers and intercessions, O Savior, save our souls!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast established the manifold angelic choirs by Thy most powerful Word and by Thy Holy Spirit, having granted them unfailing radiance: by their supplications and intercessions, O Savior, save our souls!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Lord, the Seraphim hymn Thee, and the Authorities, and the Angels, Principalities, Dominions, Thrones, and Powers, and Archangels, and the fearsome Cherubim offer praise unto Thee: by their supplications and intercessions, O Savior, save our souls! Glory... Both now...

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Ever doing [evil], I anger and grieve the Creator; grant me correction, O Maiden, beforehand make Him propitious, and by thy help raise me up unto acceptable deeds, that I may obtain salvation and remission!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light. Prokeimenon: "Behold now, bless the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord..." Verse: "Ye that stand in the temple of the Lord..."*

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, the same Tone:*

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The Angels unceasingly hymn Thee as King and Master; and I fall down before Thee, crying like the publican: O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Being immortal, O my soul, be not overwhelmed by the waves of life; but arise, crying unto thy Benefactor: O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O Martyrs of the Lord, ye sanctify every place and heal every sickness; and now pray ye that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy, we beseech you! Glory... Both now...

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Having received the voice of the Archangel Gabriel, let us say: Rejoice, O Mother of God, who didst bear the Giver of life unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Commanders of the heavenly hosts, we the unworthy now beseech you, that by your prayers you may protect us under the shelter of the wings of your immaterial glory, preserving us who fall down diligently and cry: Deliver us from perils, as commanders of the higher Powers! Glory... Both now...

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: An invincible rampart art thou unto us Christians, O Virgin Mother of God...

items.office: On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: With a tender-hearted eye, O Lord, behold my lowliness, for shortly my life is ending, and from works there is no salvation for me; therefore do I pray: With a tender-hearted eye, O Lord, behold my lowliness, and save me! Glory...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Since the Judge is at hand, take thought, O my soul, and consider the hour of the fearful day; for judgment is without mercy unto those who have not shown mercy: therefore before the end cry aloud: Spare me, O Savior, for Thou alone art without sin! Both now...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Having mystically received the command in his understanding, with haste the Bodiless One stood before the chamber of Joseph, saying unto the unwedded one: He Who bowed the heavens by His descent is contained inalterably whole in thee; and beholding Him in thy womb, having received the form of a servant, I am astonished to cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Bride unwedded!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Considering that fearful day, O my soul, watch, kindling thy lamp and enlightening it with oil; for thou knowest not when the voice shall come unto thee, saying Behold, the Bridegroom! See then, O my soul, that thou slumber not, and remain outside knocking, like the five virgins; but watchfully wait, that thou mayest meet Christ God with rich oil, and He shall grant thee the divine bridal chamber of His glory!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Like the harlot I fall down before Thee, that I may receive remission; and instead of myrrh, I offer tears from the heart unto Thee, that even as her Thou mayest show mercy unto me, O Savior, and grant me cleansing of sins: for like her do I cry unto Thee: Deliver me from the mire of my deeds!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: With heavenly light is this temple enlightened today, for in it the angelic hosts rejoice, and with them the choirs of the righteous make merry in the memory of the passion-bearers: by their supplications send down upon Thy world peace, O Christ, and great mercy! Glory... Both now...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Gate of the King of glory, through which the Most High alone passed, and was well-pleased that it should remain sealed, unto the salvation of our souls!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon, Creation of Joseph. Ode 1, Tone 8. Heirmos: Thy victorious right hand is divinely glorified in power...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Blot out the multitude of my sins according to the multitude of Thy compassions, O Christ, and grant...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: ...me a thought of return, that I may glorify Thy goodness which is beyond understanding!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Through the tender mercy of Thy compassions Thou wast manifested, incarnate on earth as man: therefore, O Word of God, receive me now who have sinned more than man, falling down before Thy compassions in repentance!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Imitating the mortality and death of Christ Who suffered of His own will, ye endured manifold sufferings and death, O ever-glorious ones: therefore have ye obtained immortal life, O Martyrs!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Brightly bearing within yourselves the fire of divine love, O Martyrs, ye feared not the fire, but fervently endured pain, and burned up all the deceit of polytheism!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The ranks of the Bodiless Powers with us hymn thee, O all-hymned Virgin; for the Uncircumscribed One, incarnate in thy womb, hast thou borne, remaining a Virgin, even as before birthgiving, O Bride of God!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 1, Tone 8. Heirmos: Traversing the untrodden, unaccustomed, unwetted [path]...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: As God-bearing coals kindled with the radiance of Thine essence, Thou hast shown forth the choirs of the Bodiless Powers, glorifying Thee, O Christ, as the Almighty!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Having acquired the power of incorruption and the granted glory of immortality, O Christ, the Angels are enlightened through drawing near unto Thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The Angels were shown forth as light-bearers, displaying immaterial purity according to their nature, O Christ, sensory-wise portraying it in bodily forms!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The angelic ranks, rejoicing, minister unto thy birthgiving beyond nature, O pure Virgin; for thou didst bear their God and Lord!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Thou Who alone knowest [the weakness of] human nature...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Arise, come, O my soul, and cry aloud unto thy Creator, Who alone knows all thy secret things, and bring forth fruits of repentance, that the compassionate Lord may show tender mercy unto thee and deliver thee from eternal fire!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Cleanse, O only Good One, cleanse and save me! Like the publican with fear do I cry unto Thee, dragging with myself a multitude of sins; and I am bowed down under the weight of transgressions, filled with immeasurable shame!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Filled with true wisdom and understanding, the Martyrs turned Greek fury to foolishness, destroyed subtle malice, and having suffered valiantly, worthily received crowns of victory, rejoicing!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Confessing a Unity in essence and a Trinity in Persons, O passion-bearers, by divine faith ye destroyed the delusion of polytheism, and appeared as luminaries, enlightening the hearts of all with the rays of grace!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: O holy Bride of God, pure one: thou didst bear the Holy One Who rests in the saints, the Son and Word co-unoriginate with the Father, Who sanctifies by the Holy Spirit those who piously worship Him!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The bow of the mighty is broken...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: God, Who is immortal by nature, having all-wisely fashioned immortal hosts by His goodness, manifests them!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Now standing before Christ with utmost desire, O Angels, pray that all of us may be saved!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The Creator of the ages truly received a beginning in time from thee, O Mother, Ever-Virgin!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Habakkuk, beholding thee with prophetic eyes as a mountain overshadowed by divine grace...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Unto whom shall I liken thee, O my wretched soul, working wicked deeds and not loving good things? Turn back cry aloud unto Him Who of His own will became poor for thy sake: O Knower of hearts, cleanse me and save me!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Thou didst proclaim repentance, O Savior, unto those who return; grant this unto me, O Good One, before the end of life; give me compunction and sighing, even as formerly unto the harlot who kissed Thy feet, O Master!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Filled with spiritual waters, O Martyrs, ye were shown to be rivers of living water by the divine nod; and by the Spirit ye dried up the muddy torrents of deceit, O Christ, and watered the hearts of the faithful!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Mightily contending, O divine Martyrs, ye endured fire and sword and every cruel torment: by their supplication, O great Word of God, deliver from torments, even eternal ones, those who hymn Thee with faith!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The Son Who was begotten of old of the unbegotten Father accepted birth in time, having become incarnate of thee, O Virgin: wishing, as He is tender-hearted, to take away the ancient warfare of earthly ones, He Who is transcendent over days and years!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: I have heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: I bring unto Thee the Bodiless Powers as intercessors: receiving them, O Compassionate One, deliver me from sins, as Thou art tender-hearted!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Drawing near unto the Cause of all, the divine minds, being cleansed, are enlightened with supreme understandings!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The divine adornments of the heavenly hierarchy, being adorned by the Holy Spirit, are preserved immutably!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Perceiving thee from afar, O Virgin Maiden, bearing in thine arms God incarnate, Isaiah foretold!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Enlightened by the radiance of Thy coming, O Christ...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: I have fallen into corrupt passions, and I fear Thy righteous judgment seat, O righteous Lord; therefore I pray Thee: Strengthen me to do good deeds that shall justify me!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: The unknown and secret things of my heart Thou knowest, O my God, Creator, and Lord; condemn me not therefore in the hour of judgment, when Thou shalt come to judge all things!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Partaking of the fire, the saints showed forth the kindling of their love for God: therefore, refreshed, the God-bearers rejoiced in the expectation of future blessings!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́тельнꙋю тѧ̀ и҆ златозарнꙋю: всел-
items.english_text: Strengthened by the hope of future blessings, the Martyrs the tearing of their limbs most patiently, and with their sinews, through unflagging endurance, choked the crafty one.

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: ници, подие́ша растерзанїѧ оу҆домъ терпеливнѣ́йше, и҆ многоко́знаго жи́лами свои́ми, неѡсла́бнымъ терпенїемъ оу҆дави́ша.
items.english_text: God-speaking lips cannot tell the ineffable mystery of thy divine birthgiving, O Bride of God: for thou bearest the Uncircumscribed One, and in thy hands dost hold Him Who holds all things in His hand!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃тїйствꙋющаѧ оу҆ста̀, не вомогꙋ́тъ бж҃тка твоего неизрече́нное повѣ́дати таинство Бгоневѣ́сто: неѡбыме́ннаго бо ражда́еши, и҆ на рꙋкꙋ свое́ю носи́ши, и҆́же рꙋко́ю содержащаго вся́ческаѧ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The ember showed forth unto Isaiah...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃ственно, бгонача́лїа близъ сїя́юще, Херꙋві́ми, и҆ Серафі́ми, свѣ́тлостїю, съ прѣстолы превзя́тыми, Бгоподо́бно прочаѧ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: Divinely shining near the divine Source in brightness, the Cherubim and Seraphim, together with the exalted Thrones, godlike enlighten the rest!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ко всего свѣтоли́тїа пода́тель, зерца́ла свѣтови́днаѧ, сло́ве Бж҃їй привелъ есѝ, твое́ю заре́ю съ весе́лїемъ, и҆ ра́зꙋмо неоу҆кло́нны, прїе́млющаѧ.
items.english_text: As the Giver of all light-outpouring, O Word of God, Thou hast brought forth radiant mirrors receiving Thine illumination with gladness and unwavering understanding!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дость тебѣ́, ꙗ҆́же пра́ѡ҃тцемъ сѣ́тованїе раздра́шающꙋю, Гаврїи́лъ сщ҃енный А́рхагг҃лз, снб҃се слѣтѣ́въ бл҃говѣ́ствова́ше чт҃аѧ Бгоневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: Rejoicing, which destroys the mourning of the forebears, did the sacred Archangel Gabriel, having flown down from heaven, announce unto thee, O pure Bride of God!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бы́иде на́съ послѣ́днѧѧ бе́здна, и҆ нѣ́сть.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: The nethermost abyss has surrounded us, and there is none...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Вра́чъ сы́й Хр҃те, и҆сцѣли́ стр҃ти ср҃ца мое́го, и҆ ѡ҆мый мя ѿ вся́кїѧ скве́рны, стрꙋ́ѧми Іи҃се мо́й мл҃тей твои́, да пою́ и҆ велича́ю бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе твое́.
items.english_text: Being the Physician, O Christ, heal the passions of my heart, and wash me from every defilement with the streams of Thy mercies, O my Jesus, that I may hymn and magnify Thy tender mercy!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Блꙋдѧ́ща мя на пꙋ́тех погибели, и҆ въ ровъ съгрѣшенїй къ падающа ѡ҆брати Хр҃те, и҆ къ незаблуднѣ́й стези наведи, твои́хъ чтныхъ ѡправда́нїй, ꙗ҆ко да сла́влю тя.

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ка́менїе въи́стинну многоцѣ́нное ка́менїем посыпа́емїи, не ѡ҆тверго́шася ка́мени жи́зннаго, ни́же и҆стꙋка́нномꙋ камени погрѣ́оша, сла́внїи вѣнцено́сци Гд҃ни Мч҃ници.
items.english_text: Turn me back, O Christ, who wander upon the paths of perdition and fall into the pit of sins, and guide me unto the unerring path of Thy venerable ordinances, that I may glorify Thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бнови́вше дш҃х ра́ломъ вѣ́ры, и҆ кла̀ мч҃ници стр҃тїй, а҆́доллъ бж҃твеннымъ стори́чный възрастиша, и҆ наслажде́нїа бл҃же́ннаго сподо́бишася.
items.english_text: Truly precious stones pelted with stones, the glorious crown-bearing Martyrs of the Lord rejected not the Rock of life, nor sacrificed unto a carved stone!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆́гненный слꙋ́гъ Ѻ҆́гнь роди́вши, ꙗ҆ви́лася есѝ всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ тва́ри вся́коѧ вои́стинꙋ, пречи́стаѧ Дво преимꙋ́щи, въ жена́хъ бл҃гве́ннаѧ, Бгоблг҃тнаѧ.
items.english_text: Having renewed their souls with the plow of faith, the Martyrs, through the divine ear of grain of their passions, made a hundredfold wheat to grow, and were accounted worthy of blessed delight!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннаѧ мѣ́ста сла́вы твое́ѧ нача́лнаго свѣ́та Вл҃ко Хр҃те, свѣтоблиста́нными ражегшеся сїѧ́нми: заре́ю свѣтовиднѣ̀ вѣ́чно пребыва́ютъ.
items.english_text: Having borne the Fire of the fiery ministers, thou wast shown forth, O all-immaculate, all-pure Virgin, truly excelling all creation, blessed among women, O thou who art full of God's grace!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: The divine places of the glory of Thy primordial Light, O Master Christ, kindled with light-beaming radiances, eternally abide in light-like splendor!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Strengthened by divine power, the Seraphim, crying out with unceasing voices the Thrice-Holy hymn, lead us to venerate the three-hypostatic Nature!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: As the Lord swore in truth of old unto David, He fulfilled the request from thy womb: for thou, O Maiden, hast borne Him Who reigns over heaven and earth!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Commanders of God, ministers of divine glory, leaders of Angels and guides of men: ask that which is profitable for us, and great mercy, as commanders of the Bodiless Hosts!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Thou didst say, O Lover of mankind, in Thy Scriptures: A multitude of Angels rejoice in heaven over one man who repents, O Immortal One! Therefore we who are in iniquities dare ever to entreat Thee, O sinless, only Knower of hearts, as Thou art tender-hearted, to have compassion and send down compunction upon us, the unworthy, O Master; grant us forgiveness, for on behalf of all of us the commanders of the Bodiless Hosts make supplication unto Thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: We perceive thee, O Mother of God, as a spiritual furnace...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Daniel tamed the lions of old, girded with virtue; emulate him, O my soul, and make inactive him who roars ever like a lion, wishing to seize thee, by ever looking unto God!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Having defiled my soul with a multitude of fornication, O Lord...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: ...yet having exceedingly great grace, O Christ, receive me even as the prodigal, and have compassion on me who sing: Praised and supremely glorified is the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Firmly strengthened by the law of Christ, the invincible Martyrs courageously cast down the evil wiles of the lawless; and lawfully having ended their course in success, [they cried]: Praised and supremely glorified is the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: God-radiant Martyrs of the Lord, manifestly kindled with the light of the Trinity, ye dispersed the darkness of torment and the gloom of deceit, singing: Praised and supremely glorified is the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: The laws of nature are renewed in thee: for beyond the laws of the flesh hast thou borne the Lawgiver, Christ, O all-immaculate one, Who establishes the deliverance of the law for all who sing: Praised and supremely glorified is the God of our fathers!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Into the fiery furnace...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Around the throne of Thine ineffable glory, the heavenly minds, ever dancing, hymn with unceasing lips: Supremely divine God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee being taken up unto the angelic ranks opened the heavenly gates unto Thee, singing: Supremely divine God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Manifesting thee as the fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets, O Maiden, he cried aloud: Behold, thou alone, O all-hymned one, dost bear the supremely divine and blessed God of our fathers and of us!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: In the furnace the children of Israel, as in a crucible...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: O my Redeemer, compassionate Christ, deliver me who cry aloud from the gloom of sin that now encompasses me and from all temptations: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: When Thou shalt come, O Christ, in glory to judge the world, number me also among the standing of Thine elect, who cry aloud and say: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Wisely did ye pass over unto the land of Christ, O holy Martyrs: for having contended mightily upon earth, ye received heavenly life, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Having put off the mortal body, ye were manifestly clothed from above in the garment of immortality as victors, O Martyrs of Christ, crying aloud: Bless the Lord...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: ...all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: The voices of the holy [prophets] from of old foretold thee, O all-pure one, to be the Mother of God Who made all things; unto Whom we sing, O all-pure one: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: We praise [the Lord]...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: In the likeness of Thy goodness hast Thou fashioned the Angels, who fulfill Thy commandments with might, O Word, and guide all the faithful to cry: Let all creation hymn the Lord of all essence, and supremely exalt Him!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: With divine virtues hast Thou adorned the heavenly life, the hierarchy of holy Angels, enlightening them as they cry unto Thee, O Christ: Let all creation hymn the Lord of all essence, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Rejoicing, let us brightly sing the divine hymn of the Bodiless Hosts unstintingly, and glorifying the neighboring ones, with them let us cry aloud: Let all creation hymn the Lord of all essence, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Righteousness, which guides the universe, worthily loved thee, O all-immaculate and all-pure Virgin; ineffably, O most pure Mother of God, did It take up Its abode in thee; Which glorify: Let all creation hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: An image of thy pure birthgiving, in the burning [furnace]...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Like the Canaanite woman I cry unto Thee: Have mercy on me, O Word! For I have a soul distressed by demonic assaults, acting foolishly in unfitting ways, and insensible of Thy divine fear, O Long-suffering One!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Establish, O Lord, the soles of my soul upon the rock of Thy commandments; trip up the serpent who shamelessly desires to trip me up, and deliver me from his evil-doing, as Thou art good and plenteous in mercy!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Having crossed the unstable waters of temptations and the surges of cruel wounds, O Martyrs, ye manifestly reached the harbor of the supreme Kingdom, enjoying divine stillness!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Having become radiant, O Martyrs, ye were accounted worthy of the never-setting Light, to dwell in the Church of the firstborn; and ye rejoice with the angelic choirs: with them pray unto the Giver of life on our behalf!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Thou bearest Him Who bears all things, and sucklest Him Who gives food unto all; great and fearful beyond understanding is thy mystery, O Ark of venerable sanctification, Virgin Mother of God...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: ...therefore with faith do we call thee blessed!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Thou art all desire, all sweetness...*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Assuming bodily forms, the Angels appeared light-like unto Thy divine disciples, telling of Thy second coming, O Christ: with them all of us, glorifying Thee as God, magnify Thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: As the grace of every rational nature, Thou makest a second brightness unto Thy primordial ray on account of Thine extreme goodness: therefore all of us, singing hymns unto Thee, magnify Thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Perceiving thy light-like virginity, O all-pure one, the divine Archistrategos was astonished, and brought joy unto thee: therefore all of us magnify thee as the Mother of God!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Archangels, Angels, Principalities, Dominions, Powers, Authorities, and Thrones, many-eyed Cherubim, and six-winged Seraphim: pray now for us, that we may be delivered from perils and from unquenchable fire!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Thou Who adornedst heaven with stars as God, and through Thine Angels guidest the whole earth in light: O Creator of all, save those who hymn Thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Thou art my protectress, O all-pure one, and a strong rampart, and intercessor for the world: and unto thee do I fall down crying: Deliver me from cruel evils, and snatch me from eternal fire, O Virgin, who place my hope in thee!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Monday, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Another age awaits thee, O soul, and the Judge desires to convict thy secret and grievous deeds; abide not then in the things of this world, but anticipate [the end], crying unto the Judge: O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Reject me not, O my Savior, who am held fast by sinful slothfulness; but arouse my thought unto repentance, and show me to be a skilled laborer in Thy vineyard, granting me the reward of the eleventh hour, and great mercy!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Passion-bearers of Christ! Come, all ye people, let us honor with songs and spiritual hymns the luminaries of the world and preachers of the faith, gushing fountains from which healings flow forth unto the faithful: by their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace unto Thy world, and...

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: ...unto our souls great mercy!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Receiving the prayers of sinners, and despising not the groanings of the afflicted: pray unto Him Who came forth from thy pure womb, that we may be saved, O most holy Virgin!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, The Beatitudes, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Through food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise, but by the Cross Christ brought the Thief therein, who cried aloud: Remember me when Thou comest in Thy kingdom!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Grant me a fountain of compunction by Thy tender-heartedness, O Christ God, cleansing me from all defilements of measureless evils, and make me a partaker of Thy kingdom by grace!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Bringing the ranks of Thine Angels unto supplication before Thee, O Christ: save and have compassion on us for their sake, as Thou art supremely good, overlooking all our sins committed in knowledge and in ignorance!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: By the shedding of your blood, O holy ones, ye manifestly drowned the spiritual Pharaoh, and now ye pour forth streams of miracles, drying up the deep of illnesses: therefore are ye called blessed!

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: With the voice of Angels, ye faithful, let us cry aloud the Thrice-Holy song: Holy art Thou, O Father, with the Son and the Spirit! Save us who cry unto Thee, O consubstantial Trinity, One God!

items.english_text: Thou who didst bear the unwaning Light, enlighten my soul that is ever darkened by demonic assaults, O all-immaculate one, and snatch me from the future fire by thy divine prayers!

items.english_text: *Epistle to the Hebrews, Section 303 (Heb. 2:2–10):*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Brethren: If the word spoken by Angels was steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward, how shall we escape if we neglect so great a salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by those who heard Him; God also bearing witness, both with signs and wonders, and with diverse miracles, and distributions of the Holy Spirit, according to His own will? For not unto Angels did God put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak...

items.english_text: ...but one in a certain place testified, saying: What is man, that Thou art mindful of him, or the son of man, that Thou visitest him? Thou madest him a little lower than the Angels; Thou crownedst him with glory and honor, and didst set him over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that He put all in subjection under him, He left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him. But we see Jesus, Who was made a little lower than the Angels, for the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God He might taste death for all. For it became Him, for Whom are all things, and by Whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the Captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

items.english_text: *The Gospel according to Luke, Section 51 (Luke 10:16–21):*

items.office: On Monday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: The Lord said unto His disciples: He that hears you hears Me; and he that rejects you rejects Me; and he that rejects Me rejects Him Who sent Me. And the seventy returned with joy, saying: Lord, even the demons are subject unto us through Thy name! And He said unto them: I beheld Satan as lightning fallen from heaven. Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy; and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Notwithstanding, in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven. In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said: I thank Thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that Thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good before Thee!

items.english_text: *On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: I have surpassed all men in sin: to what manner of repentance shall I school myself? If I sigh like the publican, I think to burden heaven; if I weep like the harlot, with my tears I defile the earth: but grant me remission of sins, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.english_text: I have committed every sin: I have surpassed all in...

items.english_text: ...fornication; if I desire to repent, I have no streams of tears; if I live slothfully even now, I shall be condemned unto torment: but grant me amendment, O only Good God, and have mercy on me!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Grant me a shower of tears of divine compunction, O Christ, as Thou art compassionate, that I may weep and wash away the defilements of my transgressions born of pleasures, and appear purified before Thee when Thou, the Judge, shalt come from heaven, O Lord, to judge men, as the only righteous Judge!

items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Forerunner John.*

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Preacher of Christ and Baptist, Angel, Apostle, Martyr, Prophet, Forerunner, Lamp, close Friend, Seal of the Prophets, most venerable among those born [of women], mediator between the Old and New grace, radiant voice of the Word: by thy sacred intercessions direct our supplications unto the compassionate God!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Behold the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world! didst thou cry aloud, O blessed Forerunner, when thou sawest Christ walking upon the earth; entreat Him therefore to grant remission of sins unto those who honor thee: for thou hast truly great boldness before Him, O Baptist, as mediator between the Law and grace!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Make haste to deliver me from temptations, O glorious Prophet of the Lord, I pray thee: for the bitter demons that war against me have risen up entirely against me, seeking to seize the soul of thine unworthy servant like a bird; forsake me not to the end, that from my deeds they may know yet more, O all-blessed one, that thou art my refuge!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: As ye are like-minded in natural kinship and harmonious agreement of prayer, O Mother of the King of all, and divine Forerunner: make supplication together for the servant who has greatly angered the merciful One, that He may have compassion and heal me, being moved by your intercessions, and deliver me from the fiery lot!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: The Lord will hear me when I cry unto Him. (Ps. 4:4)

items.english_text: I have sinned against Thee, O Savior, like the prodigal son; receive me, O Father, who repent, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the publican: Cleanse me even as him, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.english_text: When the holy Martyrs pray for us and hymn Christ, all deceit ceases, and the human race is saved by faith!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Impassable Gate, mystically sealed, blessed Mother of God: receive our prayers, bring them unto Thy Son and our God, that for thy sake He may save our souls!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise, but the testimony of the Lord is sufficient for thee, O Forerunner: for thou wast shown forth truly more honorable than the Prophets, in that thou wast accounted worthy to baptize in the streams Him Whom thou didst preach; therefore having suffered for the truth with rejoicing, thou didst announce good tidings even unto those in Hades: of God manifested in the flesh, Who takes away the sin of the world, and grants us great mercy!

items.office: On Monday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: We became partakers of the divine nature through thee, O Virgin Mother of God: for thou hast borne God incarnate unto us: therefore, as is our duty, all of us piously magnify thee!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Like the waves of the sea my transgressions have risen up against me; like a ship in the deep, I alone am sinking through many sins; but guide me unto the calm harbor of repentance, O Lord, and save me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: I am a barren tree, O Lord, bearing no fruit of repentance at all, and I fear the hewing down, and I dread that unquenchable fire: therefore I pray Thee: Before that calamity, turn me back and save me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion: "We became partakers of the divine nature..." (see after the Troparion).*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Have mercy on me, said David, and I also cry unto Thee: I have sinned, O Savior! Cleanse my sins through repentance and have mercy on me! Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me! Over two sins David wept, but I cry unto Thee over myriads of transgressions: he bedewed his couch with tears, but I have acquired not even a single drop; I despair and pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according unto the mandate of Thy mercy!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Apostles, Prophets, and Martyrs, holy, Venerable, and Righteous ones, who have fought the good fight and kept the faith, having boldness before the Savior: entreat Him, as He is good, on our behalf, we pray, that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: O Mother of God, despise me not who need protection and the help that is from thee: for in thee has my soul hoped; have mercy on me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: For the sake of the mercy of Thy compassion, O Master, save Thine own creature, O Christ; come, having bowed the heavens by Thy descent: therefore singing of Thy fearful dispensation, we cry unto Thee: By the supplications of Thy most pure Mother, grant us cleansing of sins, as Thou alone art tender-hearted!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Thou Who hast enlightened Thy saints more than gold, and glorified Thy venerable ones as God: being entreated by them, O Christ God, give peace unto our life, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, and direct our prayers like incense, O Thou Who alone restest among the saints!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Fervent protectress of Christians: pray ever unto thy Son, O Mother of God, to deliver us from every malice and vexation of the adversary, and to grant us forgiveness wherein we have sinned, according to the tender mercy of His compassions, through thy prayers, O Virgin Mother!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon, Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos: Taking up the song of Moses, cry aloud, O my soul: A helper and protector was He unto me for salvation; this is my God, and I will glorify Him!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Let us bitterly weep for ourselves, brethren, before our departure, that through good tears we may escape the tears of torment, which then possess nothing profitable!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Myriads of times, O Christ, I promised to repent; yet having a soul like a purchased slave, I fall into transgressions: have compassion, O Savior, on my weakness!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Having endured the fire of torment through divine bedewing, O passion-bearers of Christ, deliver me who lie in cruel passions from the fire of Gehenna!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
