items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Shown forth mighty against the enemies through divine power, ye cast down their powerless strength, O worthily blessed Martyrs of Christ!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: O fiery tongs, which Isaiah saw of old: burn up the material passions of my heart, O Mother of God, and destroy them utterly!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Forerunner, Tone the same. Heirmos: In the deep...*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: O Baptist and Forerunner of Christ, strengthen my mind that is grievously submerged by bodily pleasures, and calm the waves of passions, that having come unto divine stillness, I may hymn thee!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Enlightened with incomprehensible illumination, like a most luminous star thou didst run before the spiritual Orient: pray, O Baptist, that my heart may be illuminated thereby, which is darkened by all demonic assaults!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: In the river of old, O all-wise one, didst thou immerse the Abyss of mercy, Which by ensuing grace drowns all transgression; dry up, I pray thee, O blessed one, the torrents of my transgressions by thy sacred intercession!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: A kinsman wast thou, O blessed Forerunner, unto the pure Virgin who made God incarnate; with her we honor and entreat thee: make us who now dwell in thy divine temple to be temples of the Holy Spirit!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Show forth my barren mind as fruitful, O God, Husbandman of souls and Planter of good things, by Thy tender mercy!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: With slothful slumber have I burdened my soul: arouse me, O Christ, unto the vigilance of repentance, to do Thy commandments!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Show me not to be put to shame, O Jesus, in the fearful day, but having turned me back before the end, deliver me from cruel torments!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Having well conformed yourselves unto the sufferings of Christ by divine images, O passion-bearers of Christ, heal the bitter passions of my soul!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною оу҆крѣпля́еми Серафі́ми, зовꙋ́ще гла́сы немо́лчными, пѣ́нїе Трїст҃ое: почита́ти возводѧ̀ на е́сттво трїсопоста́сное.
items.english_text: Accounted worthy of ever-existing blessings in the heavens, O passion-bearers, ye firmly endured every temptation of cruel afflictions upon earth!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Мле́комъ пита́еши мтролѣ́пно пита́телѧ всѣ́мъ: и҆ носи́ши его̀ на рꙋ́кꙋ чта́ѧ, и҆́же всѧ́ческаѧ руко́ю носѧ́щаго всегда̀.
items.english_text: In motherly manner dost Thou nourish with milk the Nourisher of all, and barest Him in thine arms, O pure one, Who ever upholds all things by His hand!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ Ірмо́съ: На ка́мени мѧ вѣ́ри оу҆твердѝ, ра́зшири оу҆ста̀ моѧ̀ на врагѝ моѧ̀, возвесели́бося дꙋ́хъ мо́й, внегда̀ пѣ́ти: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́коже Бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆ нѣ́сть пра́веденъ па́че тебѐ, Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Establish me upon the rock of faith, widening my mouth against mine enemies, for my spirit rejoices when I sing: None is holy as our God, and none is righteous save Thee, O Lord!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣлѝ стрꙋ́пы дша̀ моеѧ̀: но оу҆́мъ мо́й ѡ҆мраче́нныи лѣ́ностїю, ѡ҆зарѝ, бж҃твенны ходота́йство, Гдⷭ҇нь Прⷬ҇тче, и҆ вськѝ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ сопроти́вных ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: Heal the wounds of my soul, and by divine intercession enlighten my mind that is darkened by slothfulness, O Forerunner of the Lord, and deliver me from every adverse circumstance, I pray thee!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дствїе радарꙋши́лъ есѝ ро́ждшеи, роди́вся Бж҃їимъ промы́шленїем, Премⷣ҇ре Прⷬ҇тче, непло́дное оу҆́бо срⷬ҇це моѐ плодоно́сно мнѣ̀ содѣ́лаи, Гдⷭ҇нь Прⷬ҇тче, ходота́йствомъ сѝ, добродѣ́телеи приноси́ти и҆зраще́нїа.
items.english_text: Thou didst loose the barrenness of her that bore thee, having been born by the providence of God, O most wise Forerunner; make therefore my barren heart fruitful unto me, O Forerunner of the Lord, by thine intercession, that it may bring forth the shoots of virtues!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же любо́вїю тѝ съзида́телей бж҃твеннаго хра́ма, вы́шнаго житїа̀ оу҆лучи́ти молѝ, и҆ и҆́же вѣ́рою хра́мъ твое́мꙋ слꙋжа́щыя, хра́мы Дꙋ́ху бж҃твенному сътворѝ, Крести́телю и҆ Прⷬ҇тче, моли́твами сѝ.
items.english_text: Entreat [God] that the builders of this divine temple may through thy love attain unto the life on high; and those who serve in faith in thy temple, make them to be temples unto the Divine Spirit, O Baptist and Forerunner, by thy prayers!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Бесела́шеся Прⷬ҇тча, во лжесна́хъ носи́мъ мт҃рнихъ, и҆ поклоня́шеся Гдⷭ҇у, носи́мѡму въ оу҆тро́бѣ твое́и Бгодаро́ваннаѧ, его́же молѝ, ѿ вськиѧ ско́рби и҆зба́вити на̀.
items.english_text: The Forerunner leaped with joy while yet carried in his mother's womb, and bowed down before the Lord Who was carried in thy womb, O woman endowed with divine grace; entreat Him to deliver us from every tribulation!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Е҆́же ѿ Дв҃ы твоѐ ржⷭ҇тво, Прⷬ҇ро́къ презрѧ̀, проповѣ́даше вопїѧ̀: слꙋ́хъ тво́й оу҆слы́шахъ, и҆ оу҆боꙗ́хся, ꙗ҆́ко ѿ ю҆́га, и҆з горы̀ ст҃ыѧ присѣ́нныя, прише́лъ есѝ Хрⷬ҇че.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Foreseeing Thy birth from the Virgin, the Prophet proclaimed, crying aloud: I heard report of Thee and was afraid; for from the south, from the holy shadowed mountain, art Thou come, O Christ!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆краде́нна ма̀ ѿвсю́ду, и҆ ѡ҆бнища́вша, сло́ве зрѧ̀ вра́гъ,
items.english_text: Seeing me despoiled on every side and impoverished, O Word, the crafty enemy...

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: поги́бели мое́и ра́дꙋется лести́вый мꙋдре́цъ. Гдⷭ҇и сла́вѣ, и҆ ѡ҆богати́телю оу҆бо́гихъ: того́ мѧ̀ ѕлодѣ́йства, и҆змѝ.

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋ́цѣ и҆ ѡ҆́чи ѡ҆сквернѝ Гдⷭ҇и, содѣва́ю ꙗ҆́же недосто́итъ твори́ти, и҆ къ ꙗ҆́рость подвиго́хъ щедро́ты твоѧ̂ и҆ждѝ твоѐ долготерпѣ́нїе, но оу҆ще́дривъ сп҃си ма̀ ꙗ҆́ко Бг҃ъ.
items.english_text: ...rejoices over my perdition; O Lord of glory, Who enrichest the poor: deliver me from his wickedness!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Ко́ль ди́венъ Бг҃ъ н́шъ къ ст҃ы́хъ с. вѣ́рꙋющи к не́го, и҆ разорѧ́ющи и҆стꙋ́каннаѧ поги́бели, и҆ наслѣ́довавши ра́иское простра́нство, ѿ него́же дре́вле и҆згна́нь бы́стъ А҆да́мъ.
items.english_text: I have defiled hands and eyes, O Lord, doing what is not seemly to do, and I have provoked Thy compassions unto wrath and exhausted Thy long-suffering; yet have compassion and save me, as Thou art God!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїемъ крове́и бл҃же́ннїи, оу҆ста́висте кро́къ приноси́мую, и҆ ногда̀, дѣ́мономъ, всѣ́м поги́белную: напа́губу прелще́нны приносѧ́щи чл҃вко́мъ, сего́ ра́ди оу҆блажа́еми естѐ при́сно.
items.english_text: How marvelous is our God in His saints, who believed in Him, broke down the idols of perdition, and inherited the expanse of Paradise, whence Adam of old was cast forth!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Научи́вся Дх҃омъ, Прⷬ҇ро́ческїи пресла́вныи ли́къ, е҆́же па́че оу҆ма̀ твое́и та́инѣ Бц҃е: разли́чноѡбра́зно сїю̀ преначерта́етъ, сщ҃е́нными ѡ҆́бразы, и҆́мже коне́цъ зрѝ и҆здале́че.
items.english_text: By the shedding of your blood, O blessed ones, ye brought to an end the bloodshed once offered unto the demons, which was destructive unto all, bringing destruction unto deceived men: therefore are ye ever called blessed!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ Ірмо́съ: Прише́ствовалъ есѝ ѿ Дв҃ы, не хода́тай, ни а҆́ггелъ, но са́мъ Гдⷭ҇и вопло́щся, и҆ спа́слъ есѝ всего́ мѧ чл҃вѣ́ка: тѣ́мъ зовꙋ́ ти: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й, Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: Instructed by the Spirit, the most glorious choir of the Prophets prefigured in diverse manners by sacred symbols thy mystery which is beyond understanding, O Mother of God, beholding the fulfillment thereof from afar!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Приклони́шемъ нб҃са̀, и҆ чл҃ко́мъ примѣси́вшусѧ, гла́ву приклони́лъ есѝ, десни́цею свое́ю пребога́те, е҆́юже ма̀ сохранѝ, въ ми́рѣ соблюда́ѧ срⷬ҇це моѐ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Thou art come forth from the Virgin, not an intercessor, nor an angel, but Thyself, O Lord, having become incarnate, and hast saved all of me, a man; therefore I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Unto Him Who bowed the heavens and mingled with men, thou didst bow thy head [under] thine own right hand, O most bountiful one; by it preserve me, keeping my heart in peace!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: A citizen of the wilderness did the untrodden desert possess in thee, O blessed Forerunner therefore I cry unto thee: Make my soul, which is utterly desolate of divine deeds, to be fruitful!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Vindicating the divine Law, thou wast unlawfully slaughtered; therefore I pray thee: Amend me who ever transgress the law and am drowned by demonic deceptions!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Look upon me who am sick, O all-immaculate one, and loose my cruel passions which are difficult to heal, that I may magnify thee who hast magnified all mankind!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Having driven away the gloom of my soul, O my Savior, enlighten me with the light of Thy commandments, as the only King of peace!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: In my folly I heap sins upon sins, and there is no respite in my death; woe is me! How shall I appear before Christ?

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Suffering shipwreck like a vessel, I have lost my cargo which Thou gavest me, O Bountiful One; and now, having become impoverished, I cry: Despise me not, O Christ!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having despised the glory that is below and trodden under foot, O passion-bearers, ye were accounted worthy of heavenly glory, abiding with Christ!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having through faith separated your mind from love of the flesh, O passion-bearers, ye willingly embraced torments, ever cleaving unto Christ!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Beholding thee by the Spirit as a great mountain, O Mother of God, whence a stone was cut without hands, Daniel foresaw Thee shattering the idols of the demons!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The enlightenment of those lying in darkness, the salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior, unto Thee do I rise early, O King of peace: enlighten me with Thine illumination, for other than Thee I know no God!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having baptized Christ in the streams of Jordan, O Forerunner, stream of incorruption: pray that the outflowings of my passions may be dried up, and that I may inherit the torrents of delight and the comely rejoicing of the righteous!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Setting forth the saving law for the people who were in the dissolution of transgressions, O Forerunner, thou didst stand between the Law and grace; therefore we pray thee: Enlighten us with the model of repentance!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Grant me time for repentance, O Benefactor, who have spent all the past time in despondency, having to entreat Thee on our behalf, O Word, John the great Forerunner and universal preacher of repentance!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: I have been slain by the snares and huntings of the deceitful one; quicken me, O all-immaculate Maiden, who didst bear, O Mother of God, the essential Life of all, that I may piously hymn thee, the all-praised one!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: I am held fast in the depth of sin, O Christ, and tempest-tossed in the sea of life; but even as the Prophet Jonah, lead me up from the depth of passions and save me, O Savior!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Even as the Canaanite woman of old, I cry unto Thee, O Savior, Son of David: Have mercy and compassions on me! For I have a soul suffering grievously, and of itself it has no desire to receive understanding!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The measureless waves of passions trouble me; even as Thou didst rebuke the sea of old, O Jesus, and didst save Thy holy disciples, so also raise me up and save me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The angelic and incorporeal choirs marveled at your bodily endurance, and praised Him Who granted you power, O honorable sufferers, and recompense for your deeds!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Drenched with the streams of your blood, having your eyes gouged out, O Martyrs, and freezing from cruel frost: ye passed over unto the warmth of life, singing of Christ!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: As a table containing the mystical Bread, whereof eating we hunger no more, O all-praised one, we truly acknowledge thee to be the Mother and nurturer of Christ, the God of all!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Drowned by the tempest of sins, as in the sea am I tossed by the storm; but lead me up from corruption, O my God, as the Lover of mankind!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Thou who didst proclaim the Word of the Father, pray Him to receive all voices of supplication, and to grant forgiveness of sins unto those who sing of thee in faith!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Heal the contrition of my soul, loose the burden of my sins, and beyond hope save me by thy prayers, O blessed Forerunner; entreat Jesus, Whom thou didst baptize with thine own hand, O Forerunner, to deliver me from the hand of sin, lifting up...

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: ...my hands ever unto Him, O most glorious one!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Slothful slumber holds me fast, and the sleep of sin weighs down my heart; by thy vigilant intercessions, O all-pure one, raise me up and save me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The light-manifesting and divine pillar in the world, the lamp of the Sun, the Forerunner, having shown forth in the end his divine and luminous memory, sanctifies those who faithfully bow down before it, crying aloud: O Prophet and Baptist of Christ, save us all!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Pouring forth streams of grace like the fountain of Eden, the God-loving memorial of the Forerunner pours forth gifts unto all of us in need; come therefore, let us all eagerly draw from these streams of divine healings; for it refreshes souls with unceasing gifts, drowns bodily sicknesses, and soothes every infirmity in season; let us therefore sing of it in love, and kiss it in faith, venerating it honorably, and crowning it with hymns like wreaths, O ye faithful; cleanse our defilements of thought, and adorn our souls with divine virtues, that we may firmly cry: O all-wise Baptist of Christ, save us all!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: Emulating the Cherubim, the Children danced in the furnace, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God, for in truth and judgment hast Thou brought all these things upon us because of our sins, O Thou Who art all-praised and all-glorified unto all ages!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: I have forsaken Thy laws, and having subjected myself like a brute beast unto desires, I work unseemly deeds, O Christ, and have become vain in my folly as no other among men upon earth; therefore leave me not, O Savior, to perish, for the sake of Thy love of mankind!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: In transgressions, O Lord, behold, I was conceived, as David I cry, and as the harlot I shed tears, and as a provoking servant I have provoked Thee, the only truly Good God; leave me not therefore, O Savior, to perish, for the sake of Thy love of mankind!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Manfully did the assembly of sufferers contend, and was crowned with martyr's wreaths by the life-bearing right hand; for in truth they loved God Who created all things by His Word, and now rejoicing in the heavens they delight in divine delight!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having their eyes gouged out and their hands and feet severed, the glorious martyrs speeded their course unto the heavenly journey, tripping up the assaults of the adversary; by their prayers, O Word, save all who glorify Thee!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The Cherubim glorify, the Seraphim hymn, Thrones, Authorities, and Dominions ever sing of thy birthgiving which is beyond understanding, O all-praised Mary; for thou alone barest God in the flesh: entreat Him, O pure one, to save all of us who honor thee in love!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The God-opposing decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame; but Christ spread a spiritual dew upon the God-fearing children, He Who is blessed and all-glorified!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Root up with the axe of thy prayer, cutting down through repentance the instigator of the passions of my heart, and plant therein, O Forerunner...

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: ...divine dispassion and the purest fear of God, alienating me from every malice!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Since thou didst baptize in the streams of the Jordan the Lord Who covers His upper chambers with waters, pray Him, O glorious Forerunner, ever to grant unto mine eyes a fountain of divine compunction!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having proclaimed the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world, O Forerunner: entreat Him, O glorious one, to show me alien unto the portion of the goats, and to unite me unto the sheep on His right hand!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: A barren womb bore thee, O Virgin, who barest in thy womb the Incarnate Word, Whom the great Forerunner, having recognized Him by divine leaping as the all-holy Offspring of the barren, adored with rejoicing!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: He Who of old prefigured on Mount Sinai the virgin miracle unto Moses: sing, bless, and exalt Him supreme unto all ages!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Thou camest down unto us, having become incarnate of a Mother; yet I, understanding it in no wise, am enslaved by pleasures; but in Thy goodness turn me back, O Christ, Who art the conversion of all!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Thou Good Shepherd, O Word, having turned back my wretched soul that wanders upon the mountains of transgression, save me, lest the deceitful enemy swallow me up utterly!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: [Tuesday — Duplicate Photographic Exposure of Folios 159v–160r (Leaf p164)][^179]

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: [This physical leaf in the codex facsimile is an identical secondary photographic exposure of the spread of folios 159v and 160r. The complete liturgical text is transcribed and translated under leaf p164.]

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Let us stand manfully together, cried the valiant sufferers one to another, when sorely wounded: Behold, Christ reaches out unto us wreaths of victory unto all ages!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: With stout sinews and by your firm sufferings ye throttled the dragon who thought to seduce you with food, and were shown forth to be heirs of the delight of Paradise!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: That God might make us radiant, He took flesh from thy pure blood and became earthly, O Virgin Mother of God; entreat Him ever on behalf of those who hymn thee!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation by the divine command, burning the Chaldeans, but bedewing the faithful who sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Stretch forth thy right hand unto me who lie upon the earth, O Forerunner, who didst stretch forth thy right hand and wash with waters the Undefiled One; deliver me from bodily defilements, purifying me wholly through repentance, and save me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having opportunity to repent, O my soul, shake off the heavy sleep of slothfulness, make haste to conquer, crying aloud with all unto the Mother of God: O tender-hearted one, have compassion on me by the supplications of thy Baptist!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The torrents of passions and the waters of malice have entered into my soul, O blessed Forerunner; make haste quickly to deliver me, thou who didst wash in river streams the calm abyss of dispassion!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having borne in the flesh the Most High God, deliver me from the fire of passions that afflict me, and enrich me who am sorely impoverished with divine virtues...

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: ...O all-pure one, that being saved I may hymn thee!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Ye earthborn, who has ever heard the like, or who has ever seen, that a Virgin was found with child and brought forth an infant without pain? Such is thy miracle, and thee, O pure Mother of God Mary, do we magnify!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: O how fearful is Thy judgment-seat, whereunto I must come for judgment, unable utterly to escape its terror; having fallen into slothfulness, turn me back, O only Creator, Who didst justify Manasseh when he had sinned!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Stay the streams of my measureless evils, O Christ, as I cry unto Thee, and grant me a drop of tears for the cleansing of defilement; then grant me remission, and in Thine unceasing mercy save my repenting soul!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The radiant memory of the divine sufferers, having shone forth like the sun, enlightens all the ends of the earth, and through the Divine Spirit drives away all the darkness of idols and the gloom of the assault of passions!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The honorable battalion of victorious soldiers, the chosen assembly of martyrs, the blessed choir, was numbered among the choir of the bodiless powers; by their prayers, O Christ, make all of us partakers of Thy kingdom!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: With radiant rays having shone forth from thy womb unto us, and having destroyed the night of godlessness, O Virgin Mother Mary: enlighten all who honor thee in faith, and deliver us from the inextinguishable darkness of eternal condemnation!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The Son of the Father without beginning, God and Lord, having become incarnate of the Virgin, hath appeared unto us to enlighten the darkened, and to gather the dispersed: therefore do we magnify the all-praised Mother of God!*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Deliver me from the mire of sin, O Lord, Who alone art sinless and abundantly merciful, by the supplications of the Baptist, who proclaimed Thee unto all the world as the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of men!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: As a sweet-smelling rose, as a fragrant cypress, as an unfading lily, as honorable myrrh do I have thee, O Forerunner of the Lord; deliver me from the foul stench of my deeds by thy prayers, who flee under thy protection!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Make me, who am barren through unfruitfulness, O all-blessed one, ever to bring forth a goodly offspring of deeds of virtues, working a wonder in me, O Lord, and making me a partaker and fellow-dweller in the assembly of the saints!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Unto us who love thee and bless thee in faith, rejoicing in thy divine temple, grant from heaven release from cruel afflictions, O Forerunner of the Lord, amendment of life, and deliverance from transgressions!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Carried in the womb of the Mother of God, thou didst bow down before Him Who upholds all things by His nod; together with her entreat Him, O glorious one, that my humble soul may be saved, which daily falls into many transgressions!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Most glorious Forerunner and preacher of grace, who didst preach sacred repentance unto all, and having shown forth the Lamb Who takes away the sins of the world, O blessed one: entreat Him now also to have mercy on the world!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Let us all praise the Forerunner John, the Baptist of the Savior, a Prophet born of a Prophet, nursling of the wilderness, and offspring of Elizabeth!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: All the Prophets proclaimed thee beforehand, O Virgin: David called thee a Mountain, and an Ark, a Lampstand, and a Ladder, a Bridge, and a Jar carrying Manna; as the Mother of God we honor thee worthily!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Pondering my foolish deeds and the evils I have committed, I flee unto Thy compassions, emulating the publican, the weeping harlot, and the prodigal son; therefore I fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou condemnest me, spare me, O my God, and have mercy on me!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Overlook my transgressions, O Lord born of the Virgin, and cleanse my heart, making it a temple for Thy Holy Spirit; cast me not away from Thy presence, O Thou Who hast measureless and great mercy!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Taking up the Cross of Christ as an unconquerable weapon, the holy Martyrs brought to naught all the power of the devil, received heavenly crowns, and became a wall unto us, praying unto Him.

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Save Thy servants from perils, O Virgin Mother of God, for after God we all flee unto thee as an unbreakable rampart and protectress!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, The Beatitudes, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: We offer unto Thee the voice of the thief, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy kingdom!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Overlook my many transgressions, O Lover of mankind, and make me a partaker of the brightness on high, O Bountiful One!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Thou who didst immerse the Abyss of tender-heartedness in the waters, O Forerunner: dry up the abyss of my evils by thy prayers!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Ye who dried up the streams of deceit with the flows of your blood, O passion-bearers of Christ: worthily are ye glorified!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Trinity without beginning, I bow down before Thee: Father, and Son, and Right Spirit; I acknowledge Thee as one simple and tri-hypostatic essence!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The Fruit of thy womb, O pure one, has made him who stumbled through the fruit of old once again a dweller in Paradise!

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 7: The righteous man shall be glad in the Lord, and shall hope in Him. (Ps. 63:11)*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Epistle to the Colossians, Section 258 (Col. 3:12–16):*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Brethren: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, long-suffering;

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye. And above all these things put on love, which is the bond of perfectness. And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful. Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts unto the Lord.

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Verse 1: The righteous man shall flourish like a palm tree. (Ps. 91:13)*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Verse 2: Planted in the house of the Lord... (Ps. 91:14)*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *The Gospel according to Matthew, Section 40 (Matt. 11:2–15):*

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: At that time: When John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples, and said unto Him: Art Thou He that should come, or do we look for another? Jesus answered and said unto them: Go and show John again those things which ye do hear and see: the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them. And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in Me. And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John: What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses. But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet. For this is he, of whom it is written: Behold, I send My messenger before Thy face, who shall prepare Thy way before Thee. Truly I say unto you, among them that are born of women there has not risen a greater than John the Baptist; notwithstanding, he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he. And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force. For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John. And if ye will receive it, this is Elijah, who was to come. He that has ears to hear, let him hear.

items.office: On Tuesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Communion Verse: The righteous man shall be in everlasting remembrance. (Ps. 111:6)*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Creation was sanctified, O only Long-suffering One, by the precious blood dropping from Thy side, and the rivers of polytheism were dried up; and Adam was delivered from condemnation by Thy Crucifixion, O Word!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: He Who is the Creator and Lord of all things and the God of all is willing to be numbered among the condemned, and willingly endures suffering for men; lifted up upon the Cross by the curse of the Law, Thou art crucified of Thine own will, O Benefactor and Lord; and being pierced in Thy side with a spear, O Giver of life, Thou didst pour forth two fountains of immortality; therefore unceasingly do we all faithfully glorify Thy sufferings, O Bountiful One!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Mother of God [Staurotheotokia], Tone the same:*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who was born of thee hanging upon the Tree, O all-immaculate one, thou didst cry aloud, exclaiming: O my most beloved Child, whither is Thy light-bearing beauty set, Who hast adorned the nature of mankind?

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Wounded by the weapon of the evil serpent, and lying half-dead upon the bed of despair: heal me swiftly, O Maiden, with the medicine of thy prayer, and save me, O my hope and protection!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Put off, O soul, the heavy burdens of thy former transgressions, and bow thy neck unto the easy yoke of thy Lord, Who shone forth from the Virgin as from a light cloud at the angelic voice!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: A sword pierced thy heart, O all-pure one, when thou sawest Thy Son upon the Cross, and thou didst cry aloud: Leave me not childless, O my Son and my God, Who didst preserve me a Virgin after childbearing!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 3: Thy mercy, O Lord, shall pursue me all the days of my life. (Ps. 22:6)*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: We bow down before Thy precious Cross, O Christ, which Thou hast preserved for the world, the great cleansing of us sinners, the victory of the Church, and the boast of all the inhabited earth; prefiguring the Cross, Moses on the mountain lifted up his hands on high and conquered Amalek; and Thou, O Savior, having stretched forth Thy palms upon the precious Cross, didst embrace all and save them from the bondage of the enemy, and gavest unto me a life-giving sign to flee from the bow of mine adversaries: therefore, O Word, I bow down before Thy precious Cross!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The Prophets, and Apostles of Christ, and Martyrs taught us to hymn the Consubstantial Trinity; and they enlightened the deceived nations, and made the sons of men partakers with the Angels!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: When thou sawest the unwaning Sun, Who shone forth from thy womb, setting upon the Cross and darkening the sun's rays, burdened in soul by the darkness of grief, thou didst cry aloud: O Thou Who didst set of Thine own will, shine forth again for my enlightenment and that of all the world!

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Troparion: Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance...*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion: Having acquired thy protection...*

items.office: On Tuesday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: The Cross was planted upon the earth and reached unto the heavens, not as a tree attaining unto the height, but because Thou Who wast upon It fillest all things: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the cypress, the pine, and the cedar, O Lamb of God, that Thou mightest save those who in faith bow down before Thy voluntary Crucifixion: O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having acquired the Cross of Thy Son as a rod of strength, O Mother of God, thereby do we cast down the insolence of the enemy, ever magnifying thee in love!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Thou Who didst deign to meet the Cross and death, didst plant It in the midst of creation; when Thou wast well-pleased, O Savior, to have Thy Body nailed thereto, then the sun hid its rays; then also the thief, beholding these things, praised Thee upon the Cross, crying out reverently: Remember me, O Lord! And believing, he was received into Paradise!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Beholding Thine unsearchable power and voluntary Crucifixion, the angelic hosts marveled, seeing how He Who is invisible was encompassed in flesh, wishing to deliver mankind from corruption; therefore as unto our Benefactor we cry unto Thee: Glory, O Christ, to Thy tender-heartedness!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на, непрохо́днаѧ и҆мѧ́ше, бл҃же́нне Прⷬ҇тче,
items.english_text: Having clad yourselves in the whole armor of Christ, and girded yourselves with the weapon of faith, the hostile arrays ye cast down idol-worship; with zealous hope of life ye endured all the torturers' threats and wounds of old; therefore ye also received crowns, O patient-souled martyrs of Christ!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: дальски низложисте. оусердно надеждою жизни претерпѣсте, вся мꙋчителскаѧ прежде прещенїа и раны, тѣм же и вѣнца прїасте, мчнци Хр҃тови терпеливодушный.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Поноснꙋю щедре см҃рть ради распятїа, колею претерпѣлъ еси, еꙗже рождшїа тѧ зрѧщи оудзвляшеса. Еѧже молбами за бл҃гоꙋтробїе мати твоеѧ, едине пребл҃гїи чл҃колюбче Гдⷭ҇и, оущедри исп҃си міра вземляи миръ грѣхи.
items.english_text: A reproachful death, O Bountiful One, by crucifixion didst Thou willingly endure; beholding which, she that bare Thee was struck with awe. By her supplications, for the sake of the tender compassion of Thy Mother, O only all-good Lord, Lover of mankind, have mercy and save the world, Thou Who takest away the sins of the world!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: По г҃. стїхологїи Сѣдална Гласъ, г҃.
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Распятїе исм҃рть прїатъ, животъ бесмертный. источилъ еси нам Хрⷭ҇те Сп҃се, и истла миръ свободивъ. Тѣм же твоѧ слави жизнодавче чл҃колюбче стрⷭ҇ти сп҃сенныѧ, ининае вси сп҃саемса, чтнаго Крⷭ҇та твоего миръ, и не побѣдимое ѡрꙋжїе имꙋще.
items.english_text: Crucifixion and death didst Thou accept, O Christ Savior, and didst pour forth immortal life for us, delivering the world from corruption; therefore we glorify Thy saving sufferings, O Life-giver and Lover of mankind, whereby we all are saved, having the peace and invincible weapon of Thy precious Cross!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ претерпѣлъ еси, безчестнѣ, Гдⷭ҇и, иже єсть высший всеѧ твари, ꙗко да почтеши ма прежде лютѣ ѡбезчещеннаго: Копїем же въ ребро твое прободенъ бывъ долготерпѣливе, хотя избавити ма ѡ истлѣнїа созданїе твое, пою многое твое млⷭ҇рдїе, и бл҃гитню чл҃колюбче.
items.english_text: Thou didst endure the Cross in dishonor, O Lord, Who art higher than all creation, that Thou mightest honor me who of old was grievously dishonored; and being pierced in Thy side with a spear, O Long-suffering One, desiring to deliver Thy creature from corruption, I hymn Thy manifold tender mercy and goodness, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Неискꙋсобрачнаѧ чтⷭ҇аѧ Мти твоѧ Хрⷭ҇те, зрѧщи тѧ мртва висѧща на древѣ, мтрски рыдающи, глаше: Что
items.english_text: She that knew not wedlock, Thy pure Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee hanging dead upon the Tree, maternally lamenting, cried aloud: What...

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: что ти воздаде Еврейскїй беззаконный сонмъ, и неблгⷣрны, иже многихъ, и великихъ твоихъ, Сн҃ꙋ мой даровъ насладивсе: пою бж҃ественное ти сошествїе.

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ̑ чⷭ҇тному и животворащему Кртꙋ.
items.english_text: ...what hath the lawless and ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many and great gifts, O my Son? I hymn Thy divine condescension!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснь, а҃. Глаⷭ, г: Ірмоⷭ: Иже воды древле,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-Creating Cross.*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Многоболѣзненныѧ страсти оуставилъ еси Слове, стрⷭ҇тми чтныѧ плоти твоеѧ, и чл҃вки сп҃лъ еси. Ихже оудзви древле сопротивоборецъ бл҃гтно покланяющїисѧ недомыслному оумомъ смотрѣнїю твоемꙋ.
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 3. Heirmos: He Who of old gathered the waters into one gathering by His divine will, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: He is our God and is all-glorified; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Иже свѧзавый враи лестїю чл҃ка заповѣди преступленїемъ, оузами свѧзанъ єсть нерѣшимыми Гдⷭ҇и, ймиже воплощаемъ хотѣнїемъ, свѧзанъ былъ еси раздѣшла прегрѣшенїа нша чл҃колюбче.
items.english_text: By the sufferings of Thy precious flesh, O Word, Thou didst make the painful passions to cease, and didst save mankind whom of old the adversary had wounded, as they devoutly bow down before Thy dispensation, which is incomprehensible to the mind!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Бѣдствꙋющꙋю потопленїемъ зрѧще стрⷭ҇тотерпци тваръ бѣсовскими лестми, вѣрны ꙗвишасѧ пристанища небꙋрнаѧ, всю лꙋкаваго силꙋ, стрꙋѧми кровными потопиша великойменитїи.
items.english_text: He who in Eden through deceit bound man by the transgression of the commandment is bound, O Lord, with unbreakable bonds, wherewith by Thy voluntary incarnation Thou wast bound, loosing our transgressions, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Ликъ мчническїи, ликостоѧнїамъ горнїй свѣтло сочеталъся, блистанми всегⷣа ѡкрестъ ѡзарѧетса; несозданнаго бж҃тва, исꙋщихъ на земли ѡзарьет, того чꙋдеса вѣрою славѧщихъ.
items.english_text: Beholding the creation in distress and drowning through demonic deceits, the passion-bearers showed themselves to be stormless havens for the faithful; and by the streams of their blood the renowned ones drowned all the power of the evil one!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The choir of martyrs, having radiantly joined the choirs on high, is ever illumined round about by the splendors of the uncreated Godhead, and illumines those on earth who faithfully glorify their marvels!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Higher than the ranks on high hast thou shown thyself to be, having borne upon earth the God-Word, O all-immaculate one, Who for His goodness' sake hath raised us up unto the heavenly realms by His sufferings and precious Cross!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Mother of God. The same Heirmos:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Grant unto the furrows of my soul, O Virgin, to be abundantly watered with tears; and vouchsafe me, O Sovereign Lady, to bear fruit a hundredfold, and fill my heart with gladness, that I may glorify thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: For the sake of the tender compassion of thy mercy, O Sovereign Lady of all, have mercy upon my wretched soul, and deliver me from the everlasting fire and from demonic assault, who now flee under thy protection, O Mother of God!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: As the undefiled temple of the King, I pray thee, O all-immaculate one, cleanse by thy prayers my heart which has been defiled by unruly passions, and enrich it with deeds of a pure life, O thou who art full of divine grace!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Why in slothfulness, O passionate soul, dost thou pass through life, and fearest not the day of the dread judgment? But arise at last from the despondency of transgressions, and now cry aloud with zeal and fervor: Save me, O pure Sovereign Lady!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: O Thou Who from non-existence didst bring all things into being, creating them by Thy Word and perfecting them by Thy Spirit, O Almighty Lord: establish me in Thy love!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Thee Who art impassible by the nature of Thy Godhead, yet didst become passible in the flesh for Thy goodness' sake, the Jewish assembly put to death upon the Tree, O Thou Who makest us immortal!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: O Word Who didst hang the earth upon the waters, Thou wast suspended upon the Tree of Thine own will, raising me up unto the heavens, who had fallen into the malice of the adversaries!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Dappled all over with wounds, O all-praised martyrs of Christ, ye stand before the Lord, receiving recompense from His rich hand!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: With a joyful soul the saints departed unto the contests, making an end to the sorrow of our bondage, and filling the angelic choirs with joy!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Beholding Christ lifted up upon the Cross, she that knew not wedlock, weeping, cried aloud: The Sun of glory has set from mine eyes, He Who illumines those in darkness!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Deliver thy servant from Gehenna and from all other torments in the hour of judgment, O all-immaculate one, and make me a partaker of the Kingdom of thy Son and God!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Heal the wounds of my soul, and calm the tumultuous surging of my thoughts, O Sovereign Lady, and grant unto me a peaceful state!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Fiercely inflamed now by passions, there is no healing for my soul, O all-immaculate one; yet leave me not utterly forsaken, O Virgin, thy servant!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Being dead in soul from the multitude of the malice of passions quicken me, O Sovereign Lady, who didst ineffably give birth to Christ the Life-giver!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou hast established for us a firm love, O Lord: for Thine Only-begotten Son didst Thou give unto death for us; therefore thankfully we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: In truth, O Master, Who art higher than all honor, Thou didst endure reproach, O Christ, being struck upon the head with a reed, that Thou mightest honor me who was dishonored by transgression, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: With a crown of thorns wast Thou crowned of Thine own will, O Long-suffering One, as a true King, and Thou didst cut down the thorn-bearing desire of sin; I hymn Thy sufferings, O Savior!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Uncrushed did ye remain by the torment of wounds, O Martyrs, crushing the enemy's deceit, and trampling underfoot him who boasted beyond measure and exalted himself in utter pride!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: In corruptible bodies having acquired divine incorruption through suffering, having steadfastly imitated the honorable sufferings of the Immortal One, O all-praised Martyrs, ye are numbered with all the bodiless hosts!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Of old the Prophet beheld thee as a scroll, O Maiden, wherein by the Father's finger was written the incarnate Word; and He tore up the ancestral handwriting with the spear, O all-immaculate one!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When the Bridegroom shall come in the night to judge the earth, then grant me, O all-immaculate one, to go forth with a shining lamp to meet Him...

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: ...and to bow down before His coming!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The dark night of passions holds me fast, thy servant; but by thy light, O good one, dispel the cloud of my soul, and guide me unto the light of the divine commandments, O all-immaculate one!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Drowned am I wholly by a tempest of temptations and by the surging of evil thoughts, and ever dragged down into the abyss of despair: save me, O Sovereign Lady, thy weeping servant!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When my soul is about to be separated from the body, then stand by me mercifully, and snatch me away from the assault of the demons who unceasingly seek my destruction, O Maiden!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: He Who is invisible appeared upon earth and willingly conversed with mortals, the Incomprehensible One; and rising early unto Him, we praise Thee, O Lover of mankind!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: As a Lamb wast Thou lifted up upon the Tree, and offered as a sacrifice unto the Father for our sake, O Good One; and Thou didst bring an end to idolatrous sacrifices, O Almighty One!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Pierced in Thy side with a spear, O Life-giver, Thou didst pour forth two fountains of salvation, proclaiming Thee to be One of the Trinity, bearing two energies!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: A firm foundation and an immovable stone have the valiant passion-bearers found in faith, building themselves up as precious stones!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Strengthened by the power of God through faith, ye conquered all the cruel might of the deceiver, O passion-bearing Martyrs and ye are radiantly crowned!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Having incorruptibly given birth to Christ, thou didst renew our nature which had become corrupt through transgression of old, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, protectress of our souls!
