items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Behold, O pure one, the affliction of my humble and passionate soul; behold also the uprising of the bodiless enemies, and deliver me from harm at their hands!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Leave not my mind to be dragged continually into unruly thoughts by demonic temptations, O Sovereign Lady, but establish it immovably!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Thy Son was shown eating with sinners for the sake of His great mercy; having been made like unto them, O pure one, have mercy on me also, who have sinned more than all!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Let me not be rebuked in the wrath of thy Son at the time of His coming, nor let me be condemned in His anger, O all-hymned one, but save me by thy prayers!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: The lowest abyss of sins hath encompassed me, and my spirit faints; but stretching forth Thy high arm, O Master, as Peter do Thou save me, O Helmsman!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Through the serpent was man brought forth from Eden, when the deceiver deceived him with enticing food; but Christ, lifted up upon the Tree of His own will, grants unto me again the ancient entrance!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: He who wounded us was wounded, and remained incurable when Thy side was wounded, O Benefactor and Lord;

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: ...and we the faithful were healed by Thy wounds wherewith Thou wast wounded willingly!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Ye appeared in the midst of the fire, O all-wise armor-bearers of Christ, roasted like lambs, and offered for the banquet of God the King of all, inheriting unceasing gladness!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Ye pour forth rivers of healings flowing from an inexhaustible fountain, O passion-bearers, drying up the currents of passions and bedewing the gatherings of the faithful!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Beholding the death of the Word Who was voluntarily incarnate from thy blood, O all-hymned one, maternally didst thou cry aloud and magnify Him Who is the author of life, O Virgin Mother and Sovereign Lady!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: By the worldly waves to the harm of my mind, I, a wretched one, am continually drowned, and am ever driven by the winds of the enemy; now do I cry unto thee: O Mother of God, help me!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Grant unto me streams of spiritual tears, O all-immaculate Maiden, that I may wash away the mire of my transgressions, and the tumult of passions, and the defilements of the body!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: I have fallen asleep unto spiritual death, and lie in the grave of despair; but give me thy hand, and raise me up, I pray thee, guiding me unto repentance of life!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Dry up the muddy rivers of mine evil deeds, O Mother of God, by streams of compunction, and direct me unto waters of relief in the day of judgment!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Kontakion: Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross of Thine own will, O Christ God, grant Thy compassions unto Thy new community that bears Thy name; make glad Thy faithful people by Thy power, granting them victories over their adversaries, having Thine aid as a weapon of peace, an invincible trophy!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: He who was caught up unto the third heaven into Paradise, and heard divine and ineffable words which it is not lawful for human tongues to utter—what doth he write to the Galatians, which ye as lovers of the Scriptures have read and understood? God forbid, he says, that I should boast, save only in the Cross of the Lord, whereon having suffered He slew the passions! Having Him therefore, let us firmly hold fast to the Cross of the Lord, the boast of all; for this is our saving Tree, a weapon of peace, an invincible victory!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: Unto the golden image of old, with Persian honor the three children would not bow down, singing to the Lord in the midst of the furnace: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: By Thy sufferings Thou didst make our afflictions to cease, O Lover of mankind, and hast now brought us over unto painless life, as we devoutly bow down before Thy precious passions, O God of all!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When creation beheld Thee crucified, O Christ, it was transformed and trembled; the earth was shaken, the rocks were split asunder, and the course of the sun hid its light!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Obeying the law of Christ, the Martyrs turned away from unlawful...

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: ...flatteries; and suffering lawfully in the midst of the tribunal, they were gloriously crowned!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Ye were not consumed by the fire, having acquired a purpose hotter than fire, O crowned passion-bearers of the Lord, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Standing and beholding Christ lifted up upon the Cross, Whom thou hadst borne, O all-immaculate one, thou didst cry aloud: Leave me not childless, O Thou Who didst preserve me pure even after childbearing!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: As the merciful Mother of God, vouchsafe Thy servants mercy, O Sovereign Lady, who in faith cry unto Thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Blot out the remembrance of my sins and vile deeds, O pure one, that in faith I may cry aloud unto Thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The choir of martyrs entreats thee, O Mother of God and Sovereign Lady: have mercy upon thy servants who in faith cry unto Thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: At the dread judgment seat of Christ, when I am about to be judged as guilty, appear unto me, O all-immaculate one, delivering me from every torment by thy fervent intercession!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: The Babylonian furnace burned not the Children, nor did the fire of the Godhead harm the Virgin; therefore with the Children we the faithful cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all forever!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When Thou wast crucified, Paradise was opened again, and the revolving sword turned its back on us, put to shame by the spear that pierced Thy holy side, O Christ, greatly merciful!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: By Thy spear was the adversary wounded and fell; and Adam who had fallen returned unto life, crying aloud: I honor Thee Who wast slain of Thine own will, O Christ, and I bless and glorify Thee, O greatly merciful One!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The world is enlightened by your contests and the courage of your suffering, and by unnumbered marvels it is delivered from heavy afflictions, faithfully crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all forever!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: He who before boasted that he would consume the earth and the sea is seen as a laughingstock, lying beneath your feet, O holy ones; and Christ adorns you with His life-bearing right hand and with unfading crowns, O ever-glorious ones!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: In time thou didst bear Him Who is above all times, Who looses temporal bonds by His own bonds, O all-immaculate one, binding the first-created Adam with the sweet bonds of His love!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Unceasingly, O pure one, show tender mercy unto those who in compunction honor thee, that they may be delivered from the snares of the devil, crying unto Thy Son: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all forever!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When by God's command my soul is about to depart from life, snatch me away from the hunting predators, O Mother of God, as I sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all forever!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Dark night holds me fast, for I have been enslaved to dark deeds; but do thou thyself, the gate of the Light, illumine me with thy light, as I sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all forever!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Grant thy mercy, O Sovereign Lady, unto the world, and prayer unto thy servant; deliver thy people from impending threat, O all-honorable one, as we cry aloud giving thanks: Glory to thee, O Queen of all!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Her that was prefigured on Sinai in the bush and fire to Moses the Lawgiver, and who conceived the divine Fire in her womb without being burned—the all-radiant and unquenchable lamp, the holy Mother of God—in hymns unceasingly honoring, we magnify!*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: That Thou mightest restore the others whom Thou hadst lost, O Christ, Thou didst lift up Thy flesh upon the Cross, O Good One, and makest partakers of joy Thine angelic hosts on high, O Life-giver, with whom honoring Thee in hymns, O Benefactor, we magnify Thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: As Thou didst stretch forth Thy hands upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou didst take up my weakened hands, vanquished by many passions, by Thy power, and didst strengthen my knees unto true healing; therefore thankfully we magnify Thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: In the flame of boundless wounds, Thy valiant and marvelous champions found Thee to be cooling dew, O Christ; therefore rejoicing they ran the race for the desired rewards, unceasingly magnifying Thee in hymns!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The multitude of sufferers, the holy choir, entreats Thee, O Christ, for the assembly of the people who provoke Thee much: by the multitude of Thy compassions, O Bountiful One, cleanse the multitude of our iniquities, as the Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Bearing human likeness, O Virgin, thou didst bear the Radiance of the Father; and when He was lifted up upon the Cross, the sun, enduring not to see it, was darkened, and the gloom of idolatry departed: therefore with Him we magnify thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: In the shadow of the law and in the scriptures, an image let us the faithful discern...*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The end draws nigh, O soul, judgment is at the doors; turn away from shameful deeds, take hold of the good life, for thou hast the Mother of God as a helper, delivering thee from every malice!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Among mental thieves have I fallen, wretched one, and through their wiles have I been stripped of the robe of my virtues to the harm of my mind, and filled with soul-corrupting passions; I cry unto thee: O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, despise me not!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: My whole life, O all-immaculate one, is consumed in despondency, and through despair I have now drawn nigh unto hades; but grant me amendment...

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: ...O pure one, and leave me not to be afflicted therein, who flee under thy protection!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Thou knowest the weakness of my humble body, the wounds of my soul, the sighing of my heart, the wandering and deceit of my mind; therefore by thy tender-heartedness grant healing unto my wandering!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion of the Cross, on Wednesday:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The divine Cross, an invincible weapon and confirmation of the faith, do we hymn and bow down before in faith: the great refuge and boast of Christians, the guardian of the Orthodox, the glory of passion-bearers; worthily do we praise Thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Standing by the Cross, the all-immaculate one, seeing her Son hanging crucified upon the Tree, poor one, wept, shedding tears maternally, and cried aloud: What marvelous wonder is this, that the Creator of creation submits to be nailed fast!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The tree of disobedience budded forth death unto the world; but the tree of the Cross sprouted life and incorruption; therefore we pray Thee, the crucified Lord, that the light of Thy countenance may be signed upon us!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Through longing for pleasure was I cast out, having fallen by a cruel fall; yet despising me not, O Master, for my sake Thou didst take upon Thyself crucifixion like unto mine, and savest me and leadest me into glory, O my Deliverer, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: The hosts of the holy Angels were amazed at the struggles of the martyrs, how, though compassed with flesh, they set at naught the torments, having become imitators of the sufferings of Christ the Savior; and they pray for our souls!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When the all-hymned Ewe-lamb, the Virgin Thy Mother, beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O my Christ, weeping with lamentation she cried aloud: O my Son and my God, leave me not childless, Thou Who didst preserve me pure even after childbearing!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *At the Divine Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 3:*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: When forefather Adam cast off Thy commandment, O Christ, Thou didst cast him out of Paradise; but the thief who confessed Thee upon the cross, O Bountiful One, Thou didst settle therein, as he cried: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Crucified for my sake and pierced in Thy side with a spear, O my Jesus, Thou didst pour forth two fountains of salvation; therefore, saved by Thy suffering, O Christ, I hymn and glorify Thy tender compassion: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Thou wast numbered with the transgressors, and didst take away the iniquities of all, O Jesus; and crowned with thorns as King of all, Thou didst cut down from the root the thorny sin of the forefather, O Christ; therefore in faith we now glorify Thy sufferings!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Having been made like unto the sufferings of Christ, O valiant sufferers, all-praised Martyrs, ye cast down the enemy's deceit by the power of Christ, and obtained eternal glory; pray ye for all of us, O holy ones!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: O Tri-hypostatic Unity and undivided all-effecting Trinity, one essence and power: protect Thy singers from every harm of the enemy, and vouchsafe them the Kingdom, which they that lived well have obtained!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Beholding Him upon the Cross Whom thou didst incarnate of thy pure blood, grieving she cried aloud, O Virgin Mother of God: What is this, O Child, that the evil assembly hath rendered unto Thee, putting Thee to death, Who art the life and resurrection of all the faithful!

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 3 (Song of the Theotokos): My soul doth magnify the Lord. (Luke 1:46) Verse: For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden. (Luke 1:48)*

items.english_text: *The Epistle of the Holy Apostle Paul to the Philippians, Section 240 (Phil. 2:5–11):*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: Brethren: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: but made Himself of no reputation, and took upon Him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: and being found in fashion as a man, He humbled Himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the Cross. Therefore God also hath highly exalted Him, and given Him a name which is above every name: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: *Alleluia, Tone 8 (Tone [N]): Verse: Give ear, O daughter, and see... (Ps. 44:11) Verse: The rich among the people shall entreat thy countenance... (Ps. 44:13)*

items.english_text: *The Gospel according to Luke, Section 54 (Luke 10:38–42, 11:27–28):*

items.office: On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_text: Превышши вышни ꙗвилася еси чиновъ, рожши на земли
items.english_text: At that time: Jesus entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received Him into her house. And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard His word. But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to Him, and said: Lord, dost Thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? Bid her therefore that she help me. And Jesus answered and said unto her: Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: but one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her. And it came to pass, as He spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto Him: Blessed is the womb that bare Thee, and the paps which Thou hast sucked. But He said: Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
