items.english_text: *On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Стрⷭ҇тїю ти чтною. бе[з]честно бывшее естество. почести еси чл҃чтка. тѣмже тя почитающе страх[ом], величаем державу твою, и вѣрно слав[им]. славно бо прославися.
items.english_text: With celestial light creation is enlightened today, even this temple; for in it the angelic hosts rejoice, and with them the choirs of martyrs make glad, in the memory of the passion-bearers: by their prayers send down, O Christ, unto our souls peace and great mercy.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Стрⷭ҇тїю ти чтною. бе[з]честно бывшее естество. почести еси чл҃чтка. тѣмже тя почитающе страх[ом], величаем державу твою, и вѣрно слав[им]. славно бо прославися.
items.english_text: As noetic luminaries were ye revealed, O holy martyrs, unto the world for ye abolished deceit by faith, and enlightened your spiritual lamps, and entered with the Bridegroom in glory into the heavenly bridal chamber; and now pray that our souls may be saved.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: ...бо прелести, оупраднисте вѣрою, дшевных свѣща ваша просвѣтисте, и съ женихомъ со славою внидосте въ нбный чертогъ: и ннѣ молитися сптисѧ дшамъ нашимъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion: "Who for our sake wast born of the Virgin..."*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: И нынѣ, Богородиченъ: Иже насъ ради рождейся от Дѣвы...
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: По в҃. Стїлогїи. Сѣдална мчнчны, Гла. и҃. по, Премрос:
items.english_text: As ever-shining luminaries unto the universe were ye revealed through faith, having in martyr-like manner placed all hope upon the Lord, and with the noetic oil of the Holy Spirit ye enlightened your spiritual lamps; therefore also as spiritual chalices, pouring forth your blood like water, ye appeared unto the Church, O all-lauded passion-bearers: pray Christ God to grant the remission of sins unto us who with love honor your holy memory.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Вселеннѣй свѣтила прно сїающаꙗ, ꙗвистеся вѣрою, мчнически все возложивше оупованіе на Гда, и мысленнымъ елеемъ Дха стаго, дшевныꙗ свѣща ваша просвѣтисте, тѣмже и чаша дховныꙗ, проливающе крови ꙗко воды, Црквы ꙗвистеся, стрⷭ҇тотерпци всехвалный, млите Хрта Бга, согрѣшенїй ѡставленіе даровати, на, чтꙋщимъ любовію стꙋю памят вашꙋ.
items.english_text: Valiant martyrs of the Lord, and hierarchs: who having lawfully and honorably accomplished the good fight, and received incorruptible crowns from God, unceasingly pray His goodness for us, that He may grant us remission of transgressions, as He is a God easily reconciled.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Хрбрцы Мчници Гдни, и Стлїе: иже добрѣ побигъ клю-чтнолѣпнѣ законно съвершивше, и вѣнца нетлѣнныꙗ ѿ Бга воспрїемше, непрестанно млите ѡ на того блгтыню, да согрѣшенїемъ прощеніе намъ дарꙋетъ. ꙗко Бгъ блгопремѣненъ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Sessional Hymn for the Departed:*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Глубиною мрⷣости, члѣколюбнѣ вся строꙗ: и еже напалзу всѣмъ подаваꙗ, едине создателю, покои Гди душа рабъ свои, на тя бо оупованіе возложиша, на Творца Зиждителя, и Бга ншего.
items.english_text: With depth of wisdom, in love for mankind, Thou orderest all things, and dispensest unto all that which is profitable, O only Creator: give rest, O Lord, unto the souls of Thy servants; for they have placed their hope in Thee, our Maker and Creator and God.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Тебе стѣну и пристанище имамы, и млтвенницꙋ бл҃го-
items.english_text: In thee do we have a wall and a haven, and an acceptable...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: -прїятну, къ рождьшемуся из тебе Бгу, Бце безневѣстнаꙗ: вѣрный ты еси спніе.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Канонъ мчнком, стлемъ, прпбны, й оусопши. Гласъ, й. Пѣснь, а҃. Ірмо́съ:
items.english_text: ...intercessor before the God Who was born of thee, O unwedded Mother of God: thou art the salvation of the faithful.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Воспоимъ Гдви, проведшемъ люди своя, сквозѣ чермное море: пѣснь побѣдную, ꙗко прославися.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerable Ones, and the Departed, Tone 8.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Чтное бисерїе ꙗвистеся, вѣнецъ оукрасисте чтныꙗ Цркве, стр҃тоносци Хр҃товы доблественнїи.
items.english_text: Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea: a song of victory, for He is glorified.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Облисташа догмат и добродѣтелей бж҃енними свѣтлостми, Хвы стлїе, итѣми вѣрны срца просвѣтиша.
items.english_text: Ye were revealed as precious pearls, and ye adorned the crown of the honorable Church, O valiant passion-bearers of Christ.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Тебе иже въ Прроцѣх, и въ Прпбны оудивляемаго, моли Слове, тѣхъ молбами спаси насъ.
items.english_text: The hierarchs of Christ shone with the divine brightness of dogmas and virtues, and thereby enlightened the hearts of the faithful.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Егда судъ првный прїидеши сотворити првнѣйшій, неосужденны, Слове: тѣх молбами на спасай.
items.english_text: We entreat Thee, O Word, Who art marvelous in the Prophets and in the Venerable: by their prayers save us.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Бга рождьшю женскїй ликъ тебе вѣдый, въ слѣдъ тебе Дво тому приведеся. пострадавъ.
items.english_text: When Thou, the most righteous Judge, comest to execute righteous judgment, O Word: save us uncondemned by their prayers.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канонъ оусопши. Гла, й. Пѣснь, а. Ірмо: Воду прошед...
items.english_text: Knowing thee to have born God, O Virgin, the choir of women, having suffered, was brought after thee unto Him.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Стихъ: Дивенъ Бгъ въ стыхъ своихъ, Бгъ Іилевъ. (Пс. 67:36)
items.english_text: *Another Canon for the Departed, Tone 8.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: Traversing the water...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Emulating by their death the death of Christ, and by their sufferings His honorable Passion, all the martyrs obtained the divine and blessed life.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Overlooking the transgressions of youth and passing by the sins, O Christ Savior: number among Thine elect Thy servants who have fallen asleep before us,

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Granting richly unto Thy servants whom Thou hast received, O much-merciful One, the glory and the joy which they that acquired the blessed abode have obtained.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive the Word of the Father, hypostatically united in the flesh, Who through thee, O all-immaculate Maiden, abolished hades by divine power.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O Word Who by the word didst establish the heavens: establish our mind and heart, that we may glorify Thee, the Savior of our souls.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having rejected the abominable sacrifices with steadfast mind, the sufferers became a most honorable sacrifice unto the Word Who was sacrificed.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Renewing by hierurgic words that which had grown old through all kinds of passions, ye were revealed as divine disciples of Him Who renewed the world.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The grace of the All-Holy Spirit, which of old was manifestly given unto the Prophets, afterwards filled the fasting ascetics with divine gifts.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Number among the choirs of the saints, O God, those who have departed from this life in faith, and make them dwellers of Paradise, for the sake of Thine ineffable mercy.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Jesus, Who is...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: ...nowhere contained, roomily took up His dwelling within thy sanctified womb, O all-pure, all-hymned Virgin.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: O Lord, Builder of the vault of heaven...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having been cleansed from the ancient ancestral fall by Baptism and regeneration, and sprinkled with the streams of your own blood, O blessed ones, ye reign with Christ.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O Thou Who willingly wast laid dead in the tomb, raising up those who dwell in the tombs, O Savior: be well-pleased that they whom Thou hast taken from among us may dwell in the tents of Thy righteous.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Being entreated by the divine compassion, and by the grace of Thy nature which is known to be so great: grant forgiveness of sins unto Thy servants, and give them rest with Thyself.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: He Who was incarnate of thy womb and became man, Who is pre-eminently the only Lover of mankind, saves man from the gates of death, O all-pure Mother of God, only all-hymned one.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: As the first-fruits of nature, unto the Creator of creation the universe offers Thee, O Lord, the God-bearing martyrs: by their prayers preserve in profound peace Thy Church and Thy city, for the sake of the Mother of God, O Thou Who alone art much-merciful.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: I have heard, O Lord...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having entered the spiritual arena, burning in spirit, O divinely-blessed sufferers: ye burned up material deceit.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thy venerable ones, O Lord, and the hierarchs hast Thou radiant-glorified: by their divine prayers make us partakers of Thy glory.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The inspiration of the Divine Spirit which enlightened the Prophets granted strength unto women, and they destroyed the haughty insolence of the enemy.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Deign to grant that Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O Most Good One, may rejoice in the choir together with all the saints in the dwellings of Thy saints, we entreat Thee.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Above the laws of nature, O unwedded Bride of God, thou didst bear the Law-giver of the Divine Father, Who renews fallen human nature.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou art my Lord, O Christ, Thou art...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: That they might behold Thy glory, O Master, and radiantly obtain the light-giving beams of Thy brightness in heaven, the divine martyrs endured to bear every manner of torment, singing unto Thee, O Christ: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Many are the mansions with Thee, O Savior, apportioned according to worth unto all, according to the measure of virtues: deign, therefore, O Bountiful One, to fill them with those who have departed in faith, piously crying unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Manifestly didst Thou appear unto man, O Immortal One, Thou didst endure death common to all, and didst show forth the paths of life: deign, as Lover of mankind, to grant forgiveness of sins unto those who have departed, as Master bestowing and granting communion of light.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou art the boast of the faithful...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: ...O unwedded one, thou art the mediatress, thou art the refuge of Christians, a wall and a haven; unto thy Son dost thou bear supplications, O all-immaculate one, and dost save from calamities those who know thee in faith and love as the pure Mother of God.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Enlighten us by Thy commandments...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The divine martyrs endured bodily wounds, and therefore ever heal our wounds, wounding the demons.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O holy hierarchs of God, pray with all the venerable ones unto Christ, that He may grant us remission of sins.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having mortified the flesh by wounds and asceticism, the venerable women, O Lover of mankind, were accounted worthy of the good things hoped for.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having slain death by Thy death, O Immortal One: as Lover of mankind give rest unto Thy faithful servants who have died in hope of life.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou didst abolish the condemnation of our forebears, O pure one, having borne in the flesh Jesus, the only Lord Who justifies all.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having compassion, deign to account the departed worthy of Thine ineffable glory and of Thy blessedness which is beyond word, in the dwellings of the saints, where is the delightful voice of those that keep festival in the passionless life, O only Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Where are the angelic ranks, where the assemblies of the righteous rejoice settle Thy servants in the bosom of Abraham, O Savior, and be well-pleased, O Merciful One, that they may stand with boldness before the dread and divine Throne.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou wast revealed as our cleansing, our righteousness, and redemption, and by Thy wound Thou hast healed our infirmities: do Thou therefore, O Bountiful and Good One, appoint those who have departed to dwell in the sweetness of Paradise.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Condescending in mercy, O Compassionate One, Thou didst take upon Thyself the measure of human nature, adorned with divine glory in the highest, taking from virginal loins flesh ensouled and rational, whereby Thou didst destroy death.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: By your honorable wounds ye heal spiritual infirmities, and ever remove the festerings of bodies, wounding the hosts of wicked demons, O holy martyrs.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The choir of the venerable, the assembly of hierarchs, and the divine company of holy women, having suffered steadfastly, inherited the heavenly rewards.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having mortified the flesh, the ascetics received life; and having shepherded well the flock of Christ, the most wise hierarchs were accounted worthy of immortal glory after their end.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou Who art life unto the living, O Word, and rest unto the dead...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: ...settle Thy departed servants, who have been taken from among us by Thy divine nod, in the bosom of Abraham Thy pleasing servant.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The radiance of the Father was made manifest in thee, O pure one; and having dispelled the darkness of polytheism by the immaterial beams of His Godhead, He enlightened the world.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Savior, endured many tortures, their souls having been wounded by Thy love, O Holy One, desiring Thine everlasting glory and sweet communion with Thee.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou didst tear apart the bonds of inimical death, O Savior, and didst resurrect all the prisoners therein, granting life: whereunto, O Benefactor, deign to admit the departed.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: From tears and sighings in hades deliver Thy servants, O Savior; for as the only Compassionate One, Thou wipest away every tear from every face of those who faithfully theologize Thee.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The Creator of nature is fashioned within thy womb; being full as God, He empties Himself, O all-immaculate one; the only Immortal One dies by death for the salvation of all.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: With the saints give rest, O Christ, unto the souls of Thy servants, where there is neither sickness, nor sorrow, nor sighing, but life everlasting.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou alone art immortal, Who hast made and fashioned man for we mortals were fashioned from the earth, and unto the same earth shall we go, as Thou didst command Who didst fashion me and say unto me: For dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return; whither all we mortals go, making our funeral weeping the song: Alleluia.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The godly children in Babylon bowed not down unto the golden image, but bedewed in the midst of the fiery furnace, sang a hymn, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having broken down the wall of impiety by your holy bonds, O all-lauded ones: disperse the burden of my sins, as I cry: Martyrs, save me who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: With the showers of your holy blood ye quench the fire of heresies; and by flame, O most wise hierarchs, ye burn up the deceitful tares of impiety, and enlighten the souls of the faithful.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having mortified the flesh through abstinence, the ascetics live after death; and the choir of the prophets and righteous, and the company of women, having suffered, were glorified: by their prayers, O Christ, deliver us from calamities.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Give rest, O Christ, unto the souls of all who have fallen asleep in hope of life, overlooking their sins committed in this life, according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, O Compassionate and only Savior, Who art the blessed God of our fathers.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having received into thy womb...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: ...the Word entirely incarnate, as thou art pure: entreat Him, O all-pure one, to cleanse of sins the soul and body of him that flees unto thee and honors thee in faith.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The fire was ashamed before the condescension of...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: All the desire of the martyrs was extended toward the one Master, being united unto Him in love, and singing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou grantest unto those who have departed in faith the brightness of the Divine Kingdom, bestowing garments of incorruption, as they cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Fill with joy and gladness Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O Bountiful One, having accounted them worthy to call upon Thee and sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou didst loose the curse of Eve, for thou didst pour thyself forth as an all-immaculate virgin, pouring forth a wellspring of blessing unto those who cry: Blessed, O all-pure one, is the fruit of thy womb!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The God-proclaiming children in the furnace trampled upon the fire and flame, rejoicing and singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Ye cast down the idol temples while suffering, and fashioned yourselves into divine temples of the Trinity, O passion-bearers of the Lord, companions of the Angels.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thy priests, O Christ, the righteous clothed with righteousness, who are from the ages, now rejoice together, beholding most clearly Thy divine beauty.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: By the holy prayers of Thy Prophets, and of the ever-blessed women, and of the righteous from the ages: grant Thy mercies, O Word, unto Thy world.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O Righteous Judge, when Thou shalt come to judge: preserve uncondemned those whom Thou hast taken from among us, overlooking their transgressions, O Master.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Appear, O Maiden, and by thine illumination drive away the dark clouds of my soul, who didst bring forth the Sun of righteousness.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: When the musical instruments sounded together...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having passed beyond earthly passions, the true martyrs received heavenly crowns, crying unto Thee unceasingly: Praise ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having descended into the nethermost pit, Thou didst resurrect those that dwell in the tombs by Thy life-originating right hand; and unto Thy servants who have fallen asleep in faith, O Bountiful One, grant rest.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: As Thou art the wellspring of everlasting life, as Thou art the torrent of sweetness: deign that Thy servants who have piously departed unto Thee may sing unto Thee and glorify Thee unto all ages.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O Mary...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: ...Virgin Mother of God, who in the flesh didst bear God the Savior unto men: save those who sing of thy childbearing in faith and supremely exalt it unto all ages.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thee, the unwedded Mother of God and Virgin, who above understanding didst bear by the word the true God, higher than the most pure powers: with unceasing glorifications do we magnify.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The martyrs stood before the unrighteous tribunal, by the grace of Christ condemning all unrighteousness, rebuking those held by it, and receiving crowns of righteousness.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Ye appeared as church rudders, piously steering her ship into the haven of God's commandments, all ye blessed shepherd-hierarchs; therefore as helmsmen do we honor you.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The assembly of the Prophets and the Venerable entreats Thee; the company of women, O Lord, who suffered most radiantly and shone forth in asceticism, entreats Thee, O Lover of mankind: grant us Thy compassions.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Of the honor and eternal glory whereof all the saints of Christ were accounted worthy: deign, O Merciful One, that those who have departed from this vain life in faith may partake, by the prayers of Thy saints.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Holding the fullness of good things in thy hands, O all-immaculate one: fulfill our supplications, the prayers of thy servants; and direct our journeyings toward God, strengthening us to live in virtues.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Every ear trembled at the ineffable...*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Possessing the invincible and unconquerable strength of Christ, O martyrs: ye brought to naught the godless decree of the torturers, and manifestly were accounted worthy of the Heavenly Kingdom, enlightened by the beams of the Trinity, O praiseworthy ones.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Bitter hades was destroyed when Thou didst break it down, O Lover of mankind, resurrecting those who from the ages slept therein; and now, as Thou art good, in peace deign to grant Thine unwaning light unto those who have departed unto Thee.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou art all sweetness, O Savior, Thou art all desire and truly insatiable love, Thou art all ineffable comeliness: be well-pleased, therefore, that those who have departed unto Thee may enjoy Thy beauty, and make them worthy of Thy divine goodness.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Save us, O Mother of God, who didst bear Christ my Savior, both God and man: two-fold in nature, but not in hypostasis, only-begotten of the Father, and from thee the first-born of all creation; Whom in two natures we magnify.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O most glorious Prophets, blessed Apostles, righteous Patriarchs, unique assembly of Hierarchs, of the Venerable and Righteous, and company of women, all holy martyrs: together with the Mother of God pray the Lord to have mercy on your servants.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O Thou Who rulest over the dead and the living as God: give rest unto Thy servants in the dwellings of Thine elect; for even though they sinned, O Savior, yet they departed not from Thee.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O sweetness of Angels and joy of the sorrowing, mediatress of Christians, Virgin Mother of the Lord: protect us and deliver us from eternal torments.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera to the Martyrs, Tone 8.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim: for upon you Christ has rested; Seraphim: for unceasingly ye glorified Him; Angels: for ye turned away from bodies; Powers: ye work in miracles; many are your names and greater still your gifts: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Greatly did ye contend, O holy ones: having valiantly endured the torments of the lawless, confessing Christ before kings; and having again departed from this life, ye work powers in the world, and heal the sick by your sufferings, O holy ones: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O unconquerable martyrs of Christ: having conquered deceit by the power of the Cross, receiving the grace of eternal life: ye feared not the torturers' threatenings; wounded by torments, ye make glad; and now your blood has become healing for our souls: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having well clothed yourselves in the breastplate of faith, and armed yourselves with the weapon of the Cross, ye appeared as strong warriors; ye manfully resisted the torturers and cast down the devil's deceit; having become victors, ye were accounted worthy of crowns: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thy death, O Lord, was the mediator of immortality; for hadst Thou not been laid in the tomb, Paradise would not have been opened; therefore give rest unto the departed, as Lover of mankind.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Countless is the torment for those who live prodigally: the gnashing of teeth, and comfortless weeping, the fiery Gehenna, and the outer darkness, and the sleepless worm, hopeless tears, and the unmerciful Judge: therefore before the end we cry aloud, saying: O Master Christ, give rest unto those whom Thou hast chosen with Thine elect!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: O pure Virgin, gate of the Word, Mother of our God: pray that we may be saved!

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 8.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Royally didst Thou sign my freedom, O Master, having reddened Thy fingers with crimson wounds and stained them with Thy Blood; therefore with faith I pray Thee: number with Thy first-born and with Thy righteous, to obtain joy, those who have passed over unto Thee, the Compassionate One.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Thou didst minister as man, having slain Thyself as a Lamb; Thou didst offer an oblation unto the Father, delivering man from corruption: appoint therefore, as Lover of mankind, those who have departed to dwell in the land of the living, where streams of sweetness pour forth, and where ever-flowing fountains gush out.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: By the depths of Thine ineffable wisdom Thou settest a boundary unto life, and foreseest the future, and translatest Thy servants unto another life: those whom Thou hast received, therefore, appoint, O Lord, beside the waters of rest, in the brightness of the saints, and where the voice of praise and rejoicing is heard.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having conceived the unoriginate Word of God and the Father: with thy maternal boldness entreat Him earnestly to appoint thy servants where is the never-dispersing choir of those that keep festival and praise thee, where are the everlasting brightnesses, and the sweet voice of those that celebrate, O Mother of God.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise... Trisagion. Our Father. Troparia.*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *At the Divine Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 8:*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou rememberedst the Thief upon the Tree, and account all worthy, O only Bountiful One, of Thy Heavenly Kingdom.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Firmly partaking of all afflictions, by your holy wounds, O passion-bearers, ye wounded all the hosts of the demons by divine grace.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: The venerable ones of Christ, and the divine hierarchs, the assembly of the Prophets, and of all the holy righteous, have obtained the heavenly inheritance; let us worthily call them blessed.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Appoint all who in faith have departed from this life, O God, in the land of the righteous, and show them forth as heirs of Paradise, who sing of Thee in godlike manner.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Unto Thee, O Trinity, I offer a final hymn: those whom Thou hast translated hence in faith, make worthy of the dwellings of the saints, and have mercy on me, the prodigal.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Having borne the Fullness of all good things, fulfill our supplications, O Virgin, asking for us remission of sins, and...

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: ...enlightenment, and great mercy.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 8: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous. (Ps. 31:11a) [Verse: And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart. (Ps. 31:11b)] And for the Departed, Tone 6: Their souls shall dwell among good things. (Ps. 24:13a) [Verse: Unto Thee, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul. (Ps. 24:1)]*

items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *The Epistle of the Holy Apostle Paul to the Thessalonians, Section 270 (1 Thess. 4:13–17):*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: Brethren: I would not have you to be ignorant concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with Him. For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep. For the Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8
items.slavonic_text: Смертїю смерти Хртовѣй, и страстми стр҃ти подражавше чтнѣй, Мчници вси Бжтвенныꙗ и блаженныꙗ жизни получиша.
items.english_text: *The Gospel according to John, Section 16 (John 5:24–30):*

items.office: On Saturday at Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 8

items.english_text: The Lord said unto the Jews which came unto Him: Truly, truly, I say unto you in Himself; and hath given Him authority to execute judgment also, because He is the Son of man. Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation. I can of Mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and My judgment is just; because I seek not Mine own will, but the will of the Father Which hath sent Me.

items.english_text: With the disciples let us go up into the mountain of Galilee with faith to behold Christ, Who says that He has received authority over things above and things below; let us learn how He teaches to baptize all nations in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the initiates of His mysteries, even as He promised, unto the end of the age.

items.english_text: Thou didst rejoice with the disciples, O Virgin Mother of God, for thou didst behold Christ risen from the tomb on the third day, even as He said; unto whom also He appeared, teaching and revealing greater things, and commanding to baptize in the Father, and the Son, and the Spirit: that we may believe in His rising, and glorify thee, O Maiden.

items.english_text: When Mary Magdalene announced the Savior's resurrection from the dead and His appearance, the disciples, disbelieving, were reproached for the hardness of their hearts; but armed with signs and miracles, they were sent forth unto the preaching; and Thou, O Lord, wast taken up unto the primordial Light, the Father while they preached the Word everywhere, confirming it with miracles; therefore, having been enlightened for their sake, we glorify Thy resurrection from the dead, O Lord and Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: O the exceedingly wise judgments of Thine, O Christ! How unto Peter by the linen clothes alone Thou gavest to understand Thy resurrection; and journeying with Luke and Cleopas, Thou didst converse with them, and conversing, didst not quickly reveal Thyself; therefore also Thou wast reproached as being the only stranger in Jerusalem who knew not to the end what had taken place therein; yet Thou Who disposest all things for the profit of the creature didst unfold the prophecies concerning Thyself, and in the blessing of the bread wast recognized by them, whose hearts even before that had burned within them for the knowledge of Thee; and they already clearly proclaimed Thy resurrection unto the assembled disciples: through them have mercy on us!

items.english_text: Thou art the true Peace, O Christ, unto God's men; giving Thy peace unto the disciples after the resurrection, Thou didst show them to be terrified, thinking that they saw a spirit; but Thou didst quiet the turmoil of their souls, showing Thy hands and Thy feet; yet while they still disbelieved, by partaking of food and reminding them of Thy teachings, Thou didst open their mind to understand the Scriptures; promising them also the Father's promise, and having blessed them, Thou didst ascend into heaven: therefore with them we worship Thee, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: [Задня оправа кодексу: Зовнішній бік нижньої дерев'яної дошки оправи в темно-коричневій телячій шкірі зі сліпим та золотим тисненням. По периметру тиснена декоративна безперервна рослинно-хвиляста рамка (ролик); у центрі розташоване сліпе та позолочене тиснення Голгофського хреста на ступінчастому підніжжі. Залишки латунних кріплень застібок та природний знос шкіри.]
items.english_text: [Spine of the codex: Dark brown calfskin over three raised bands dividing the spine into four compartments. The topmost compartment bears a pasted paper archival label in a printed double rectangular border with the number "57", accompanied by antique linen repair stitching at the upper joint. The third compartment contains a central blind-stamped fleur-de-lis palmette vignette within a blind-ruled frame. Worn tailcap and exposed cord supports at the joints, concluding the physical leaves of the manuscript.][^236]
